data.title: We Are in Need of Allah’s Help (Surah Al-Fatir)
data.introduction: All human beings depend on Allah for their welfare and prevention of evil in various matters of their religion and world. Allah says (interpretation of the meaning): O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

data.title: Dua After Prayer for Rizq and Help
data.introduction: Prophet (ﷺ) used to say after every compulsory prayer, The servant will ask his Lord for all of his religiously and worldly needs, because the treasure of all things is in the hands of Allah. Allah says (interpretation of the meaning): “And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.” (Sura Al-Hijr 15:21) No one can withhold what Allah gives; And, no one can give what he resists.
data.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اَللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
data.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallahu wahdahu laa sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadir. Allaahumma laa maani'a limaa a'taita wa laa mu'tia limaa mana'ta wa laa yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minka al-jaddu
data.translation: There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone with no partner or associate. He is the Dominion and to Him be all praise, and He is able to do all things. O Allah, one can withhold what You have given and none can give what You have withheld, and no wealth or fortune can benefit anyone for from You comes all wealth and fortune.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، كَاتِبِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ أَمْلَى عَلَىَّ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ فِي كِتَابٍ إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهْوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ ‏" ‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بِهَذَا، وَعَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُخَيْمِرَةَ عَنْ وَرَّادٍ بِهَذَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ الْجَدُّ غِنًى‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Warrad: (the clerk of Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba) Once Al-Mughira dictated to me in a letter addressed to Muawiya that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say after every compulsory prayer, "La ilaha illa l-lahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu, wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani`a lima a`taita, wa la mu`tiya lima mana`ta, wa la yanfa`u dhal-jaddi minka l-jadd. [There is no Deity but Allah, Alone, no Partner to Him. His is the Kingdom and all praise, and Omnipotent is he. O Allah! Nobody can hold back what you gave, nobody can give what You held back, and no struggler's effort can benefit against You]." And Al-Hasan said, "Al-jadd' means prosperity [??]." [Bukhari: 844]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Prayer for Rizq and Help
benefits.description: This dua after salah reminds us that only Allah controls all wealth and blessings, making it a strong way to ask for rizq and help after every fard prayer in daily life.
points: Allahumma la mania lima ataita brings Barakah in rizq and keeps wealth safe.
La ilaha ilallah in this dua after prayer opens doors for rizq and success.
Muslims find help from Allah in times of need by making this dua after namaz.
Rizq ki dua after fard prayer keeps hearts strong with Iman and hope for more.
Dua for rizq and wealth helps a muslim trust Allah’s plan for every rizk and Amal.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Rizq After Prayer
when_to_recite.description: This dua for rizq after prayer is a strong way to ask Allah for Barakah, help, and more rizq, showing full trust in His power and mercy after every salah and in times of need.
points: After every fard prayer, muslims use this dua after salah to ask Allah for rizq and help.
When you finish namaz, recite this dua for rizq and wealth to seek Barakah in your day.
At times of worry about money, make dua for rizq and success with full yaqeen in Allah.
Before starting any new work, muslims say this dua for rizq and help from Allah for ease.
When feeling weak in rizq, repeat this very powerful dua for rizq and wealth after salat.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Prayer for Rizq and Help
how_to_perform.description: This dua for rizq is a very powerful dua for rizq and wealth, recited after every fard prayer to ask Allah for help, Barakah, and success in your daily life. It is a masnoon dua from Bukhari and brings rizq and peace.
steps: Right after fard salah, raise your hands and recite this dua for rizq with full hope.
Let your heart feel the meaning of La ilaha illallahu wahdahu as you say the words.
Ask Allah for help and rizq ki dua by saying Allahumma la mania lima ataita with Iman.
When you finish namaz, repeat this dua after prayer to seek wealth and success from Allah.
In your daily zikr allah, add this dua for rizq and wealth to your masnun duas for more Barakah.

data.title: Power of La Ilaha Illallah (Freeing of slave)
data.introduction: Say the following statement 10 times -
data.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
data.transliteration: Laa ilahaa illAllahu wahdahu laa sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadir
data.translation:
None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things.

The Prophet (ﷺ) said: The person who says the above statement 10 times It would be as if he had freed four of Ishmael's (As) children from slavery.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، قَالَ مَنْ قَالَ عَشْرًا كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ رَقَبَةً مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي السَّفَرِ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ رَبِيعِ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِلرَّبِيعِ مِمَّنْ سَمِعْتَهُ فَقَالَ مِنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ مَيْمُونٍ فَقُلْتُ مِمَّنْ سَمِعْتَهُ فَقَالَ مِنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى فَقُلْتُ مِمَّنْ سَمِعْتَهُ فَقَالَ مِنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ يُحَدِّثُهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ قَوْلَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ قَوْلَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ آدَمُ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ سَمِعْتُ هِلاَلَ بْنَ يَسَافٍ عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ وَعَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَوْلَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الأَعْمَشُ وَحُصَيْنٌ عَنْ هِلاَلٍ عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَوْلَهُ‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَضْرَمِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏ كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ رَقَبَةً مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلِ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْد اللَّهِ وَالصَّحِيحُ قَوْلُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun: Whoever recites it (i.e., the invocation in the above Hadith (412) ten times will be as if he manumitted one of Ishmael's descendants. Abu Aiyub narrated the same Hadith from the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "(Whoever recites it ten times) will be as if he had manumitted one of Ishmael's descendants." [Bukhari: 6404]

benefits.title: Benefits of Power of La Ilaha Illallah (Freeing of slave)
benefits.description: Saying the kalima tawhid brings a muslim closer to Allah’s mercy and power, making hearts strong and filling life with blessings through this most powerful dua in Islam.
points: Kalima tawhid wipes away many sins and brings Barakah in every Amal and day.
Zikr of Allah with la ilaha ilallah gives strength and peace to the muslim heart.
The power of dua in this zikr brings reward like freeing a slave in Allah’s eyes.
Lailahaillallah keeps Iman strong and helps muslims stay away from shirk and doubt.
Most powerful dua for everything, it brings help from Allah in every mushkil time.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Kalima Tawhid
when_to_recite.description: Reciting kalima tawhid fills the heart with Iman and brings the power of dua, reminding every muslim of Allah’s greatness, His praise, and the strength found in zikr of Allah.
points: After finishing salah, muslims repeat kalima tawhid for the power of dua and Barakah.
In the morning, start your day with la ilaha ilallah for strength and Allah’s help.
While walking or working, keep saying lailahaillallah wahdahu for constant zikr allah.
When feeling weak or sad, use this most powerful dua for everything you need.
At times of hardship, muslims turn to kalima tayyiba for hope and strong Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Kalima Tawhid for Strength and Blessings
how_to_perform.description: Reciting the kalima tawhid brings the power of dua and Barakah in your life, as it is the most powerful dua for everything. This zikr of Allah is a masnoon dua and gives strength, Iman, and peace to every Muslim.
steps: After salah, say lailahaillallah wahdahu with a heart full of Iman and trust in Allah.
In your daily zikr allah, repeat la ilaha ilallah to get strength and closeness to Allah.
When you feel weak, use this dua for strength and say la ilaha il allah with hope.
While walking or working, softly recite lailaha illalah to fill your day with Barakah.
At any time, remember to say la ilaha ilalah as a muslim prayer for all your needs.

data.title: Dua for Guidance (Recitation of Surah Al-Fatiha)
data.arabic: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
data.transliteration: Iyyaaka na'budu wa lyyaaka nasta'een
data.translation:
It is You we worship and It is You we ask for help.

He whom Allah guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He leaves astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide. (Surah Al-Kahf 18:17)

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Guidance (Recitation of Surah Al-Fatiha)
benefits.description: This dua for guidance from Surah Al Fatihah helps muslims ask Allah for help and direction, making every Salah and Amal full of hope and trust in His mercy and wisdom.
points: Iyyaka na budu wa iyyaka nastaeen brings true guidance in every muslim’s life.
Surah Al Fatiha in Salah connects hearts to Allah and keeps Iman strong always.
Al Fatiha in English shows the meaning of asking Allah for help in every Amal.
First Surah of Quran teaches muslims to trust Allah for success and right path.
Reciting surah fatiha in prayer brings Barakah and keeps hearts away from doubt.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Guidance
when_to_recite.description: This dua for guidance from Surah Al Fatihah is a strong way to ask Allah for help, Barakah, and the right path, making every muslim remember to seek His aid in all parts of life.
points: During every salah, muslims recite iyyaka na budu wa iyyaka nastaeen for guidance.
When starting any new task, use Surah Al Fatiha to ask Allah for help and success.
In times of confusion, repeat this dua for guidance to find the straight path in life.
Before making big choices, muslims turn to Surah Fatiha for Allah’s mercy and Barakah.
When teaching kids about prayer, begin with Al Fatiha in Arabic for strong Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Guidance with Surah Al-Fatiha
how_to_perform.description: This dua for guidance from Surah Al Fatihah is a quranic dua that every Muslim uses in daily salah. Saying iyyaka na budu wa iyyaka nastaeen brings help, Barakah, and success from Allah in all parts of life.
steps: Start your salah by reciting Surah Fatiha with full focus on its deep meaning.
When you feel lost, softly say iyyaka na budu wa iyyaka nastaeen for help.
In your daily namaz dua, use this verse to ask Allah for guidance and right path.
Before making any big choice, recite Surah Al Fatiha translation and ask for success.
At any time, repeat this quranic dua to keep your heart close to Allah and get Barakah.

data.title: Prophetic Du'a for Guidance (Sahih Muslim)
data.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commenced the prayer when he got up at night. Then he said:
data.arabic: اِهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ
data.transliteration: Ihdini limakhtulifa fihi minal-haqqi bi'idhnika innaka tahdi man tasha'u ila siratim mustaqim
data.translation: Guide me through that which there has been difference concerning the truth, verily, You are upon a straight path.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، وَأَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ كَانَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَفْتَتِحُ صَلاَتَهُ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَتْ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ افْتَتَحَ صَلاَتَهُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf reported: I asked 'A'isha, the mother of the believers, (to tell me) the words with which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commenced the prayer when he got up at night. She said: When he got up at night he would commence his prayer with these words: O Allah, Lord of Gabriel, and Michael, and Israfil, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, Who knowest the unseen and the seen; Thou decidest amongst Thy servants concerning their differences. Guide me with Thy permission in the divergent views (which the people) hold about Truth, for it is Thou Who guidest whom Thou wilt to the Straight Path. [Muslim: 770]

benefits.title: Benefits of Prophetic Du'a for Guidance (Sahih Muslim)
benefits.description: This prophetic dua for guidance from Sahih Muslim helps muslims find the right path when truth is unclear, making hearts steady with Allah’s help and the meaning of tawheed in Islam.
points: Prophetic dua for guidance brings muslims closer to sirat al mustaqim always.
Ihdina siratal mustaqim in this dua helps clear doubts and find true Amal.
Asking Allah with this dua from hadith keeps Iman strong in times of confusion.
Meaning of tawheed in islam shines bright when muslims use this powerful dua.
Sahih muslim dua for guidance helps muslims stay safe from wrong and misguidance.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Prophetic Dua for Guidance
when_to_recite.description: This prophetic dua for guidance from Sahih Muslim helps muslims ask Allah for the right path, Barakah, and clear truth, especially when life brings confusion or hard choices.
points: After salah, muslims use this prophetic dua for guidance to seek siratal mustaqim.
When facing confusion in deen, recite this dua for guidance to find the truth in Islam.
Before making big life choices, ask Allah with this dua from hadith for Barakah and help.
In times of disagreement, muslims turn to this dua for guidance for unity and tawheed.
When teaching kids about right and wrong, use this prophetic dua for guidance in daily life.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Prophetic Dua for Guidance from Sahih Muslim
how_to_perform.description: This prophetic dua for guidance is a strong islamic dua from Sahih Muslim, asking Allah to show the right path when there is confusion. It is a masnoon dua that helps every Muslim find truth and Barakah in daily life.
steps: After every salah, quietly recite this dua for guidance with full trust in Allah.
When you feel unsure, say ihdina siratal mustaqim and ask for the right way.
In your daily zikr allah, add this dua from hadith to keep your heart on Islam tawheed.
Before making choices, use this prophetic dua for guidance to seek Allah’s help.
At night before going to bed, softly repeat this muslim prayer for Barakah and peace.

data.title: Dua after Salah for Help in Worship
data.introduction: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) to recite this supplication after every (prescribed) prayer -
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّيْ عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma 'a'innee 'alaa thikrika, wa shukrika, wahusni 'ibaadatik
data.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to give You thanks, and to perform Your worship in the best manner.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ مُسْلِمٍ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيُّ، عَنِ الصُّنَابِحِيِّ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأُحِبُّكَ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأُحِبُّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أُوصِيكَ يَا مُعَاذُ لاَ تَدَعَنَّ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَوْصَى بِذَلِكَ مُعَاذٌ الصُّنَابِحِيَّ وَأَوْصَى بِهِ الصُّنَابِحِيُّ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Mu'adh b. Jabal reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) caught his hand and said: By Allah, I love you, Mu'adh. I give some instruction to you. Never leave to recite this supplication after every (prescribed) prayer: "O Allah, help me in remembering You, in giving You thanks, and worshipping You well." Mu'adh willed this supplication to the narrator al-Sunabihi and al-Sunabihi to 'Abu Abd al-Rahman. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1522]

data.title: Dua for Good manners (Masnoon Dua)
data.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commenced the prayer when he got up at night. Here is a part of it -
data.arabic: وَاهْدِنِيْ لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِيْ لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
data.transliteration: Wahdini li ahsanil-akhlaaqi, la yahdi li ahsanihaa illa anta wasrif anni sayyi'ahaa laa yasrifu anni sayyi'ahaa illa anta
data.translation: Guide me to the best of manners for none can guide to the best of them but You. Protect me from bad manners for none can protect against them but You.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ الْمَاجِشُونُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِنَّ صَلاَتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏.‏ أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاهْدِنِي لأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاَقِ لاَ يَهْدِي لأَحْسَنِهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لاَ يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ فِي يَدَيْكَ وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَكَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سَجَدَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَصَوَّرَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَكُونُ مِنْ آخِرِ مَا يَقُولُ بَيْنَ التَّشَهُّدِ وَالتَّسْلِيمِ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: Ali b. Abu Talib reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up at night for prayer he would say: I turn my face in complete devotion to One Who is the Originator of the heaven and the earth and I am not of the polytheists. Verily my prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, the Lord of the worlds; There is no partner with Him and this is what I have been commanded (to profess and believe) and I am of the believers. O Allah, Thou art the King, there is no god but Thee, Thou art my Lord, and I am Thy bondman. I wronged myself and make a confession of my Sin. Forgive all my sins, for no one forgives the sins but Thee, and guide me in the best of conduct for none but Thee guideth anyone (in) good conduct. Remove sins from me, for none else but Thou can remove sins from me. Here I am at Thy service, and Grace is to Thee and the whole of good is in Thine hand, and one cannot get nearneststo Thee through evil. My (power as well as existence) is due to Thee (Thine grace) and I turn to Thee (for supplication). Thou art blessed and Thou art exalted. I seek forgiveness from Thee and turn to Thee in repentance: and when he would bow, he would say: O Allah, it is for Thee that I bowed. I affirm my faith in Thee and I submit to Thee, and submit humbly before Thee my hearing, my eyesight, my marrow, my bone, my sinew; and when he would raise his head, he would say: O Allah, our Lord, praise is due to Thee, (the praise) with which is filled the heavens and the earth, and with which is filled that (space) which exists between them, and filled with anything that Thou desireth afterward. And when he prostrated himself, he (the Holy Prophet) would say: O Allah, it is to Thee that I prostrate myself and it is in Thee that I affirm my faith, and I submit to Thee. My face is submitted before One Who created it, and shaped it, and opened his faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the best of Creators; and he would then say between Tashahhud and the pronouncing of salutation: Forgive me of the earlier and later open and secret (sins) and that where I made transgression and that Thou knowest better than I. Thou art the First and the Last. There is no god, but Thee. [Muslim: 771]

data.title: Dua for Guidance
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) instructed Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA) to seek guidance and firmness from Allah -
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالسَّدَادَ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma inni as'alukal huda was-sadaad
data.translation: O Allah, I beg of Thee righteousness and adhering to the straight path.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَاصِمَ بْنَ كُلَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي وَاذْكُرْ بِالْهُدَى هِدَايَتَكَ الطَّرِيقَ وَالسَّدَادِ سَدَادَ السَّهْمِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: Ali reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Say," O Allah, direct me to the right path and make me adhere to the straight path," and when you make a mention of right guidance, keep in mind the right path and when you consider of the straight (path), keep in mind the straightness of the arrow. [Muslim: 2725]

data.title: Powerful Night Prayer in Witr (Dua Qunoot)
data.introduction: Narrated Al-Hasan ibn Ali (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught me some words that I say during the witr -
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِيْ فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنِيْ فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ إِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ وَلَا يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
data.transliteration: Allahum-mahdinee feeman hadayta, wa 'aafinee feeman 'aafayta, wa tawallanee feeman tawallayta, wa baarik lee feemaa 'a'atayta, wa qinee sharra maa qadhayta, fa'innaka taqdhee wa laa yuqdhaa 'alayka, 'innahu laa yadhillu man waalayta, wa laa ya 'izzu man 'aadayta, tabaarakta Rabbanaa wa ta'aalayta
data.translation: O Allah, guide me with those whom You have guided, and strengthen me with those whom You have given strength. Take me to Your care with those whom You have taken to Your care. Bless me in what You have given me. Protect me from the evil You have ordained. Surely, You command and are not commanded, and none whom You have committed to Your care shall be humiliated and none whom You have taken as an enemy shall taste glory. You are Blessed, Our Lord, and Exalted.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ جَوَّاسٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْحَوْرَاءِ، قَالَ قَالَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ رضى الله عنهما عَلَّمَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَلِمَاتٍ أَقُولُهُنَّ فِي الْوِتْرِ قَالَ ابْنُ جَوَّاسٍ فِي قُنُوتِ الْوِتْرِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ إِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ وَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ وَلاَ يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Al-Hasan ibn Ali: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught me some words that I say during the witr. (The version of Ibn Jawwas has: I say them in the supplication of the witr.) They were: "O Allah, guide me among those Thou hast guided, grant me security among those Thou hast granted security, take me into Thy charge among those Thou hast taken into Thy charge, bless me in what Thou hast given, guard me from the evil of what Thou hast decreed, for Thou dost decree, and nothing is decreed for Thee. He whom Thou befriendest is not humbled. Blessed and Exalted art Thou, our Lord." [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1425]

data.title: The Power of Daily Istighfar (Hadith)
data.introduction: Forgiveness for sins should be sought from Allah, for the most important thing a servant can ask his Lord for, is forgiveness for his sins or its inevitable consequence. Such as deliverance from Hell and entry into Paradise. The servant needs forgiveness from his Lord for his sins, because he makes mistakes every day and night and Allah alone can forgive all sins. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: My heart is invaded by unmindfulness, and I ask Allah's pardon a hundred times in the day.

data.title: Dua for forgiveness (Rabbighfirli wa tub alayya innaka)
data.introduction: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar (RA): We counted that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would say this dua a hundred times during a meeting -
data.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَىَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ
data.transliteration: Rabbighfirli wa tub `alayya innaka Antat-Tawwabur-Rahim
data.translation: O Allah forgive me and accept my repentance, for You are the Accepter of repentance, the Most Merciful.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ إِنْ كُنَّا لَنَعُدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الْوَاحِدِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ ‏ "‏ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَىَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: We counted that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would say a hundred times during a meeting: "My Lord, forgive me and pardon me; Thou art the Pardoning and forgiving One". [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1516]

data.title: Dua for forgiveness for major sins
data.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَىُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
data.transliteration: Astaghfirullaa hal-'Adheemal-ladhee laa 'ilaaha 'illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoomu wa 'atoobu 'ilayhi
data.translation:
I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, Whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Living, the Eternal, and I repent to Him.

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says, 'I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Exalted, there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Everlasting, and I repent to Him', is forgiven even if he flees from the battlefield."

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الشَّنِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ بِلاَلَ بْنَ يَسَارِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ جَدِّي سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَالَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَىَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏ غُفِرَ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Bilal bin Yasar bin Zaid [the freed slave of the Prophet(ﷺ)] narrated: “My father narrated to me, from my grandfather, that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say: ‘Whoever says: “I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Magnificent, whom there is none worthy of worship but Him, the Living, Al-Qayyum, and I repent to him,” (Astaghfirullāhal-`Aẓīm alladhī lā ilāha illā huwal-Ḥayyul-Qayyūmu wa atūbu ilaih) then Allah will forgive him, even if he fled from battle.’” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3577]

data.title: Paradise and Hell Fire Dua for protection
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'alukal-jannata wa 'a'oodhu bika minan-naar
data.translation:
O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek Your protection from the Fire.

Narrated by Abu Huraira (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), asked a man, "What do you supplicate in your prayer?" The man says, I recite Tashahhud and say- (The dua is mentioned above) I can’t recite dua as beautifully as you, nor can I recite dua like Mu'adh!" Then Prophet (ﷺ) said, “We also supplicate like you!”

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْقَطَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ لِرَجُلٍ ‏"‏ مَا تَقُولُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَتَشَهَّدُ ثُمَّ أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِهِ مِنَ النَّارِ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ مَا أُحْسِنُ دَنْدَنَتَكَ وَلاَ دَنْدَنَةَ مُعَاذٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ حَوْلَهُمَا نُدَنْدِنُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to a man: ‘What do you say during your Salat?’ He said: ‘The Tashah-hud, then I ask Allah for Paradise, and I seek refuge with Him from Hell, but I do not understand what you and Mu’adh murmur (during Salat). He said: ‘Our murmuring revolves around the same things.’” [Sahih (Albani). Ibn Majah: 910]

data.title: Seeking forgiveness in Life & Hereafter (Hadith)
data.introduction: Al-`Abbas bin `Abdul-Muttalib (RA) said: “I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), teach me something that I may ask Allah, [Mighty and Sublime] for.’ He (ﷺ) said: ‘Ask Allah for Al-`Āfiyah.’ Then I remained for a day, then I came and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), teach me something that I may ask Allah for.’ So he (ﷺ) said to me: “O Abbas, O uncle of the Messenger of Allah! Ask Allah for Al-`Āfiyah in the world and in the Hereafter.” [1] Narrated by Abu Bakr Siddiq (RA): The Prophet (ﷺ) said (sitting) on the pulpit, "Seek forgiveness and healing from Allah, for no one has been given anything better than healing after Yaqeen." [2]

data.title: Dua for Hearts to obedience (Sahih Muslim)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma musarrifal-qulubi, sarrif qulubana 'ala ta'atik
data.translation:
O Allah! Controller of the hearts, direct our hearts to Your obedience.

Abdullah bin Amr bin al-'As (RA) reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, the hearts of all the sons of Adam are between the two fingers out of the fingers of the Compassionate Lord as one heart. He turns that to any (direction) He likes. Then Allah’s Messenger (ﷺ) said: (Dua mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الْمُقْرِئِ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو هَانِئٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيَّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، يَقُولُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ قُلُوبَ بَنِي آدَمَ كُلَّهَا بَيْنَ إِصْبَعَيْنِ مِنْ أَصَابِعِ الرَّحْمَنِ كَقَلْبٍ وَاحِدٍ يُصَرِّفُهُ حَيْثُ يَشَاءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abdullah b. Amr b. al-'As reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, the hearts of all the sons of Adam are between the two fingers out of the fingers of the Compassionate Lord as one heart. He turns that to any (direction) He likes. Then Allahs Messenger (ﷺ) said: 0 Allah, the Turner of the hearts, turn our hearts to Thine obedience. [Muslim: 2655]

data.title: Dua For Steadfast In Religion (Masnun Dua)
data.introduction: Shahr bin Hawshab (R) said: “I said to Umm Salamah (RA): ‘O Mother of the Believers! What was the supplication that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said most frequently when he was with you?” She said: ‘The supplication he said most frequently was -
data.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِيْ عَلَى دِيْنِكَ
data.transliteration: Ya Muqallibal-qulubi, thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik
data.translation:
O Changer of the Hearts! Strengthen my heart upon Your Religion.

So I said: O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), why do you supplicate so frequently. He said: ‘O Umm Salamah! Verily, there is no human being except that his heart is between Two Fingers of the Fingers of Allah, so whomsoever He wills He makes steadfast, and whomever He wills He causes to deviate.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُوسَى الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، عَنْ أَبِي كَعْبٍ، صَاحِبِ الْحَرِيرِ حَدَّثَنِي شَهْرُ بْنُ حَوْشَبٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُ دُعَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَكِ قَالَتْ كَانَ أَكْثَرُ دُعَائِهِ ‏"‏ يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لأَكْثَرِ دُعَائِكَ يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ آدَمِيٌّ إِلاَّ وَقَلْبُهُ بَيْنَ أُصْبُعَيْنِ مِنْ أَصَابِعِ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ شَاءَ أَقَامَ وَمَنْ شَاءَ أَزَاغَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَتَلاَ مُعَاذٌ ‏:‏ ‏
hadith.translation: (‏ ربَّنَا لاَ تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا ‏) ‏ قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ وَالنَّوَّاسِ بْنِ سَمْعَانَ وَأَنَسٍ وَجَابِرٍ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو وَنُعَيْمِ بْنِ هَمَّارٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَهَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ ‏.‏ Shahr bin Hawshab said: “I said to Umm Salamah: ‘O Mother of the Believers! What was the supplication that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said most frequently when he was with you?” She said: ‘The supplication he said most frequently was: “O Changer of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion (Yā Muqallibal-qulūb, thabbit qalbī `alā dīnik).’” She said: ‘So I said: “O Messenger of Allah, why do you supplicate so frequently: ‘O Changer of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.’ He said: ‘O Umm Salamah! Verily, there is no human being except that his heart is between Two Fingers of the Fingers of Allah, so whomsoever He wills He makes steadfast, and whomever He wills He causes to deviate.’” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3522]

data.title: Dua for success in Deen (Allahumma aslih li deeni)
data.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say -
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِيَ الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي، وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma aslih lee deeni alladhi huwa ‛is-matu amree, Wa aslih lee dun-yaaiallati feeha ma‛aashee, Wa asli lee aakhiratee allati feeha ma‛aadee, Waj-‛alil hayaata ziyaa‛datan lee fee kulli khair waj 'alilmawta raa‛hatan lee min kulli sharr
data.translation: O Allah perfect for me my religion on which success of all my affairs depends, And perfect my worldly affairs on which my livelihood depends, And perfect my hereafter to which I will return, And make in life for me an increase of all good, And make death for me a comfort from all evil.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو قَطَنٍ، عَمْرُو بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ الْقُطَعِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ الْمَاجِشُونِ عَنْ قُدَامَةَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِيَ الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَاىَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (in these words): " O Allah, set right for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs. And set right for me the affairs of my world wherein is my living. And set right for me my Hereafter on which depends my after-life. And make the life for me (a source) of abundance for every good and make my death a source of comfort for me protecting me against every evil." [Muslim: 2720]

data.title: Dua for Protection and seek Allah's help
data.introduction: Narrated Abdullah bin Umar (RA): One of the supplications of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was as follows -
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma in-nee a‛oodhu bika min za-waali ni‛matik, wa tahaw-wuli ‛aafi-yatik, wa fujaa-ati niqmatik, wa jamee‛i sakha-tik
data.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from deprivation of Your blessing, alteration of Your protection, sudden infliction of Your anger, and all Your wrath.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ أَبُو زُرْعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ، عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ مِنْ دُعَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) supplicated in these words: " O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the withdrawal of Thine blessing and the change of Thine protection (from me) and from the sudden wrath of Thine, and from every displeasure of Thine." [Muslim: 2739]

data.title: Dua for Stress, Anxiety and Depression
data.introduction: Narrated Abu Huraira (RA): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to seek refuge with Allah from the difficult moment of a calamity and from being overtaken by destruction and from being destined to an evil end, and from the malicious joy of enemies.
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'A'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazani, wal'ajzi wal-kasali, wal-bukhli wal-jubni, wa dhala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal
data.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i.e. others).

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ ‏"‏ الْتَمِسْ غُلاَمًا مِنْ غِلْمَانِكُمْ يَخْدُمُنِي حَتَّى أَخْرُجَ إِلَى خَيْبَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ بِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ مُرْدِفِي، وَأَنَا غُلاَمٌ رَاهَقْتُ الْحُلُمَ، فَكُنْتُ أَخْدُمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا نَزَلَ، فَكُنْتُ أَسْمَعُهُ كَثِيرًا يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَدِمْنَا خَيْبَرَ، فَلَمَّا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْحِصْنَ ذُكِرَ لَهُ جَمَالُ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ حُيَىِّ بْنِ أَخْطَبَ، وَقَدْ قُتِلَ زَوْجُهَا وَكَانَتْ عَرُوسًا، فَاصْطَفَاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِنَفْسِهِ، فَخَرَجَ بِهَا حَتَّى بَلَغْنَا سَدَّ الصَّهْبَاءِ حَلَّتْ، فَبَنَى بِهَا، ثُمَّ صَنَعَ حَيْسًا فِي نِطَعٍ صَغِيرٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ آذِنْ مَنْ حَوْلَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ وَلِيمَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى صَفِيَّةَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ خَرَجْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَوِّي لَهَا وَرَاءَهُ بِعَبَاءَةٍ، ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ عِنْدَ بَعِيرِهِ فَيَضَعُ رُكْبَتَهُ، فَتَضَعُ صَفِيَّةُ رِجْلَهَا عَلَى رُكْبَتِهِ حَتَّى تَرْكَبَ، فَسِرْنَا حَتَّى إِذَا أَشْرَفْنَا عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ نَظَرَ إِلَى أُحُدٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ نَظَرَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحَرِّمُ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَيْهَا بِمِثْلِ مَا حَرَّمَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ مَكَّةَ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مُدِّهِمْ وَصَاعِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Abu Talha, "Choose one of your boy servants to serve me in my expedition to Khaibar." So, Abu Talha took me letting me ride behind him while I was a boy nearing the age of puberty. I used to serve Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he stopped to rest. I heard him saying repeatedly, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from distress and sorrow, from helplessness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from being heavily in debt and from being overcome by men." Then we reached Khaibar; and when Allah enabled him to conquer the Fort (of Khaibar), the beauty of Safiya bint Huyai bin Akhtab was described to him. Her husband had been killed while she was a bride. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) selected her for himself and took her along with him till we reached a place called Sa`d-AsSahba,' where her menses were over and he took her for his wife. Haris (a kind of dish) was served on a small leather sheet. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told me to call those who were around me. So, that was the marriage banquet of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Safiya. Then we left for Medina. I saw Allah's Apostle folding a cloak round the hump of the camel so as to make a wide space for Safiya (to sit on behind him) He sat beside his camel letting his knees for Safiya to put her feet on so as to mount the camel. Then, we proceeded till we approached Medina; he looked at Uhud (mountain) and said, "This is a mountain which loves us and is loved by us." Then he looked at Medina and said, "O Allah! I make the area between its (i.e. Medina's) two mountains a sanctuary as Abraham made Mecca a sanctuary. O Allah! Bless them (i.e. the people of Medina) in their Mudd and Sa (i.e. measures). [Bukhari :2893]

data.title: Dua for Reward of Freeing Slaves (Masnun dua)
data.introduction: Say ten times -
data.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
data.transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer
data.translation:
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without any partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.

Whoever says this dua ten times is like one who has freed four slaves from among the children of Ismaa'eel.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهْوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ‏.‏ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ، كَانَتْ لَهُ عَدْلَ عَشْرِ رِقَابٍ، وَكُتِبَ لَهُ مِائَةُ حَسَنَةٍ، وَمُحِيَتْ عَنْهُ مِائَةُ سَيِّئَةٍ، وَكَانَتْ لَهُ حِرْزًا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ، حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَلَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ بِأَفْضَلَ مِمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ إِلاَّ رَجُلٌ عَمِلَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said," Whoever says: "La ilaha illal-lah wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu-l-mulk wa lahul- hamd wa huwa 'ala kulli shai'in qadir," one hundred times will get the same reward as given for manumitting ten slaves; and one hundred good deeds will be written in his accounts, and one hundred sins will be deducted from his accounts, and it (his saying) will be a shield for him from Satan on that day till night, and nobody will be able to do a better deed except the one who does more than he." [Bukhari No: 6403; Muslim No: 2693]

data.title: Dua for Forgiveness of Sins
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, A person who says 100 times a day -
data.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
data.transliteration: SubhaanAllahi wa bihamdihi
data.translation:
Glorified is Allah and praised is He.

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, A person who says 100 times a day (dua mentioned above) It will be forgiven all his sins even if they were as much as the foam of the sea.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ‏.‏ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says, 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi,' one hundred times a day, will be forgiven all his sins even if they were as much as the foam of the sea. [Bukhari: 6405]

data.title: Dhikr for Forgiveness (Subhanallah Wa Bihamdihi Dua)
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Beneficent (Allah). And those are -
data.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
data.transliteration: SubhaanAllahi wa bihamdihi, Subhaanal-laahil-'Adheem
data.translation: Glory be to Allah and all praise is due to him, glory be to Allah the great.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Beneficent (Allah), and they are, 'Subhan Allah Al- `Azim and 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi.'" [Bukhari: 6406]

data.title: Powerful Dhikr Beloved to Allah (Masnun Dua)
data.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said "The dearest phrases to Allah are four. There is no harm for you in which of them begin with (while remembering Allah). And they are -
data.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
data.transliteration: SubhaanAllahi, walhamdu lillaahi, wa Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu, wa Allahu 'Akbar
data.translation:
How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest. [1]

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The uttering of (these words) is dearer to me than anything over which the sun rises. [2]

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنِ هِلاَلِ بْنِ يَسَافٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعِ بْنِ عُمَيْلَةَ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "أَحَبُّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ‏.‏ لاَ يَضُرُّكَ بَأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأْتَ.‏ وَلاَ تُسَمِّيَنَّ غُلاَمَكَ يَسَارًا وَلاَ رَبَاحًا وَلاَ نَجِيحًا وَلاَ أَفْلَحَ فَإِنَّكَ تَقُولُ أَثَمَّ هُوَ فَلاَ يَكُونُ فَيَقُولُ لاَ‏." ‏‏ إِنَّمَا هُنَّ أَرْبَعٌ فَلاَ تَزِيدُنَّ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Samura b. Jundub reported: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said "The dearest phrases to Allah are four: Subhan Allah (Hallowed be Allah), Al-Hamdulillah (Praise be to Allah), La ilaha illa-Allah (There is no deity but Allah), Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greater). There is no harm for you in which of them begin with (while remembering Allah). And do not give these names to your servants: Yasar and Rabah and Najih and Aflah. [[1] Muslim: 2137 [2] Muslim: 2695]

data.title: Benefits of Saying Subhan Allah
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Whoever says 100 times -
data.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
data.transliteration: SubhaanAllah
data.translation:
How perfect Allah is.

One thousand virtues are recorded (to your credit) and one thousand vices are blotted out.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى الْجُهَنِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى الْجُهَنِيُّ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ فَيُكْتَبُ لَهُ أَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ أَوْ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ أَلْفُ خَطِيئَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Mus'ab b. Sa'd reported that his father told him that he had been in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: Is one amongst you powerless to get one thousand virtues every day. Amongst those who had been sitting there, one asked: How one amongst us can get one thousand virtues every day? He said: Recite:" Exalted is Allah (He is free from imperfection) one hundred times for (by reciting them) one thousand virtues are recorded (to your credit) and one thousand vices are blotted out. [Muslim: 2698]

data.title: Benefits of Surah Ikhlas Daily Recitation
data.introduction: Surah Ikhlas 10 Times:
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّـهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللَّـهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾
data.transliteration: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem. (1) Qul HuwAllahu 'Ahad. (2) Allahus-Samad. (3) Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. (4) Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan 'ahad
data.translation:
In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. (1) Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, (2) Allah, the Eternal Refuge. (3) He neither begets nor is born, (4) Nor is there to Him any equivalent." (Sura Ikhlas: 1-4)

In a saheeh hadeeth, Mu'adh ibn Anas (RA) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Whoever recites Surah Ikhlas 10 times, Allah will make a house for him in Paradise.

benefits.title: Benefits of Surah Ikhlas Daily Recitation
benefits.description: Surah Ikhlas brings huge reward and makes Iman strong, as this short surah is equal to one third of the Quran and fills the heart with love for Allah every day.
points: Surah Ikhlas in Arabic gives reward like reading one third of Quran.
Qul Huwallahu Ahad brings Allah’s mercy and keeps the heart clean from shirk.
Reciting Surah Ikhlas benefits a muslim by making Amal easy and full of Barakah.
Surah Ikhlas ki fazilat protects from evil and brings peace in daily namaz.
Allahus Samad in surah al ikhlas reminds muslims of Allah’s oneness and power.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Surah Ikhlas
when_to_recite.description: Surah Ikhlas is a short surah with big reward, bringing Barakah and strong Iman, and it is loved by Allah when recited daily for protection, blessings, and forgiveness.
points: After every fard salah, recite surah ikhlas for extra reward and Allah’s mercy.
In morning and evening azkar, add surah ikhlas for daily protection and Barakah.
Before going to bed, read surah al ikhlas for safety and peace through the night.
When feeling weak in Iman, recite qul huwallahu ahad to make your heart strong.
While making dua, include surah ikhlas for more blessings and acceptance from Allah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Surah Ikhlas Daily Recitation
how_to_perform.description: Reciting Surah Ikhlas every day brings Barakah and keeps your Iman strong. This surah is short but holds big rewards, and it is easy for every Muslim to read and remember in their daily Amal.

Before going to bed, recite surah al ikhlas three times for Allah’s protection.
When you feel scared or alone, softly say qul huwallahu ahad to find peace in your heart.
After every namaz, add surah ikhlas in your zikr allah to get more blessings in your day.
Teach your kids surah ikhlas in Arabic and Surah Ikhlas translation so they learn its meaning.

data.title: Daily dua for planting a tree in Jannah
data.introduction: Whoever says -
data.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
data.transliteration: SubhaanAllahil-'Adheem wa bihamdihi
data.translation:
How perfect Allah is, The Supreme, and I praise Him.

A palm tree will be planted in Paradise for him.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، وَغَيْرُ، وَاحِدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ الصَّوَّافِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏.‏ غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Jabir narrated that: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Whoever says: ‘Glory is to Allah, the Magnificent, and with His Praise (Subḥān Allāhil-Aẓīm, wa biḥamdih)’ a date-palm tree is planted for him in Paradise.” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3464]

benefits.title: Benefits of Daily Dua for Planting a Tree in Jannah
benefits.description: This dua for Jannah helps a Muslim earn trees in Paradise and brings Allah’s praise and mercy closer, making every day full of hope and reward for the hereafter.
points: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi subhanallahil azeem plants a tree in Jannah.
Jannat dua brings Barakah in Amal and keeps the heart soft with Allah’s zikr.
Subhanallahil azeem wa bihamdihi gives reward and wipes away small sins.
Daily dhikr with this masnun dua makes the path to Jannah easy for muslims.
Sincere use of this dua for success brings Allah’s help in both dunya and akhirah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Jannah
when_to_recite.description: This dua for jannah is a daily dhikr that plants a tree in Jannah, brings Barakah to your Amal, and fills your heart with hope for Allah’s mercy and reward in the next life.
points: After finishing salah, recite subhanallahi wa bihamdihi subhanallahil azeem for Jannah.
In free time, keep your tongue busy with this dua for jannah to earn reward.
While walking or working, say subhanallahil azeem wa bihamdihi for daily Barakah.
Before going to bed, end your day with this jannat dua for forgiveness and success.
When feeling sad, use this dua for jannah to fill your heart with hope and Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Planting a Tree in Jannah
how_to_perform.description: This dua for Jannah is easy to say and brings you closer to Allah’s mercy. Recite it daily to plant trees in Jannah and fill your book of Amal with good deeds and Barakah.
steps: Begin your morning by saying subhanallahi wa bihamdihi subhanallahil azeem softly.
After every salah, repeat this dua for jannah to grow your rewards in the hereafter.
While doing daily work, let your lips move with subhanallahil azeem wa bihamdihi.
Teach your family the meaning of subhanallahi wa bihamdihi subhanallahil azeem in urdu.
Before going to bed, quietly say this muslim prayer to end your day with zikr allah.

data.title: Dua for Jannah (Lahaula Walaquwata)
data.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
data.transliteration: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata 'illaa billaah
data.translation:
There is no might nor power except with Allah.

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, “O 'Abdullah ibn Qays! Shall I not inform you of one of the treasures of Paradise? ” I said, "Surely, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Say it." - (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَكُنَّا إِذَا عَلَوْنَا كَبَّرْنَا فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ارْبَعُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ، فَإِنَّكُمْ لاَ تَدْعُونَ أَصَمَّ وَلاَ غَائِبًا، وَلَكِنْ تَدْعُونَ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَتَى عَلَىَّ وَأَنَا أَقُولُ فِي نَفْسِي لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ قُلْ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا‏.‏ كَنْزٌ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ كَنْزٌ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Musa: We were in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey, and whenever we ascended a high place, we used to say Takbir (in a loud voice). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people! Be kind to yourselves, for you are not calling upon a deaf or an absent one, but You are calling an All-Hearer, and an All-Seer." Then he came to me as I was reciting silently, "La haul a wala quwwata illa bil-lah." He said, "O `Abdullah bin Qais! Say: La haul a walaquwata illa bil-lah, for it is one of the treasures of Paradise." Or he said, "Shall I tell you a word which is one of the treasures of Paradise? It is: La haul a wala quwwata illa bil-lah." [Bukhari: 6384]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Jannah (Lahaula Walaquwata)
benefits.description: This jannat dua reminds every Muslim that all strength comes from Allah alone, bringing hope, reward, and help in every hard time for those who trust in His power.
points: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah in arabic opens doors to Jannah for muslims.
This powerful dua brings Allah’s help in tough times and keeps Iman strong.
Lahaula walaquwata makes sins easy to leave and Amal easy to do for Allah.
Jannat dua gives peace in the heart and keeps a muslim safe from pride.
La hawla wala quwwata illa billah ki fazilat brings reward in both dunya and akhirah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Jannat Dua (Lahaula Walaquwata)
when_to_recite.description: This jannat dua reminds us that all power and help comes from Allah, bringing Barakah, strength, and hope for Jannah when recited in times of need and daily life.
points: After salah, repeat la hawla wala quwwata illa billah for reward and Jannah.
When facing hard times, use this powerful dua to seek Allah’s help and strength.
In your daily zikr, add la hawla wala quwwata illa billah for Barakah and Iman.
While feeling weak or tired, say this jannat dua to remember Allah’s power.
Before going to bed, end your day with la hawla wala quwwata illa billah for peace.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Jannat Dua (Lahaula Walaquwata)
how_to_perform.description: Reciting this jannat dua reminds you that all power comes from Allah alone. It is a simple but powerful dua for jannah that brings Barakah and helps you stay strong in your Iman every day.
steps: Start your day by saying la hawla wala quwwata illa billah in arabic with full heart.
When you feel weak or tired, softly repeat this powerful dua to seek Allah’s help.
After every namaz, add la hawla wala quwwata illa billah to your zikr allah for more reward.
Teach your kids the meaning of la hawla wala quwwata illa billah in urdu so they learn this muslim prayer.
While facing any hard time, quietly say lahaula walaquwata to keep your trust in Allah.

data.title: Dua of all praise for Allah (Masnoon Dua)
data.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
data.transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, Allahu 'Akbar kabeeran, walhamdu lillaahi katheeran, SubhaanAllahi Rabbil-'aalameen, laa hawla wa laa quwwata 'illaa biilaahil-'Azeezil-Hakeem
data.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without any partener. Allah is most great and much praise is for Allah. How perfect Allah is, Lord of the worlds. There is no might nor power except with Allah, The Exalted in might, The Wise.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua Praising Allah (Masnoon Dua)
benefits.description: This dua praising Allah brings a muslim closer to Him, filling the heart with thankfulness and reminding us of Allah’s greatness, mercy, and power in every part of daily life.
points: Allah’s help comes to the one who says la ilaha illalahu with full Iman.
The words allahu akbar and alhamdulillah bring Barakah and peace in Amal.
Subhanallah meaning reminds muslims to keep hearts clean from bad things.
La hawla wala quwwata illa billah meaning gives strength in hard times.
Masnoon dua like this keeps a muslim’s zikr allah strong in every Salah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Praising Allah
when_to_recite.description: This dua praising Allah is a masnoon dua that fills your heart with Iman and Barakah, reminding you of Allah’s greatness and mercy in every moment, bringing peace and reward to your daily Amal.
points: After finishing salah, use this dua praising Allah to thank Him for His blessings.
While walking on the road, remember Allah with la ilaha illalahu and feel His nearness.
In times of hardship, recite la hawla wala quwwata illa billah for strength and help.
When you see something amazing, say subhanallah meaning Allah is perfect in all ways.
During morning and evening azkar, repeat this masnoon dua for daily Barakah and protection.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua of all praise for Allah
how_to_perform.description: This dua praising Allah is a masnoon dua that brings Barakah and peace to your heart. Reciting these words like la ilaha illalahu, allahu akbar, alhamdulillah, and subhanallah helps you remember Allah’s greatness and thank Him for His blessings every day.
steps: Start your day by reciting this dua praising allah after Fajr salah to fill your heart with Iman.
When you feel happy or get any good news, say allahu akbar and alhamdulillah in arabic.
During your walks on road or while sitting alone, softly repeat subhanallah meaning and la hawla wala quwwata illa billah meaning.
Before going to bed, recite this masnoon dua to thank Allah for all His gifts and mercy.
After finishing your namaz, use this islamic dua to keep your zikr allah strong and your Amal pure.

data.title: Dua after Accepting Islam (Masnun Dua)
data.introduction: Whenever a person embraced Islam, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) instructed him to recilte -
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
data.transliteration: Allaahummaghfir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, wa 'aafinee warzuqnee
data.translation:
O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me and grant me sustenance.

Another narration of Muslim says, "These will combine everything in this world and the Hereafter for you."

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيُّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Malik Ashaja'i reported on the authority of his father that whenever a person embraced Islam, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) instructed him to recilte: " O Allah, grant me pardon, have mercy upon me, direct me to the path of righteousness and provide me sustenance." [Muslim: 2697]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua after Accepting Islam
benefits.description: This dua after accepting Islam helps a new muslim ask Allah for forgiveness, mercy, guidance, safety, and rizq, making the start of their Iman journey full of hope and Barakah.
points: Allahummaghfirli warhamni brings Allah’s forgiveness and covers old sins.
Hidayat ki dua helps a muslim stay on the right path with strong Iman.
Rizq ki dua in this masnoon dua opens doors for halal food and daily needs.
Allah’s mercy and safety come to the one who makes this dua after salah.
Powerful dua for everything keeps a muslim’s heart close to Allah always.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Accepting Islam
when_to_recite.description: This dua after accepting Islam is a masnoon dua asking Allah for forgiveness, mercy, guidance, safety, and rizq, making your Iman strong and your Amal full of Barakah in every step of your new Muslim life.
points: Right after accepting Islam, recite this dua after accepting islam for Allah’s mercy.
During sujood in salah, ask Allah with allahummaghfirli warhamni wahdini warzuqni.
After every salah, make this dua for forgiveness and rizq to keep your heart clean.
When feeling lost, use this hidayat ki dua to seek guidance and Barakah from Allah.
In times of need, repeat this powerful dua for everything and trust Allah’s plan.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after accepting Islam
how_to_perform.description: This dua after accepting Islam is a masnoon dua that asks Allah for forgiveness, mercy, guidance, safety, and rizq. It is a simple and powerful islamic dua every new Muslim and believer should use daily to keep their Iman and Amal strong.

When you finish your salah, quietly say this dua for forgiveness from Allah and ask for Barakah.
If you feel lost or need help, use this dua for guidance and rizq ki dua in your own words.
Before going to bed, repeat this masnoon dua to seek Allah’s mercy and maghfirat ki dua.
During sujood in namaz, whisper this sujood dua to ask for safety and daily rizq from Allah.

data.title: Most Powerful Dhikr and Dua in Islam
data.introduction: The greatest Dua
data.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
data.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaah
data.translation: All praise is for Allah.

benefits.title: Benefits of Powerful Dua and Dhikr (Alhamdulillah)
benefits.description: Saying Alhamdulillah fills the heart with shukr, brings peace, and keeps a muslim close to Allah, making every moment full of Barakah and hope in daily life.
points: Alhamdulillah meaning teaches a muslim to thank Allah in every Amal.
This powerful dua and dhikr brings Allah’s mercy and removes sadness.
Zikr allah with Alhamdulillah keeps Iman strong in all times of life.
Saying Alhamdulillah for everything brings more rizq and good in the home.
Best dua for everything helps muslims remember Allah after every Salah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Powerful Dua and Dhikr
when_to_recite.description: This powerful dua and dhikr, Alhamdulillah, fills your heart with shukar and brings Barakah in every moment, reminding you to thank Allah for all things, big or small, and making your Iman strong every day.
points: After finishing any meal, say Alhamdulillah to thank Allah for His rizq and blessings.

how_to_perform.description: Saying Alhamdulillah is the most powerful dua and dhikr in Islam, filling your heart with shukar and bringing you closer to Allah. This simple word, Alhamdulillah, means all praise is for Allah and should be used daily by every Muslim.
steps: After every namaz, softly say Alhamdulillah in Arabic to thank Allah for His gifts.
When you eat or drink, remember to say Alhamdulillah for everything you have.
If you feel happy or safe, use this powerful dua and dhikr to show your shukar Alhamdulillah.
While sitting with family or friends, quietly repeat Alhamdulillah meaning in your heart.
Before going to bed, end your day with this best dhikr allah to keep your Iman strong.

data.title: Powerful Dhikr That Lasts Forever in Jannah
data.introduction: Eternal good deeds are -
data.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
data.transliteration: SubhaanAllah, walhamdu lillaah, wa Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllah, wa Allahu 'Akbar, Laa hawla wa laa quwwata 'illaa billaah
data.translation: How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest. There is no might nor power except with Allah.
data.reference: Musnad-e Ahmad (no. 513) (Ahmad Shakir, ed.) and its chain of narration is authentic. See Majma'uz-Zawa'id 1/297. Ibn Hajar mentions it in Bulughul-Maram saying that Ibn Hibban and Al-Hakim considered it authentic.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dhikr and Dua That Lasts Forever in Jannah

La ilaha illallah in this dhikr and dua brings forgiveness for many old sins.
Alhamdulillah meaning fills the home with shukr and Allah’s blessings.
Allahu Akbar meaning gives courage and hope in every hard time of life.
La hawla wala quwwata illa billah meaning brings help from Allah in all Amal.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dhikr and Dua
when_to_recite.description: This dhikr and dua brings endless Barakah and reward, filling your heart with Iman and shukar, and making your tongue busy with the best zikr allah that lasts forever in Jannah and every day in this world.
points: After salah, fill your time with dhikr and dua by saying subhanallahi walhamdulillahi wala ilaha illallah wallahu akbar.
While walking alone, remember Allah with la ilaha illallah and feel His nearness.
In times of worry, repeat la hawla wala quwwata illa billah for strength and peace.

When you see something beautiful, say subhanallah meaning Allah is perfect in all ways.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dhikr and Dua That Lasts Forever in Jannah
how_to_perform.description: This dhikr and dua is called the best dhikr, and it brings endless Barakah in this life and Jannah. steps: After every salah, recite subhanallah in arabic, alhamdulillah in arabic, and allahu akbar in arabic.
When you feel weak or tired, softly say la hawla wala quwwata illa billah meaning.
