When feeling tired at night, remember to recite this sleeping dua and ask my Lord to forgive me Allah.
After finishing your night zikr Allah, whisper the dua before sleeping for Allah forgive me.
If you wake up in the middle of the night, quietly say Astaghfirullah al azeem and repeat the dua for sleep.
When teaching kids about Islamic prayers, help them learn this dua for the night and say Bismillah ir rahman ir rahim.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua to Sleep
how_to_perform.description: This dua to sleep is a simple way to ask Allah for forgiveness and peace before you rest. It is a masnoon dua that brings Barakah and helps you sleep with a clean heart every night.
steps: Lay down on your bed and softly say Bismika Rabbi with full trust in your Lord.
Recite the dua to sleep in Arabic, thinking about forgiveness and saying Astaghfirullah.
Ask Allah to forgive your sins and give you a peaceful night as you close your eyes.
After saying this night dua, try to sleep with a heart full of hope in Allah’s mercy.
Make this prayer before sleeping a daily habit to get Barakah and Allah’s forgiveness.

data.title: Sleeping Dua
data.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْوِيَ
data.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee 'at'amanaa wa saqaanaa, wa kafaanaa, wa 'aawaanaa, fakam mimman laa kaafiya lahu wa laa mu'wiya
data.translation:
All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.

Anas (RA) said, Rasulullah (ﷺ) used to say this dua when he was lying in bed.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُئْوِيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When you go to bed, say: " Praise is due to Allah Who fed us, provided us drink, sufficed us and provided us with shelter, for many a people there is none to suffice and none to provide shelter." Sahih Muslim 2715 [Muslim 4/2085 no. 2715]

benefits.title: Benefits of Sleeping Dua
benefits.description: This sleeping dua reminds us to thank Allah for food, water, shelter, and His care, filling our hearts with Alhamdulillah before sleep and teaching us to trust Allah’s mercy every night.
points: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.
Saying Alhamdulillah for everything brings night barakah and peace to the heart.
This masnoon dua helps Muslims remember Allah’s blessings before sleeping.
Reciting the sleeping dua teaches gratitude and trust in Allah’s care every night.
It is a way to thank Allah for food, drink, and shelter, which many people do not have.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Sleeping Dua
when_to_recite.description: This sleeping dua is best recited before going to bed to thank Allah for His blessings and mercy.
points: Before going to bed, remember to recite the sleeping dua and say Alhamdulillah for everything.
After your last meal at night, whisper this dua for sleep and thank Allahu Akbar for His blessings.
When feeling safe in your home, use the night dua and praise be to Allah for shelter and care.
If you wake up in the night, quietly say Alhamdulillah rabbil alamin and repeat the prayer before sleeping.
While teaching children about Islamic prayers, help them learn this dua before sleeping and say Syukur Alhamdulillah.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Sleeping Dua
how_to_perform.description: This sleeping dua is a beautiful way to thank Allah for His care and blessings before going to bed. Reciting it helps you remember Allah’s mercy and feel safe as you rest for the night.
steps: Make wudu if possible, then sit on your bed and say the sleeping dua with Iman.
Recite All praise is due to Allah and thank Him for food, drink, and shelter.
Say Alhamdulillah for everything you have, and trust Allah will protect you at night.
Repeat this dua before sleeping to keep your heart full of shukr and get Barakah.
After finishing the prayer before sleeping, close your eyes and sleep with peace.

data.title: Duas Before Sleeping
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيْكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِيْ وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَ شِرْكِهِ وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِيْ سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma 'Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadati faatiras-samaawaati wal'ardh, Rabba kulli shay 'in wa maleekahu, 'ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta, 'a'oodhu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa shirkihi, wa 'an 'aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee soo 'an, 'aw 'ajurrahu 'ilaa Muslim
data.translation:
O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.

The Prophet (ﷺ) taught this dua to be recited in the morning, evening and after bed.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ عَاصِمٍ الثَّقَفِيَّ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مُرْنِي بِشَيْءٍ أَقُولُهُ إِذَا أَصْبَحْتُ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ قَالَ قُلْهُ إِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتَ وَإِذَا أَخَذْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with him, said: “Abu Bakr said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, command me with something that I may say when I reach morning and evening.’ He said: ‘Say: “O Allah Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Possessor, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except You, I seek refuge from You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Shaitan and his Shirk (Allāhumma `ālimal-ghaibi wash-shahādati fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ, rabba kulli shai’in wa malīkahu, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā anta, a`ūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wa min sharrish-shaiṭāni washirkihi).’” He said: ‘Say it when you reach morning, and evening, and when you go to bed.’” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3392]

benefits.title: Benefits of Duas Before Sleeping
benefits.description: These duas before sleeping help protect your Iman and heart from harm, reminding you to trust Allah, seek His help, and keep away from shaytan’s tricks every night before you rest.
points: O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things.
La ilaha illa anta brings safety and peace before sleeping.
Seeking refuge in Allah protects from the evil of the soul and shaytan.
Reciting this dua helps avoid harm to oneself and other Muslims.
This masnoon dua brings night barakah and keeps the heart clean.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Duas Before Sleeping
when_to_recite.description: These duas before sleeping are best recited before going to bed to seek Allah’s protection and peace.
points: Before going to bed, recite the duas before sleeping and say La ilaha illa anta for safety.
After your last prayer at night, whisper this dua before sleeping and ask O Allah for protection.
When feeling scared or worried, use the night dua and call Ya Allah to keep shaytan away.
If you wake up from a bad dream, quietly say Allahuma and repeat the dua for sleep for peace.
While teaching kids about Islamic prayers, help them learn this dua for the night and say Subhanallah.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Duas Before Sleeping
how_to_perform.description: Reciting duas before sleeping brings peace to your heart and keeps you safe from harm. These Islamic duas help you remember Allah’s power and mercy as you end your day and rest at night.
steps: Sit on your bed, think of Allah’s greatness, and start with Bismillah before the dua.
Say O Allah, La ilaha illa anta, and ask for safety from your own mistakes and shaytan.
Recite this dua before sleeping to protect yourself and other Muslims from harm.
After reading the night dua, trust Allahu Akbar will keep you safe till morning.
End with Alhamdulillah and close your eyes, feeling peace from this Muslim prayer.

data.title: Duas Before Sleep
data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
data.transliteration: A‛oodhu bikalima-tillahit taamma-tillati la-yujawizuhunna barrun wala-fa-jirun, min sharri ma- khalaqa wa bara-aa wa dhara-aa, wa min sharri ma yanzilu minas sama-yi wa min Sharhri Ma Ya’ruju fi-haa, Wa Min sharri maa dhara-a fil ardhi,Wa Min sharri Ma Ya'khruju Minhha-, Wa Min sharri Fitanillali Wan Naha-ri, Wa Min sharri Kulli Ta-Riqin Illa- Tariqan Yatruqu Bikhairin Ya-Rahmaan
data.translation:
I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which no virtuous person or sinner can overcome, from the evil of what He has created, created and spread, from the evil of that which descends from heaven, from the evil of that which ascends to heaven. From the evil of whatever is scattered in the earth, from the evil of whatever comes out of the earth, from the evil of the fitnah of night and day, and from the evil of all strangers, except the one who comes with goodness, O Most Merciful.

Abdur Rahman Ibn Khanbash (RA) said, "One night the devil jinn came forward to attack the Prophet (ﷺ) in the desert with fire. Then Jibriel (As) came and taught him this dua. As soon as the dua is recited, the fire of the devils is extinguished and they flee.”

benefits.title: Benefits of Duas Before Sleep
benefits.description: These duas before sleep help you ask Allah the most merciful for safety from harm, fitnah, and all evil, filling your heart with peace and trust in Ar Rahman every night before you rest.
points: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which no virtuous person or sinner can overcome.
This dua protects from the evil of what Allah has created and from the fitnah of night and day.
Reciting this dua brings peace and safety from harm and evil.
Ya Rahman brings barakah and keeps the heart safe every night.
This masnoon dua is a strong shield for every Muslim before sleep.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Duas Before Sleep
when_to_recite.description: These duas before sleep are best recited before going to bed to seek Allah’s protection from harm and fitnah.
points: Before going to bed, recite the duas before sleep and say I seek refuge in Allah for protection.
After your last zikr allah at night, whisper this dua before sleeping and call Ya Rahman Ya Rahim.
When feeling scared of the night, use the night dua and remember Allah the most merciful for safety.
If you hear strange sounds at night, quietly say Audhubillah and repeat the prayer before going to sleep.
While teaching children about Islamic prayers, help them learn this dua for the night and mention Surah Ar Rahman.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Duas Before Sleep
how_to_perform.description: Reciting duas before sleep is a way to ask Allah the most merciful for safety from harm and evil. This night dua helps you feel safe and brings peace to your heart before you rest.
steps: Sit or lay on your bed, then start with Bismillahir rahmanir rahim and focus on Allah.
Say I seek refuge in Allah using this dua before sleeping to keep away all evil things.
Recite the full duas before sleep, asking Ar Rahman to protect you from fitnah of night and day.
After finishing, trust that Allahu Akbar will keep you safe from harm till morning comes.
End with Subhanallah and close your eyes, feeling peace from this Muslim prayer.

data.title: Duas Before Bed
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِى اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِيْ وَأَخْسِئْ شَيْطَانِيْ وَفُكَّ رِهَانِيْ وَاجْعَلْنِيْ فِي النَّدِىِّ الْأَعْلَى
data.transliteration: Bismillaahi wada‘tu janbi, Allahum-maghfir li dhanbi wa akhsi’ shaytaani wa fukka rihaani waj‘alni fi’n-nadiyyi al-a‘laa
data.translation:
In the name of Allah, I have laid down my side for Allah. O Allah! forgive my sin, drive away my devil, free me from my responsibility, and place me in the highest assembly.

Abul Azhar Anmari (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say these words when he was lying in bed at night.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُسَافِرٍ التِّنِّيسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ ثَوْرٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَزْهَرِ الأَنْمَارِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي وَأَخْسِئْ شَيْطَانِي وَفُكَّ رِهَانِي وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي النَّدِيِّ الأَعْلَى ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ رَوَاهُ أَبُو هَمَّامٍ الأَهْوَازِيُّ عَنْ ثَوْرٍ قَالَ أَبُو زُهَيْرٍ الأَنْمَارِيُّ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated AbulAzhar al-Anmari: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to his bed at night, he would say: in the name of Allah, I have laid down my side for Allah. O Allah! forgive me my sin, drive away my devil, free me from my responsibility, and place me in the highest assembly. Abu Dawud said: Abu Hammam al-Ahwazi transmitted it from Thawr. He mentioned Abu Zuhair al-Anmari (instead of Abu al-Azhar). [Sahih (Albani). Sunan Abu Dawud: 5054]

benefits.title: Benefits of Duas Before Bed
benefits.description: These duas before bed help you ask Allah for forgiveness, Barakah, and safety from shaytan, making your heart calm and your Iman strong before you sleep every night.
points: Bismillah and Allahumma bring peace and forgiveness before sleep.
This dua asks Allah to forgive sins and keep shaytan away from your night.
Reciting the dua before bed frees you from burden and brings hope.
Night dua brings barakah and helps you sleep with a clean heart.
This masnoon dua is a Sunnah and brings Iman closer to Allah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Duas Before Bed
when_to_recite.description: These duas before bed are best recited before laying down to sleep, asking Allah for forgiveness and protection.
points: Before laying down, recite the duas before bed and say bismillah for a peaceful sleep.
After your last Muslim prayer before sleep, whisper this sleeping dua and ask Allahumma for forgiveness.
When feeling heavy with worries, use the dua before sleeping and pray Allah frees you from burden.
If you wake up in the night, quietly say dua for sleeping and ask Allah to protect you from shaytan.
While teaching kids about Islamic prayers, help them learn this dua before bed and say dua for the night.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Duas Before Bed
how_to_perform.description: Saying duas before bed helps you sleep with a clean heart and trust in Allah’s mercy. This Muslim prayer before sleep brings forgiveness, safety, and hope for a good night.
steps: Lie down on your bed, say Bismillah, and get ready to read the duas before bed.
Ask Allahumma to forgive your sins and keep shaytan away from your sleep tonight.
Recite the dua before sleeping, asking Allah to free you from any burden or worry.
Pray to be placed in the highest assembly, hoping for Allah’s mercy and Barakah.
End your night dua with peace in your heart, trusting Allah will protect you till morning.

data.title: Dua Before Bed
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you want to go to your bed, then perform ablution, lie on your right side and then supplicate:
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيْ إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma 'aslamtu nafsee 'ilayka, wa fawwadhtu 'amree 'ilayka, wa wajjahtu wajhee 'ilayka, wa 'alja'tu dhahree 'ilayka, raghbatan wa rahbatan 'ilayka, laa maalja' wa laa manjaa minka 'illaa 'ilayka, 'aamantu bikitaabikal-ladhee 'anzalta wa bi-nabiyyikal-ladhee 'arsalta
data.translation:
O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, and I entrust my affair unto You, and I turn my face towards You, and I totally rely on You, in hope and fear of You. Verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.

The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the person to whom he taught this Dua: If you die that night, you die on Fitrat, the religion of Islam.
data.reference: Al-Bukhari, Fathul Bari 11/113 no. 6313, Muslim 4/2081 no. 2710

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُثْمَانَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي الْبَرَاءُ بْنُ عَازِبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَخَذْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ فَتَوَضَّأْ وُضُوءَكَ لِلصَّلاَةِ ثُمَّ اضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّكَ الأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ وَاجْعَلْهُنَّ مِنْ آخِرِ كَلاَمِكَ فَإِنْ مُتَّ مِنْ لَيْلَتِكَ مُتَّ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَدَّدْتُهُنَّ لأَسْتَذْكِرَهُنَّ فَقُلْتُ آمَنْتُ بِرَسُولِكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُلْ آمَنْتُ بِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that Allah's, Messenger (may peace be upon said: When you go to bed, perform ablution as is done for prayer; then lie down pn the right side and recite: " O Allah, I turn my face towards Thee and entrust my affair to Thee. I retreat unto Thee for protection with hope in Thee and fear of Thee. There is no resort and no deliverer (from hardship) but Thou only. I affirm my faith in Thine books which Thou revealed and in Thine Apostles whom Thou sent." Make this as the last word of yours (when you go to sleep) and in case you die during that night, you would die upon Fitra (upon Islam). And as I repeated these words in order to commit them to memory, I said: " I affirm my faith in Thy Messenger (Rasul) whom Thou sent." He said: Say: " I affirm my faith in the Apostle (Nabi) whom Thou sent." Sahih Muslim 2710a [Al-Bukhari, Fathul Bari 11/113 no. 6313, Muslim 4/2081 no. 2710]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua Before Bed
benefits.description: This dua before bed is a strong shield for your heart and mind, helping you trust Allah, find peace, and ask for protection as you rest, following the Sunnah and building Iman every night.
points: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilaika teaches full trust in Allah before sleep.
This dua helps you submit your soul and worries to Allah at night.
Reciting the dua before bed brings peace, protection, and Barakah.
It is a masnoon dua that builds Iman and hope for Allah’s mercy.
This night time dua reminds Muslims that only Allah can save and protect.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Before Bed
when_to_recite.description: This dua before bed is best recited before going to sleep to seek Allah’s protection and peace.
points: Before going to bed, recite the dua before bed to seek Allah’s protection and peace.
After finishing your night time dua, use this dua before sleeping in Arabic for Barakah.
When feeling scared at night, read the dua for protection from dajjal and jahannam.
If you have worries about debt, make dua for debt and karz se nijat ki dua before sleep.
After your last salah, remember to say this Islamic dua for the night for a calm heart.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua Before Bed
how_to_perform.description: This dua before bed helps you give your worries to Allah and sleep with Iman and peace. It is a strong Muslim prayer that brings comfort and trust in Allah’s care every night.
steps: Lie down, face the qiblah if you can, and start your dua before bed with Allahumma.
Say the dua before sleeping in Arabic, giving your soul and worries to Allah.
Recite with hope and fear, believing there is no safe place except with Allah’s help.
Mention your Iman in the Book and the Prophet, making your heart strong before sleep.
End your night time dua feeling safe, knowing Allah’s mercy will protect you till morning.

data.title: Going Around with the Intention of Pray Qiyam (Hadith)
data.introduction: One has to get up at night and go to sleep with a strong desire to perform tahajjud; It has been said in various hadiths that the reward of tahajjud will be obtained even if one does not wake up at night. It was narrated from Abu Ad-Darda' (RA) who attributed it to the Prophet (ﷺ): "Whoever goes to his bed intending to get up and pray qiyam at night, then sleep overwhelms him until morning, will have recorded that which he intended for and his sleep will be a charity given to him by his Lord."

data.title: Dua When Turning Over During the Night
data.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
data.transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahul-Waahidul-Qahhaar, Rabbus-samaawaati wal'ardh, wa maa baynahumal-'Azeezul-Ghaffaar
data.translation:
There is none worthy of worship but Allah, the One, the Victorious, Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty, the All-Forgiving.

Aaishah (RA) narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say at night if he turned during sleep: (the dua is mentioned above)
data.reference: Sahih by Hakim. Imam Dhahabi 1/540; Nasai, Amalul Yaomi Wallayla No. 202, Ibnus sunni No. 757. Also see, Sahih Jame 4:213

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua When Turning Over During the Night
benefits.description: This dua when turning over during the night helps you remember Allah’s greatness, brings Barakah to your sleep, and keeps your heart close to Iman even in the quietest hours.
points: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, the One, the Victorious, Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty, the All-Forgiving.
Reciting this dua brings Barakah and Iman even while turning in bed.
This masnoon dua helps keep the heart close to Allah at night.
It is a simple zikr Allah that brings peace and comfort during the night.
Saying this dua reminds Muslims of Allah’s power and mercy every moment.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua When Turning Over During the Night
when_to_recite.description: This dua is best recited whenever you turn over or wake up during the night to remember Allah and seek His Barakah.
points: When you turn over in bed at night, recite this dua for good sleep and protection.
If you wake up suddenly, remember to say this sleeping dua in English for peace.
While feeling restless at night, use the dua for the night to calm your heart and mind.
After a bad dream, read this dua for protection and zikr Allah before sleeping again.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua When Turning Over During the Night
how_to_perform.description: This dua of the night is a simple way to remember Allah when you wake up or turn over in bed. It brings Barakah and helps keep your Iman strong even in the quiet hours, making your heart feel close to Allah.
steps: When you wake up or turn over in bed at night, softly recite this dua of the night.
If you feel scared or alone, say this dua for comfort and ask Allah for His mercy.
After saying the dua, try to remember Allah’s power and His forgiveness in your heart.
If you forget the words, use the transliteration to help you say the dua with Iman.
Before going back to sleep, trust Allah with your worries and hope for His Barakah.

data.title: Dua for Waking Up
data.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
data.transliteration: Laa 'illaaha 'illAllahu wa’hdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer Subhaanallahi, walhamdu lillaahi, wa laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu, wAllahu 'akbar, wa laa ‘hawla wa laa Quwwata 'illaa billaahil-'Aliyyil-'Adheem, Rabbighfir lee
data.translation:
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without any partner, to Him belong sovereignty and praise and He is over all things wholly capable. How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with Allah, The Most High, The Supreme, O my Lord forgive me.

‘Ubadah bin al-Samit (RA) reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying, “If anyone is alarmed while asleep and he says when awakes and he prays, his prayer will be answered. If he gets up, performs ablution, and prays, his prayer will be accepted.”

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، قَالَ قَالَ الأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَيْرُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جُنَادَةُ بْنُ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ تَعَارَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ حِينَ يَسْتَيْقِظُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ثُمَّ دَعَا رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ دَعَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ فَإِنْ قَامَ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى قُبِلَتْ صَلاَتُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ‘
hadith.translation: Ubadah b. al-Samit reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying; If anyone is alarmed while asleep and he says when awakes : there is no god but Allah alone Who has no partner, to whom dominion belongs, to whom praise is due, and who has power over everything (omnipotent). Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah, and there is no god but Allah, and then he prays: O my Lord, forgive me. Abu Dawud said : Al-Walid’s version has; and he prays, his prayer will be answered. If he gets up, performs ablution, and prays, his prayer will be accepted. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 5060]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Waking Up
benefits.description: This dua for waking up fills your morning with Barakah, brings you closer to Allah, and helps you start your day with Iman, forgiveness, and the zikr of Allah on your tongue.

Before leaving your room, remember to say subhanallah walhamdulillah wala ilaha illallah wallahu akbar.

If you feel weak in the morning, repeat la hawla wala quwwata illa billah for strength and help.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua for Waking Up
how_to_perform.description: This dua for waking up is a beautiful way to start your day with the zikr of Allah. It brings Barakah, fills your heart with Iman, and reminds you of Allah’s power and mercy every morning.

data.title: Dua on Waking Up
data.introduction: Waking up and performing ablution and reciting the last ten verses of Surah Ali-Imran:
data.arabic: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لِّأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ ﴿١٩٠﴾ الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ ﴿١٩١﴾ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ ﴿١٩٢﴾ رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا ۚ رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ ﴿١٩٣﴾ رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ ﴿١٩٤﴾ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لَا أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ ۖ بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ ۖ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا وَأُخْرِجُوا مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُوا فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُوا وَقُتِلُوا لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ثَوَابًا مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ ﴿١٩٥﴾ لَا يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ ﴿١٩٦﴾ مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۚ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ ﴿١٩٧﴾ لَٰكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلًا مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلْأَبْرَارِ ﴿١٩٨﴾ وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لَا يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۗ أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ ﴿١٩٩﴾ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ﴿٢٠٠﴾
data.transliteration: Inna fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ardi wakhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari la-aayaatil-li-ulil-albaab. Allazeena yazkuroonallaaha qiyaaman wa qu'oodan wa 'alaa junoobihim wa yatafakkaroona fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ardi Rabbanaa maa khalaqta haazaa baatilan Subhaanaka faqinaa 'azaaban-Naar. Rabbanaa innaka man tudkhilin-Naara faqad akhzaitahoo wa maa lizzaalimeena min ansaar. Rabbanaa innanaa sami'naa munaadiyan yunaadee lil-eemaani an aaminoo bi-Rabbikum fa-aamannaa; Rabbanaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wa kaffir 'annaa sayyi-aatinaa wa tawaffanaa ma'al-abraar. Rabbanaa wa aatinaa maa wa'adtanaa 'alaa rusulika wa laa tukhzinaa Yawmal-Qiyaamah; innaka laa tukhliful-mee'aad. Fastajaaba lahum Rabbuhum annee laaa udee'u 'amala 'aamilim-minkum min zakarin aw unthaa; ba'dukum min ba'd; fallazeena haajaroo wa ukhrijoo min diyaarihim wa oozoo fee sabeelee wa qaataloo wa qutiloo la-ukaffiranna 'anhum sayyi-aatihim wa la-udkhilannahum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar; thawaaban min 'indillaah; wallaahu 'indahoo husnuth-thawaab. Laa yaghurrannaka taqallubul-lazeena kafaroo fil-bilaad. Mataa'un qaleelun thumma ma'waahum Jahannamu wa bi'sal-mihaad. Laakinil-lazeena-ttaqaw Rabbahum lahum jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa nuzulan min 'indillaah; wa maa 'indallaahi khairul-lil-abraar. Wa inna min Ahlil-Kitaabi laman yu'minu billaahi wa maaa unzila ilaikum wa maaa unzila ilaihim khaashi'eena lillaahi laa yashtaroona bi-aayaatillaahi thamanan qaleelaa; ulaaa'ika lahum ajruhum 'inda Rabbihim; innallaaha saree'ul-hisaab. Yaaa ayyuhal-lazeena aamanus-biroo wa saabiroo wa raabitoo wattaqullaaha la'allakum tuflihoon.
data.translation:
(190) Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding. (191) Who remember Allah while standing or sitting or [lying] on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying], "Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire. (192) Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers. (193) Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous. (194) Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise." (195) And their Lord responded to them, "Never will I allow to be lost the work of [any] worker among you, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated or were evicted from their homes or were harmed in My cause or fought or were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds, and I will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow as reward from Allah, and Allah has with Him the best reward." (196) Be not deceived by the [uninhibited] movement of the disbelievers throughout the land. (197) [It is but] a small enjoyment; then their [final] refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place. (198) But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as accommodation from Allah . And that which is with Allah is best for the righteous. (199) And indeed, among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah and what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, [being] humbly submissive to Allah . They do not exchange the verses of Allah for a small price. Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, Allah is swift in account. (200) O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful. (Sura Al-Imran 3: 190-200)

Then the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and prayed two rak'ats; In that prayer he prolongs Qiyam, Rukoo and Sujood. After ending the prayer he fell asleep ....
data.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 8/237 no.4569; Muslim 1/530 no. 256

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الرُّومِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمَّارٍ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَزَالُونَ يَسْأَلُونَكَ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ حَتَّى يَقُولُوا هَذَا اللَّهُ فَمَنْ خَلَقَ اللَّهَ ‏"‏ قَالَ فَبَيْنَا أَنَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ إِذْ جَاءَنِي نَاسٌ مِنَ الأَعْرَابِ فَقَالُوا يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ هَذَا اللَّهُ فَمَنْ خَلَقَ اللَّهَ قَالَ فَأَخَذَ حَصًى بِكَفِّهِ فَرَمَاهُمْ ثُمَّ قَالَ قُومُوا قُومُوا صَدَقَ خَلِيلِي ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: they (the people) till constantly ask you, Abu Huraira, (about different things pertaining to religion) the they would say: Well, there is Allah, but after all who created Allah? He (Abu Huraira) narrated: Once we were in the mosque that some of the Bedouins came there and said: Well, there is Allah, but who created Allah? He (the narrator) said: I took hold of the pebbles in my fist and flung at them and remarked: Stand up, stand up (go away) my friend (the Holy Prophet) told the truth. Sahih Muslim 135c [Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 8/237 no.4569; Muslim 1/530 no. 256]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua on Waking Up
benefits.description: This dua on waking up from Surah Al Imran fills your morning with Iman, helps you remember Allah’s signs, and brings Barakah and forgiveness as you start your day with the last 10 verses of Surah Al Imran.
points: Reciting the last 10 verses of Surah Al Imran brings Barakah and Iman in the morning.
This dua helps you remember Allah’s signs and mercy at the start of the day.
It is a masnoon dua that asks for forgiveness, Jannah, and Allah’s promise.
Reading these ayat after waking up fills the heart with hope and faith.
This dua helps Muslims start the day with zikr Allah and trust in His reward.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua On Waking Up
when_to_recite.description: This dua on waking up is best recited after opening your eyes at dawn to remember Allah’s signs and ask for forgiveness and Barakah.
points: After opening your eyes at dawn, recite the dua on waking up from Surah Al Imran.
When you sit up before fajr, use the last 10 verses of Surah Al Imran for Barakah.
Before starting your morning namaz, read these rabbana dua for forgiveness and Iman.
If you want to remember Allah’s signs, recite Surah Al Imran 190-200 after waking up.
When feeling weak in faith, make this dua after waking up to renew your Iman and hope.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua on Waking Up
how_to_perform.description: Reciting the last 10 verses of Surah Al Imran as your dua on waking up fills your morning with Barakah and brings your heart close to Allah. These ayat remind you of Allah’s power and His mercy every day.
steps: After your eyes open, start your day by reading the last 10 verses of Surah Al Imran.
While sitting up, think about the meaning of these ayat and say Alhamdulillah for another day.
If you feel sleepy, quietly recite the rabbana dua from these verses to wake up your Iman.
Before leaving your bed, ask Allah for forgiveness and hope for His Barakah in your Amal.
Try to make this dua on waking up a daily habit to keep your heart strong with zikr Allah.

data.title: Dua After Waking Up
data.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُوْرُ
data.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee 'ahyaanaa ba'da maa 'amaatanaa wa'ilayhin-nushoor
data.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.
data.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 11/113 no. 6314; Muslim 4/2083 no. 2711

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ رِبْعِيٍّ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ تَحْتَ خَدِّهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَإِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ ‏"‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa: When the Prophet (ﷺ) went to bed at night, he would put his hand under his cheek and then say, "Allahumma bismika amutu wa ahya," and when he got up, he would say, "Al-Hamdu lil-lahi al-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana, wa ilaihi an-nushur." Sahih al-Bukhari 6314 [Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 11/113 no. 6314; Muslim 4/2083 no. 2711]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Waking Up
benefits.description: This dua after waking up fills your heart with Alhamdulillah, brings Barakah to your morning, and reminds you of Allah’s mercy as you start a new day with Iman and hope for a good day ahead.
points: Reciting this dua brings Barakah and gratitude at the start of the day.
Saying Alhamdulillah reminds Muslims that waking up is a gift from Allah.
This masnoon dua connects us to the idea of resurrection and Allah’s mercy.
It is a simple way to thank Allah for life and a new day every morning.
Morning azkar with this dua helps start the day with Iman and shukr.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Waking Up
when_to_recite.description: This dua after waking up is best recited as soon as you open your eyes in the morning to thank Allah for life and a new day.
points: As soon as you open your eyes, recite the dua after waking up for a blessed start.
When you sit up in bed, use this morning dua to thank Allah for giving you life again.
Before leaving your room, remember this waking up dua for a good day and strong Iman.
After fajr prayer, make this daily dua to fill your morning with zikr Allah and Barakah.
If you feel sleepy or tired, repeat this dua in the morning for energy and a happy heart.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua After Waking Up
how_to_perform.description: This dua after waking up is a simple way to thank Allah for giving you life each morning. It brings Barakah to your day and helps you start with Iman and hope for Allah’s mercy and forgiveness.
steps: When you open your eyes, quietly say the dua after waking up before leaving your bed.
While sitting up, let your heart feel the meaning of Alhamdulillah and thank Allah for a new day.
If you feel sleepy, softly repeat this morning dua to wake up your mind and remember Allah.
Before standing, ask Allah for a good day and make this daily prayer part of your morning azkar.
Try to say this dua every morning to keep your heart close to Allah and your Amal full of Barakah.

data.title: Dua For Waking Up For Fajr
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: when one of you wakes up, he should say:
data.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِيْ فِي جَسَدِيْ، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيْ، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
data.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee 'aafaanee fee jasadee, wa radda 'alayya roo’hee, wa 'adhina lee bidhikrih
data.translation: Praise is to Allah Who gave strength to my body and returned my soul to me and permitted me to remember Him.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: الحمدُ للهِ الذي عافاني في جَسَدي وَرَدّ عَليّ روحي وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِه
hadith.translation: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī `āfānī fī jasadī, wa radda `alayya rūḥī, wa 'adhina lī bidhikrihi. Praise is to Allah Who gave strength to my body and returned my soul to me and permitted me to remember Him. Reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/473. See Al-Albani's Sahih Tirmidhi 3/144. Hisn al-Muslim 3 [At-Tirmithi 5/473. See Al-Albani's Sahih Tirmiihi 3/144]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua For Waking Up For Fajr
benefits.description: This dua for waking up for fajr fills your heart with shukr to Allah for giving you life, health, and the chance to remember Him at fajr time, bringing Barakah and strength to your day from the very start.
points: Reciting this dua brings Barakah and health at the start of fajr.
Saying Alhamdulillah for strength and life helps start the day with Iman.
This masnoon dua reminds Muslims to thank Allah for the chance to remember Him.
It is a way to ask Allah for strength, forgiveness, and a good day ahead.
Morning azkar with this dua brings hope and Barakah for the whole day.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Waking Up For Fajr
when_to_recite.description: This dua for waking up for fajr is best recited as soon as you wake up for fajr to thank Allah for health, life, and the chance to remember Him.
points: Right after your eyes open for fajr, recite the dua for waking up for fajr to thank Allah.
Before making wudu for fajr namaz, remember this fajr dua for health and strength.
When you sit up in bed at fajr time, say Alhamdulillah with this dua for waking up.
After hearing the adhan for fajar prayer, use this dua for strength and Barakah in your day.
If you feel weak or tired at morning wake up, recite this dua for waking up for fajr for energy.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua For Waking Up For Fajr
how_to_perform.description: This dua for waking up for Fajr is a way to thank Allah for health, Iman, and the chance to remember Him at fajr time. It brings Barakah to your morning and helps you start your day with strong Amal and hope.
steps: As soon as you wake up for fajr, quietly recite the dua for waking up for fajr in your bed.
While sitting up, thank Allah by saying Alhamdulillah for giving you strength in your body.
Before going to make wudu, remember Allah returned your soul and gave you another chance.
After fajr namaz, repeat this dua for health and ask Allah to keep your Iman strong all day.
Try to make this dua a habit at fajr time to fill your morning with Barakah and good Amal.

data.title: Remembering Allah After Waking Up
data.introduction: Narrated Abu Huraira (RA): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Satan puts three knots at the back of the head of any of you if he is asleep. On every knot he reads and exhales the following words, 'The night is long, so stay asleep.' When one wakes up and remembers Allah, one knot is undone; and when one performs ablution, the second knot is undone, and when one prays the third knot is undone and one gets up energetic with a good heart in the morning; otherwise one gets up lazy and with a mischievous heart."

data.title: Dua for Bad Dreams
data.introduction: If you have a bad dream in your sleep, you should spit three times on the left side, then say three times -
data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
data.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
data.translation:
I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

One need to change sides in their sleep. It is forbidden to tell this dream in front of anyone. Even if you have good dreams, you don't have to tell anyone. But it can be said in front of a close friend or in front of wise people. Narrated Abu Qatadah (RA): The Prophet (ﷺ) said: A good dream is from Allah. And bad dreams are from the devil. So whoever has a good dream, let him reveal it to the one he loves. And if anyone has a bad dream, let him seek refuge in Allah from its harm and from the evil of Satan, and spit three times to the left. Don't reveal the dream to anyone. Then it will not be able to harm him. [1] Jarir (RA) said, Rasulullah (ﷺ) said, when one of you has a dream that he dislikes, he should spit three times to his left. And he seeks refuge in Allah from Satan three times and changes sides. [2] Abu Hurairah (RA) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If a person has a bad dream, he should get up and pray two rak'ahs. [3]

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ، يَقُولُ لَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَرَى الرُّؤْيَا فَتُمْرِضُنِي حَتَّى سَمِعْتُ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ يَقُولُ وَأَنَا كُنْتُ لأَرَى الرُّؤْيَا تُمْرِضُنِي، حَتَّى سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الرُّؤْيَا الْحَسَنَةُ مِنَ اللَّهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُمْ مَا يُحِبُّ فَلاَ يُحَدِّثْ بِهِ إِلاَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّ، وَإِذَا رَأَى مَا يَكْرَهُ فَلْيَتَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَلْيَتْفِلْ ثَلاَثًا وَلاَ يُحَدِّثْ بِهَا أَحَدًا فَإِنَّهَا لَنْ تَضُرَّهُ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Salama: I used to see a dream which would make me sick till I heard Abu Qatada saying, "I too, used to see a dream which would make me sick till I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "A good dream is from Allah, so if anyone of you saw a dream which he liked, he should not tell it to anybody except to the one whom he loves, and if he saw a dream which he disliked, then he should seek refuge with Allah from its evil and from the evil of Satan, and spit three times (on his left) and should not tell it to anybody, for it will not harm him. " [[1] Bukhari: 7044 [2] Muslim: 6041 [3] Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 2280]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Bad Dreams
benefits.description: Dua for Bad Dreams helps you seek Allah’s protection from shaitan, brings calm and safety to your heart after a nightmare, and reminds you to trust Allah’s mercy in every moment of fear.
points: Reciting this dua after a bad dream brings Allah’s protection from shaitan.
It helps remove fear and anxiety from the heart after nightmares.
This dua is a masnoon prayer from hadith, trusted by all Muslims.
Saying auzubillah minashaitan nirajeem brings peace and Barakah at night.
It teaches children and adults to turn to Allah for safety from evil and fear.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Bad Dreams
when_to_recite.description: This dua for bad dreams helps you seek Allah’s protection from shaitan, bringing calm and safety to your heart after a nightmare and reminding you to trust Allah’s mercy in every moment of fear.
points: After waking up from a nightmare, recite the dua for bad dreams for Allah’s protection.
When feeling scared at night, use this dua for protection from shaitan and fear.
If you remember a bad dream before going back to sleep, say auzubillah for peace.
Before sharing your dream with anyone, quietly recite this dua for bad dreams for safety.
When your child wakes up afraid, teach them this dua for nightmares to calm their heart.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Bad Dreams
how_to_perform.description: When you wake up from a bad dream, this dua for bad dreams helps you find peace and safety by asking Allah to protect you from Shaytan. Every Muslim should know this simple protection dua and use it before going to bed or after a nightmare.
steps: After a nightmare, quietly recite auzubillah minashaitan nirajeem to seek Allah’s help.
Turn your head to the left side and softly spit three times as taught in hadith.
Try not to share your bad dream with anyone and trust Allah’s protection from shaitan.
Recite ayat kursi or 4 qul after this dua for protection from shaitan and fear.
Before going to bed, read manzil dua or masnoon duain to keep away nightmares and get Barakah.

data.title: Dua Related to Dreams (Hadith)
data.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said - "A good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Satan. So if anyone of you sees (in a dream) something he dislikes, when he gets up he should blow thrice (on his left side) and seek refuge with Allah from its evil for then it will not harm him."

data.title: Dua When Wearing Clothes
data.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِيْ هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيْهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّيْ وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
data.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee kasaanee haadhaa aththawba wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlim-minnee wa laa quwwah
data.translation:
All Praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power nor might from myself.

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone says this while wearing clothes, his previous sins will be forgiven."

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا نُصَيْرُ بْنُ الْفَرَجِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ - عَنْ أَبِي مَرْحُومٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ طَعَامًا ثُمَّ قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا الطَّعَامَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَمَنْ لَبِسَ ثَوْبًا فَقَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Mu'adh ibn Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone eats food and then says: "Praise be to Allah Who has fed me with this food and provided me with it through no might and power on my part," he will be forgiven his former and later sins. If anyone puts on a garment and says: "Praise be to Allah Who has clothed me with this and provided me with it through no might and power on my part," he will be forgiven his former and later sins. [Hasan (Albani). Abu Dawud: 4023]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua When Wearing Clothes
benefits.description: Dua when wearing clothes reminds you to thank Allah for every garment, showing shukr for His Rizq and remembering that all blessings come from Him alone, not from our own power or strength.
points: Reciting this dua brings Barakah in every dress you wear.
It helps you remember Allah’s mercy and Rizq in daily life.
Saying alhamdulillah for everything keeps the heart full of gratitude.
This masnoon dua teaches children and adults to thank Allah for all blessings.
It is a daily habit that increases Iman and shukr in every Amal.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua When Wearing Clothes
when_to_recite.description: This dua when wearing clothes reminds you to thank Allah for every garment, showing shukr for His Rizq and remembering that all blessings come from Him alone, not from our own power or strength.
points: Each morning before putting on your clothes, recite the dua when wearing clothes for Barakah.
When you wear new clothes, use this dua for new clothes to thank Allah for His Rizq.
After washing and drying your dress, say this dua for wearing clothes as a daily habit.
Before leaving home in fresh clothes, remember this dua for protection and gratitude.
If you receive a gift of new dress, recite the dua when wearing clothes for shukr and joy.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua When Wearing Clothes
how_to_perform.description: This dua when wearing clothes reminds us to thank Allah for every dress He gives, showing our Iman and gratitude. It is a simple masnoon dua that brings Barakah and makes us remember Allah’s blessings in our daily life.
steps: When you put on any dress, say the dua for wearing clothes with a thankful heart to Allah.
If you wear new clothes, recite the new clothes dua and feel happy for Allah’s Rizq.
Before leaving for namaz or going outside, read this dua to get protection and Barakah.
While helping kids or family wear clothes, teach them this daily dua for Islamic lifestyle.
After wearing your dress, say alhamdulillah for everything and remember Allah’s mercy.

data.title: Dua for Wearing New Clothes
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيْهِ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma lakal-hamdu 'Anta kasawtaneehi, 'as'aluka khayrahu wa khayra maa suni'a lahu, wa 'a'oodhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lahu
data.translation: O Allah, for You is all praise, You have clothed me with it, I ask You for the good of it and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of it and the evil for which it was made.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اسْتَجَدَّ ثَوْبًا سَمَّاهُ بِاسْمِهِ عِمَامَةً أَوْ قَمِيصًا أَوْ رِدَاءً ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ عُمَرَ وَابْنِ عُمَرَ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Sa'eed: "When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), would wear a new garment he would mention what it was, whether an 'Imamah, a Qamis, or a Rida', then he would say: Allahumma lakal-hamdu, Anta kasawtanihi, as'aluka khairuhu wa khaira ma suni'a lahu, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lahu'" ('O Allah! For You is the praise, You have clothed me, I ask You for its good and the god for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.) [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Umar, and Ibn 'Umar. [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 1767]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Wearing New Clothes
benefits.description: Dua for wearing new clothes helps you thank Allah for His gifts, asking for good from your new dress and seeking safety from any harm, filling your heart with shukr and Barakah every time you wear something new.
points: Reciting this dua brings Barakah and protection in new clothes.
It helps you thank Allah for every new dress and His Rizq.
Saying allahumma lakal hamdu keeps the heart full of gratitude and shukr.
This masnoon dua teaches Muslims to ask for good and protection in every Amal.
It is a daily habit that brings happiness and Iman to the family.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Wearing New Clothes
when_to_recite.description: This dua for wearing new clothes helps you thank Allah for His gifts, asking for good from your new dress and seeking safety from any harm, filling your heart with shukr and Barakah every time you wear something new.
points: When you first put on new clothes, recite the dua for wearing new clothes for Barakah.
After buying a new dress, use this new clothes dua before wearing it for the first time.
If you receive a gift of new clothes, say allahumma lakal hamdu with this dua for new dress.
Before going out in your new outfit, remember this dua for new clothes for protection.

data.arabic: تُبْلَی وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی
data.transliteration: Tubla- wa yukhliful-laahu ta'aalaa
data.translation:

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اسْتَجَدَّ ثَوْبًا سَمَّاهُ بِاسْمِهِ إِمَّا قَمِيصًا أَوْ عِمَامَةً ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو نَضْرَةَ فَكَانَ أَصْحَابُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا لَبِسَ أَحَدُهُمْ ثَوْبًا جَدِيدًا قِيلَ لَهُ تُبْلِي وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated AbuSa'id al-Khudri: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) put on a new garment he mentioned it by name, turban or shirt, and would then say: O Allah, praise be to Thee! as Thou hast clothed me with it, I ask Thee for its good and the good of that for which it was made, and I seek refuge in Thee from its evil and the evil of that for which it was made. Abu Nadrah said: When any of the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) put on a new garment, he was told: May you wear it out and may Allah give you another in its place. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 4020]

data.title: Dua Before Undressing (Bismillah)
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّه
data.transliteration: Bismillaah
data.translation:
In the name of Allah.

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When one of you undresses or is uncovered, the veil between the human genitals and the eyes of the jinn is called 'Bismillah'.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ بَشِيرِ بْنِ سَلْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَلاَّدٌ الصَّفَّارُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ النَّصْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَتْرُ مَا بَيْنَ أَعْيُنِ الْجِنِّ وَعَوْرَاتِ بَنِي آدَمَ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُهُمُ الْخَلاَءَ أَنْ يَقُولَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ وَإِسْنَادُهُ لَيْسَ بِذَاكَ الْقَوِيِّ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَشْيَاءُ فِي هَذَا ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Ali bin Abi Talid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated that : the Messenger of Allah said: "The screen between the eyes of the jinns and nakedness of the children of Adam when one of you enters the area of relieving oneself is saying: 'Bismillah.'" [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 606]

data.title: Dua for Someone Wearing New Clothes (Female)
data.arabic: أَبْلِيْ وَأَخْلِقِيْ
data.transliteration: Abli wa akhliqi
data.translation:
May you live so long that your dress gets worn out.

Umm Khalid (RA), daughter of Khalid Ibn Sayed (RA), said, 'A garment was brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), with a black design on it. Then he said, "Who can we wear this dress?" When the Companions were silent, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Bring Umm Khalid." Then when I was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ), he put the garment on me with his own hands. Then he said twice- (The dua is mentioned above) This is what happened when Umme Khalid emigrated from Ethiopia to Medina with her father, when she was very young.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ خَالِدٍ بِنْتِ خَالِدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَتْ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ أَبِي وَعَلَىَّ قَمِيصٌ أَصْفَرُ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَنَهْ سَنَهْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَهْىَ بِالْحَبَشِيَّةِ حَسَنَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَذَهَبْتُ أَلْعَبُ بِخَاتَمِ النُّبُوَّةِ، فَزَجَرَنِي أَبِي‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ دَعْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَبْلِي وَأَخْلِقِي، ثُمَّ أَبْلِي وَأَخْلِقِي، ثُمَّ أَبْلِي وَأَخْلِقِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَبَقِيَتْ حَتَّى ذَكَرَ‏.‏ يَعْنِي مِنْ بَقَائِهَا‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Sa`id: Um Khalid bint Khalid bin Sa`id said, "I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with my father and I was wearing a yellow shirt. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Sanah Sanah!" (`Abdullah, the sub-narrator said, "It means, 'Nice, nice!' in the Ethiopian language.") Um Khalid added, "Then I started playing with the seal of Prophethood. My father admonished me. But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to my father), "Leave her," Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (then addressing me) said, "May you live so long that your dress gets worn out, and you will mend it many times, and then wear another till it gets worn out (i.e. May Allah prolong your life)." (The sub-narrator, `Abdullah aid, "That garment (which she was wearing remained usable for a long period."). [Bukhari: 5993]

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Sanah Sanah!" (`Abdullah, the sub-narrator said, "It means, 'Nice, nice!' in the Ethiopian language.") Um Khalid added, "Then I started playing with the seal of Prophethood. My father admonished me. data.title: Dua When Someone Wearing New Dress
data.arabic: اِلْبَسْ جَدِيدًا وَعِشْ حَمِيدًا وَمُتْ شَهِيدًا
data.transliteration: ilbas jadeedan, wa‛ish 'hameedan wa mut shaheedan
data.translation:
Wear anew, live commendably and die a shaheed.

Narrated Ibn Umar (RA): The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a white dress on Umar and said, “Is this your dress new, or does it look like it was washed?” He said, “It is rather new.” Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said - (The dua is mentioned above) Umar (RA) said, “O Messenger of Allah! I am praying the same for you.”

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَنْبَأَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ رَأَى عَلَى عُمَرَ قَمِيصًا أَبْيَضَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ثَوْبُكَ هَذَا غَسِيلٌ أَمْ جَدِيدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ بَلْ غَسِيلٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْبَسْ جَدِيدًا وَعِشْ حَمِيدًا وَمُتْ شَهِيدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated from Ibn `Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw `Umar wearing a white shirt and he said: “Is this garment of yours washed or a new one?” He said: “Rather it has been washed.” He said: “Ilbas jadida, wa `ish hamida, wa mut shahida (May you wear new clothes, live a good life and die as martyr).” [Sahih (Albani). Ibn Majah: 3558]

data.title: Dua Said To Someone Wearing New Clothes
data.arabic: اِلْبَسْ جَدِيدًا وَعِشْ حَمِيدًا وَمُتْ شَهِيدًا وَيَرْزُقُكَ اللَّهُ قٌرَّةَ عَيْنٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاَخِرَةِ
data.transliteration: ilbas jadeedan, wa‛ish 'hameedan wa mut shaheedan wa iyarjuqukallahu qurrata ‘ainin feeduniya wal akhirah
data.translation: Wear anew, live commendably and die a shaheed and may Allah give you those things in this duniya and in hereafter which will cool your eyes.

data.title: Dua for leaving home
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
data.transliteration: bismillaahi, tawakkaltu 'alal-laahi, laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah
data.translation:
In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah and there is no might nor power except with Allah.

Narrated Anas ibn Malik (RA): The Prophet (ﷺ) said: When a man goes out of his house and say these words, the following will be said to him at that time: "You are guided, defended and protected." The devils will go far from him and another devil will say: How can you deal with a man who has been guided, defended and protected?

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الْخَثْعَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا خَرَجَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ فَقَالَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يُقَالُ حِينَئِذٍ هُدِيتَ وَكُفِيتَ وَوُقِيتَ فَتَتَنَحَّى لَهُ الشَّيَاطِينُ فَيَقُولُ لَهُ شَيْطَانٌ آخَرُ كَيْفَ لَكَ بِرَجُلٍ قَدْ هُدِيَ وَكُفِيَ وَوُقِيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Anas ibn Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: When a man goes out of his house and says: "In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah; there is no might and no power but in Allah," the following will be said to him at that time: "You are guided, defended and protected." The devils will go far from him and another devil will say: How can you deal with a man who has been guided, defended and protected? [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 5095]

data.title: Dua before leaving house
data.introduction: Umm Salamah (RA) narrated that: When the Prophet (ﷺ) would leave his house, he would say:
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ اَللَّـهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ نَزِلَّ أَوْ نَضِلَّ أَوْ نَظْلِمَ أَوْ نُظْلَمَ أَوْ نَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيْنَا
data.transliteration: Bismillaahi, tawakkaltu 'alal-laahi. Allaahumma, inna na`udhu bika min an nazilla aw nadilla, aw nazlima aw nuzlama, aw najhala aw yujhala 'alaina
data.translation:
In the Name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. O Allah! We seek refuge in You from slipping unintentionally or becoming misguided, or committing oppression or being oppressed, or acting ignorantly or being treated ignorantly.

A mu'min should recite these adhkar by his/her heart whenever (Day/Night) he/she goes outside.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ نَزِلَّ أَوْ نَضِلَّ أَوْ نَظْلِمَ أَوْ نُظْلَمَ أَوْ نَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيْنَا ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Umm Salamah narrated that : When the Prophet (ﷺ) would leave his house, he would say: “In the Name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. O Allah! We seek refuge in You from slipping unintentionally or becoming misguided, or committing oppression or being oppressed, or acting ignorantly or being treated ignorantly (Bismillāh, tawakkaltu `alallāh. Allāhumma, innā na`ūdhu bika min an nazilla aw naḍilla, aw naẓlima aw nuẓlam, aw najhala aw yujhala alainā).” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3427]

data.title: Dua when leaving the house
data.introduction: Umm Salamah (RA) said, whenever Rasul (ﷺ) went outside my home he recite these words looking at the sky-
data.arabic: اَللَّـهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ، أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ، أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ، أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a‛oodhu bika an adilla aw udalla, aw azilla aw uzalla, aw azlima aw uzlama, aw adhala aw yudhala ‛alayya
data.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip (i.e. to commit a sin unintentionally) or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ بَيْتِي قَطُّ إِلاَّ رَفَعَ طَرْفَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَىَّ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Umm Salamah, Ummul Mu'minin: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) never went out of my house without raising his eye to the sky and saying: "O Allah! I seek refuge in Thee lest I stray or be led astray, or slip or made to slip, or cause injustice, or suffer injustice, or do wrong, or have wrong done to me." [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 5094]

data.title: Dua for entering home
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
data.transliteration: Allaahumma inni as'aluka khairal-mawliji wa khairal-makhraji. Bismillahi wa lajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'al-Allahi rabbina tawakkalna
data.translation:
O Allah! I ask Thee for good both when entering and when going out; in the name of Allah we have entered, and in the name of Allah we have gone out, and in Allah our Lord do we trust.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ) commanded us to mention Allah upon entering home and informed that, who does that devil can’t enter into the house with him. Fundamental dua upon entering home is giving salaam. Abu Malik Ash’ari (RA) narrated that, Rasoolullah (ﷺ) said that, when anyone from you enter into the house, he should recite these words and then give salaam to his family. The narrators of this narration are all trustworthy but there is a probability that the hadith is ‘Mursaal’.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، - قَالَ ابْنُ عَوْفٍ وَرَأَيْتُ فِي أَصْلِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ضَمْضَمٌ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا وَلَجَ الرَّجُلُ فِي بَيْتِهِ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا ثُمَّ لْيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated AbuMalik Al-Ash'ari: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: When a man goes into his house, he should say: "O Allah! I ask Thee for good both when entering and when going out; in the name of Allah we have entered, and in the name of Allah we have gone out, and in Allah our Lord do we trust." He should then greet his family. [Hasan (Ibn Baz). Abu Dawud: 5096]

data.title: Dua before entering home
data.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
data.transliteration: As-salaamu 'alaykum wara'hmatullaahi wa barakaatuh
data.translation:
Peace be upon you, and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings.

To give salaam upon all is sunnah. Giving salaam upon spouse and family members is additional sunnah. It is recommended and have special rewards and those who have this character, this below mentioned hadith give glad tidings. Abu umama (RA) said that, Rasoolullah (ﷺ) said, “Allah will give guarantee and protection for three kinds of people. If he live then all of his matter will be protected by Allah and if he die then he will enter into jannah. (First one is) He who give salaam before enter into the house, he will enter in the protection of Allah….”

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " بُنِيَ الْإِسْلَامُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ: شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ وَالْحَجِّ وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ "
hadith.translation: Ibn ‘Umar reported God's messenger as saying, “Islam is based on five things: the testimony that there is no god but God and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger, the observance of the prayer, the payment of zakat , the Pilgrimage, and the fast during Ramadan.” (Bukhari and Muslim.) [Hasan (Ibn Hajar). MIshkat: 4/316]

After a long day outside, use assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh to bring mercy.
