When visiting someone’s house, recite dua for entering home to spread Allah’s mercy.
If you feel tired or upset, make dua of entering home for calm and Allah’s kindness.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua before entering home
how_to_perform.description: Saying the dua before entering home brings peace, Barakah, and Allah’s mercy to your house. This simple dua before entering home is a way to greet your family and fill your home with blessings and Iman.
steps: Step to your door and say assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh with a smile.
When you enter, greet your family using this dua for entering home to spread Barakah.
If you come home after work or school, softly say salam alaikum for Allah’s mercy.
While opening the door, remember the meaning of assalamualaikum in your heart.
After saying the dua, believe Allah will fill your home with peace and guide your Amal.

data.title: Dua of entering home
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
data.transliteration: Bismil-laahi walajna, wabismil-laahi kharajna, wa'alallaahi rabbina tawakkalna
data.translation:
In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.

Then give salaam to the people of the house. [1] When a person enters his house and mentions the name of Allah at the time of entering it and while eating the food, Satan says (addressing himself: You have no place to spend the night and no evening meal;[2]

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، - قَالَ ابْنُ عَوْفٍ وَرَأَيْتُ فِي أَصْلِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ضَمْضَمٌ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا وَلَجَ الرَّجُلُ فِي بَيْتِهِ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا ثُمَّ لْيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated AbuMalik Al-Ash'ari: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: When a man goes into his house, he should say: "O Allah! I ask Thee for good both when entering and when going out; in the name of Allah we have entered, and in the name of Allah we have gone out, and in Allah our Lord do we trust." He should then greet his family. [[1] Hasan (Ibn Baz). Abu Dawud: 5096 [2] Muslim: 2018]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua of Entering Home
benefits.description: Let your house be filled with Allah’s care and trust by saying this dua of entering home, making every step inside and outside safe with His name and keeping your family close to His Rahmah.
points: Bismillah in this dua for entering home keeps shaytan away from your house.
Placing tawakkal on Allah with this dua brings peace and safety to the family.
Dua of entering home makes every entry and exit full of Barakah and Amal.
Using this masnoon dua for entering house helps hearts stay strong with Iman.
Saying this dua for entering the home brings Allah’s help in all daily matters.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua of Entering Home
when_to_recite.description: This dua of entering home reminds every Muslim to say bismillah and trust Allah, bringing Barakah and safety to the house, and making every step inside or outside full of tawakkal and Iman.
points: Entering your house, always say the dua of entering home for Barakah and safety.
When leaving your home, recite bismillah and this dua for Allah’s protection.
After coming back from work or school, use the dua for entering the house for peace.
If you move to a new home, make the dua for entering home to ask for Allah’s blessings.
Before opening the door at night, remember the dua for entering house for calm and tawakkal.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua of entering home
how_to_perform.description: Reciting the dua of entering home brings Barakah and keeps your house safe with Allah’s name. This dua for entering home is a simple way to start and end your day with Iman and trust in Allah’s help.
steps: Enter your house by stepping in with your right foot and say bismillah with full heart.
As you cross the door, softly read this dua of entering home to seek Allah’s Barakah.
When you leave the house, remember to say bismillahi tawakkaltu alallah for protection.
If you come home after a long day, recite this dua for entering the house and leaving.
After saying the dua, trust Allah to fill your home with peace and guide your Amal.

data.title: Dua Before Entering the Toilet
data.introduction: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say when he entered the toilet:
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
data.transliteration: Bismillaah, Allaahumma 'innee 'A'oodhu bika minal-khubuthi walkhabaa'ith
data.translation:
In the Name of Allah. O Allah, I seek protection in You from the male and female unclean spirits.

Ali (RA) said, Rasoolullah (ﷺ) said: When one of you goes to a secluded place by the call of nature, the covering of the genitals of the children of Adam from the eyes of the jinn is to say "Bismillah".

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا دَخَلَ الْخَلاَءَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ ‏" ‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ ابْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ غُنْدَرٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ إِذَا أَتَى الْخَلاَءَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُوسَى عَنْ حَمَّادٍ إِذَا دَخَلَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Anas: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, he used to say, "Allah-umma inni a`udhu bika minal khubuthi wal khaba'ith i.e. O Allah, I seek Refuge with You from all offensive and wicked things (evil deeds and evil spirits). [Bukhari: 142]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua Before Entering the Toilet
benefits.description: Keep yourself safe from harm and impurity by saying this dua before entering the toilet, letting Allah’s name protect you from all evil and keeping your heart clean and full of Iman.
points: Bismillah in this dua before entering the toilet keeps shayateen away from you.
Allahumma inni in this dua gives protection from hidden harm and impurity.
Bathroom jane ki dua helps a muslim stay clean in body and Amal every day.
Using this masnoon dua before entering bathroom brings Allah’s mercy and safety.
Dua before toilet entry keeps your zikr Allah strong even in private moments.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Before Entering the Toilet
when_to_recite.description: This dua before entering the toilet helps every Muslim remember bismillah and ask Allah for safety from harm, keeping the heart clean and the mind safe from shayateen with every step inside.
points: Before stepping into the washroom, recite the dua before entering the toilet for Allah’s help.
When your child goes to the bathroom, teach them the bathroom dua for protection.
If you feel scared at night, use the dua before entering bathroom for peace and calm.
Entering any public toilet, remember the dua before toilet to keep away bad things.
While opening the bathroom door, say the dua entering toilet for Barakah and safety.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua Before Entering the Toilet
how_to_perform.description: This dua before entering the toilet is a simple way to ask Allah for safety from harm and keep your Amal clean. Every Muslim should say this masnoon dua before going into the bathroom to get Allah’s help and Barakah.
steps: Always say bismillah softly before stepping into the washroom to start with zikr allah.
Enter the bathroom with your left foot first and recite the dua before entering the toilet.
Use the words allahumma inni as you walk in, asking Allah to keep you safe from bad things.
Remember to keep your mind on this bathroom dua and not talk or mention Allah’s name inside.
When you leave, step out with your right foot and thank Allah for keeping you safe from harm.

data.title: Dua for Leaving the Toilet
data.introduction: It is narrated on the authority of Aisha (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say when he came out of the toilet:
data.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
data.transliteration: Gufraanak
data.translation:
I ask You (Allah) for forgiveness.

Ayesha (RA) said that Rasoolullah (ﷺ) used to say this dua when he came out of the toilet.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حَدَّثَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ، رضى الله عنها أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنَ الْغَائِطِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ غُفْرَانَكَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: When the Prophet (ﷺ) came out of the privy, he used to say: "Grant me Thy forgiveness." [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 30]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Leaving the Toilet
benefits.description: Show thankfulness and seek Allah’s forgiveness by saying this dua for leaving the toilet, keeping your heart humble and your Amal clean as you follow the right way of islamic toilet etiquette.
points: Gufranak in this dua for leaving toilet brings Allah’s forgiveness to the heart.
Dua after leaving toilet helps a muslim remember Allah after every need.
Using this masnoon dua for leaving the toilet keeps your Amal pure and accepted.
Toilet se nikalne ki dua teaches thankfulness for Allah’s mercy and daily ease.
After toilet dua reminds muslims to stay humble and ask forgiveness in small things.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Leaving the Toilet
when_to_recite.description: This dua for leaving the toilet reminds Muslims to ask Allah for forgiveness, showing thankfulness for His mercy and keeping the heart clean after every visit to the washroom.
points: After stepping out from the bathroom, recite the dua for leaving the toilet for forgiveness.
When teaching kids islamic toilet etiquette, use the dua after leaving toilet for Amal.
If you forget to say the dua after toilet, remember it as soon as you recall for Barakah.
Leaving a public washroom, make the dua for leaving the toilet to thank Allah for ease.
After using the toilet at night, softly say the after toilet dua for Allah’s mercy.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Leaving the Toilet
how_to_perform.description: This dua for leaving the toilet is a short masnoon dua that helps you ask Allah for forgiveness and keep your Amal pure. Every Muslim should say this bathroom dua after coming out to follow islamic toilet etiquette and get Barakah.
steps: Step out of the bathroom with your right foot first and quietly say gufranak.
Right after leaving, recite the dua for leaving toilet to ask Allah for forgiveness.
Keep your heart focused on forgiveness in islam while saying this masnoon dua.
Make sure not to delay this after toilet dua and say it as soon as you exit the washroom.
Use this muslim prayer daily to keep your Amal clean and follow the sunnah of the Prophet.

data.title: Reply of Azan (Azan Dua)
data.introduction: Narrated by 'Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA), he said, The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the muazzin says "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar", Then if any of you say “Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar; When the muazzin says "Ashhadu an laa ilaaha illallah", If he says "Ashhadu an laa ilaaha illallah"; When Muazzin says “Ashhadu Anna Muhammadar Rasoolullah, If he says "Ashhadu Anna Muhammadar Rasoolullah"; When the muazzin says "Haiya alas salah", If he says "Laa hawla wala quwwata illa billah"; When the muazzin says "Haiya alal falah", If he says "Laa hawla wala quwwata illa billah"; When the muazzin says "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar", If he says "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar", Then when the muazzin says "Laa ilaaha illallah", If he says "Laa ilaaha illallah" If he says these things from the heart, then he will go to Paradise.

data.title: Dua after hearing Adhan (Azan dua)
data.introduction: After uttering Mu'adhdhin Tashahhud (i.e. Ashhadu Anna Muhammadar ...) the listeners will say this dhikr -
data.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا
data.transliteration: Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha ill-Allahu wa'hdahu laa shareeka lahu wa anna mu'hammadan ‛abduhu wa rasooluhu, radeetu billaahi rabban wa bimu'hammadin rasoolan wa bil -islaami deen-an
data.translation:
I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger (ﷺ). I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Muhammad as a Messenger and Islam as a religion.

Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (RA) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever hears Mu'adhzin and utters these words, all his sins will be forgiven."

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ الْحُكَيْمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ الْقُرَشِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ الْحُكَيْمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يَسْمَعُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا ‏.‏ غُفِرَ لَهُ ذَنْبُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ رُمْحٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ‏"‏ مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يَسْمَعُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قُتَيْبَةُ قَوْلَهُ وَأَنَا ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If anyone says on hearing the Mu'adhdhin: I testify that there is no god but Allah alone. Who has no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger, (and that) I am satisfied with Allah as my Lord, with Muhammad as Messenger. and with Islam as din (code of life), his sins would be forgiven. In the narration transmitted by Ibn Rumh the words are:" He who said on hearing the Mu'adhdhin and verity I testify." ' Qutaiba has not mentioned his words:" And I." [Muslim: 386]

benefits.title: Benefits of Azan Dua
benefits.description: Let your Iman grow strong by saying the azan dua after hearing the call to prayer, showing love for Allah, His Messenger, and Islam, and bringing Barakah to your Salah and daily Amal.
points: Ash hadu allah ilaha illallah in azan dua makes Iman shine in the heart.
Raditu billahi rabban in dua after adhan brings Allah’s pleasure and mercy.
Azan ke baad ki dua helps a muslim remember the true path of Islam every day.
Saying this masnoon dua after azan brings Barakah to your Salah and Amal.
Azan dua keeps the love for Prophet Muhammad and Islam alive in the heart.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Azan Dua
when_to_recite.description: This azan dua is recited after hearing the call to prayer, helping Muslims renew their Iman, remember the shahada, and feel close to Allah, His Messenger, and Islam with every adhan.
points: After hearing the adhan, recite the azan dua to show your Iman and love for Islam.
When teaching kids about salah, use the dua after adhan to build their faith in shahada.
If you hear the muslim call to prayer at home, say the azan dua for Barakah in your house.
While waiting for jamaat in masjid, remember the azan ke baad ki dua for more reward.
After listening to adhan on phone or radio, softly recite the azan dua for Amal and peace.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Azan Dua
how_to_perform.description: After hearing the azan, this azan dua helps you show your Iman and love for Islam. It is a masnoon dua that every Muslim should say to get Barakah and follow the sunnah of the Prophet.
steps: Wait until the adhan is finished, then softly recite the azan dua with full heart.
Say the shahada and azan dua after adhan, showing your faith in Allah and His Messenger.
Keep your mind on zikr allah and repeat raditu billahi rabban as part of this muslim prayer.
Use this dua after azan before starting your namaz to get more reward and blessings.
Teach your family to say this azan ke baad ki dua so everyone gets the Barakah of this masnoon dua.

data.title: Dua After Adhan (Durood Sharif)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Mu'hammadin wa 'alaa 'aali Mu'hammadin, kamaa sallayta 'alaa 'Ibraaheema wa 'alaa 'aali 'Ibraaheema, 'innaka Hameedun Majeed. Allaahumma baarik 'alaa Mu'hammadin wa 'alaa 'aali Mu'hammadin, kamaa baarakta 'alaa 'Ibraaheema wa 'alaa 'aali 'Ibraaheema, 'innaka Hameedun Majeed
data.translation:
O Allah, bestow Your favor on Muhammad (ﷺ) and on the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) as You have bestowed Your favor on Ibrahim (Ah) and on the family of Ibrahim (Ah), You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad (ﷺ) and the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) as You have blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim (Ah), You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.

Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When you hear the Mu'adhdhin, repeat what he says, then invoke a blessing on me, for everyone who invokes a blessing on me will receive ten blessings from Allah; then beg from Allah al-Wasila for me, which is a rank in Paradise fitting for only one of Allah's servants, and I hope that I may be that one. If anyone who asks that I be given the Wasila, he will be assured of my intercession.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمُرَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ حَيْوَةَ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، وَغَيْرِهِمَا، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ فَقُولُوا مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ ثُمَّ صَلُّوا عَلَىَّ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَىَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْرًا ثُمَّ سَلُوا اللَّهَ لِيَ الْوَسِيلَةَ فَإِنَّهَا مَنْزِلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لاَ تَنْبَغِي إِلاَّ لِعَبْدٍ مِنْ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ وَأَرْجُو أَنْ أَكُونَ أَنَا هُوَ فَمَنْ سَأَلَ لِيَ الْوَسِيلَةَ حَلَّتْ لَهُ الشَّفَاعَةُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: Abdullah b. Amr b. al-As reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When you hear the Mu'adhdhin, repeat what he says, then invoke a blessing on me, for everyone who invokes a blessing on me will receive ten blessings from Allah; then beg from Allah al-Wasila for me, which is a rank in Paradise fitting for only one of Allah's servants, and I hope that I may be that one. If anyone who asks that I be given the Wasila, he will be assured of my intercession. [Muslim: 384]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Adhan (Durood Sharif)
benefits.description: This dua after azan brings blessings and mercy from Allah, raising the rank of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his family, and brings Barakah to those who send durood sharif after hearing the call to prayer.
points: Allah gives Barakah to the one who sends durood sharif after azan.
Durood ibrahim after adhan helps a muslim get closer to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
Saying allahumma salli ala muhammad after azan brings more mercy in namaz.
After azan dua with durood sharif makes duas more likely to be accepted.
Durood sharif in english or arabic after azan brings peace and Amal in heart.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Durood Sharif
when_to_recite.description: This durood sharif is recited after adhan to send blessings on Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his family, bringing Barakah and reward for every Muslim who loves the Prophet and follows his sunnah.
points: After the adhan finishes, recite durood sharif for blessings on Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
While waiting for iqamah, use the dua after adhan to fill your heart with love for Nabi.
When teaching kids about salah, help them learn durood ibrahim after azan for Amal.
If you hear the azan at home, softly say durood sharif for Barakah in your house.
Before starting fard salah, remember to recite durood sharif for more reward and Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Durood Sharif after Adhan
how_to_perform.description: After the adhan, reciting durood sharif brings Barakah and follows the sunnah of the Prophet. This masnoon dua is a way to send blessings on Muhammad ﷺ and his family, and every Muslim should make it a habit.
steps: Wait for the azan to finish, then start with allahumma salli ala muhammad from your heart.
Recite durood ibrahim slowly, thinking about the blessings for the Prophet and his family.
Say this durood sharif after azan before making any other dua or starting your namaz.
Teach your kids and family to read this darood pak so everyone gets the reward together.
Use this muslim prayer daily to keep your zikr allah strong and get more Barakah in your Amal.

data.title: Dua After Adhan (Azan Dua)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا وَالْوَسِيْلَةَ وَالْفَضِيْلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُوْدًا الَّذِيْ وَعَدْتَهُ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma rabba haadhi-hid-da watit-taammah, wassalaatil-qaa’imah, aati mu'hammadan-il- waseelata wal-fadeelah, wab‛ath-hu maqaaman ma'hmoodan-illadhee wa‛adtah
data.translation: O Allah, Owner of this perfect call and Owner of this prayer to be performed, bestow upon Muhammad (ﷺ) al-waseelah and al-fadeelah and raise him upon a praised platform which You have promised him.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يَسْمَعُ النِّدَاءَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، حَلَّتْ لَهُ شَفَاعَتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever after listening to the Adhan says, 'Allahumma Rabba hadhihi-dda` watit-tammah, was-salatil qa'imah, ati Muhammadan al-wasilata wal-fadilah, wa b`ath-hu maqaman mahmudan-il-ladhi wa`adtahu' [O Allah! Lord of this perfect call (perfect by not ascribing partners to You) and of the regular prayer which is going to be established, give Muhammad the right of intercession and illustriousness, and resurrect him to the best and the highest place in Paradise that You promised him (of)], then my intercession for him will be allowed on the Day of Resurrection". [Bukhari: 614]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Adhan (Azan Dua)
benefits.description: This dua after adhan brings special rewards, helps raise the rank of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and brings Barakah and acceptance for those who remember Allah after hearing the azan.
points: Allah grants the promise of Maqam Mahmood to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
After azan dua helps a muslim get more Barakah in every Salah and Amal.
Azan dua makes duas more likely to be accepted by Allah’s mercy.
Saying dua after adhan brings peace and Iman in the heart of a muslim.
Azan ke baad ki dua gives a muslim the chance to earn big rewards from Allah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Adhan
when_to_recite.description: This dua after adhan is a special way to ask Allah for Barakah and honor for our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, bringing more reward and blessings to your namaz and making your Iman stronger every day.
points: After hearing the adhan, muslims should recite the dua after adhan for Barakah.
When the muazzin finishes calling, use the after azan dua to gain more reward.
Before starting your fard salah, make dua after azan in english for extra blessings.
At the masjid, after hearing the azan, recite the azan ke baad ki dua for more Amal.
If you want to follow sunnah, remember to say the dua after hearing adhan for Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua After Adhan
how_to_perform.description: This dua after adhan is a special muslim prayer to ask Allah to give the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ the highest place in Jannah. Every Muslim should say this masnoon dua after hearing the azan to get Barakah and follow the sunnah.
steps: Wait for the muazzin to finish the azan, then start the dua after adhan with full Iman.
Recite the azan dua slowly, asking Allah to give the Prophet the promised Maqam Mahmood.
Keep your heart focused on zikr allah and say this dua after azan before starting your namaz.
Teach your family to read this after azan dua so everyone gets reward and follows islamic prayers.
Use this masnoon dua daily to get more Barakah and keep your Amal strong in every salah.

data.title: Hadith on Dua between Adhan and Iqamah
data.introduction: Narrated Anas Ibn Malik (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Dua is not returned between Adhaan and Iqamah"

data.title: Answer to Adhan and Iqamah
data.introduction: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whenever you hear the Adhaan, say what the Mu'adh-dhin is saying. The Prophet (ﷺ) called both Adhaan and Iqamah as Adhaan. [1] Here is to be mentioned that, to reply 'Qaadaqaamatissalah' as 'Aqaamaha allahy wa aadaamahaa' - the hadith is weak (Da’eef) [2] So, for replying the iqaamah, the musalli should reply by using same words as the ad’aan.

data.title: Dua for Imams and Mu'adhdhins (Dua for Forgiveness)
data.introduction: Narrated Abu Hurayrah (RA): The imam is responsible and the mu'adhdhin is trusted.
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَرْشِدِ الْأَئِمَّةَ وَاغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤَذِّنِيْنَ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma arshidil a-immata wagfir lilmua-ddhinin
data.translation: O Allah, guide the imams and forgive the mu'adhdhins.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الإِمَامُ ضَامِنٌ وَالْمُؤَذِّنُ مُؤْتَمَنٌ اللَّهُمَّ أَرْشِدِ الأَئِمَّةَ وَاغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤَذِّنِينَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The imam is responsible and the mu'adhdhin is trusted, O Allah, guide the imams and forgive the mu'adhdhins. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 517]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Imams and Mu'adhdhins
benefits.description: This dua for imams and mu'adhdhins brings Allah’s guidance for leaders and forgiveness for those who call to prayer, making the masjid a place of Barakah and unity for all muslims.
points: Allahumma gives hidayah to imams so they lead Salah with true Iman.
Dua for forgiveness brings maghfirat for mu'adhdhins who call to prayer.
Asking Allah for guidance helps imams stay on the right path in Amal.
Islamic prayer for forgiveness makes the masjid full of Barakah and peace.
Maghfirat ki dua for mu'adhdhins brings reward for every adhan they call.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Imams and Mu'adhdhins
when_to_recite.description: This dua for imams and mu'adhdhins is a simple way to ask Allah for guidance and forgiveness, bringing Barakah to those who lead and call us to salah, and helping our Iman grow with every prayer.
points: After every fard salah, muslims can recite dua for imams and mu'adhdhins for Barakah.
When you hear the adhan, remember to make this dua for forgiveness for mu'adhdhins.
At the masjid, before joining jamaat, use the dua for guidance for imams and mu'adhdhins.
On Fridays, after jummah prayer, recite the islamic prayer for forgiveness for leaders.
If you see the imam or mu'adhdhin, quietly say this dua for guidance and maghfirat.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Imams and Mu'adhdhins
how_to_perform.description: This dua for Imams and Mu'adhdhins is a simple islamic prayer for forgiveness and guidance, asking Allah to guide those who lead Salah and forgive those who call to prayer, bringing Barakah to the whole community.
steps: Start by facing the Qiblah and with a clean heart, say allaahumma arshidil a-immata wagfir lilmua-ddhinin.
After every Fard Salah, quietly recite this dua for forgiveness for imams and mu'adhdhins.
When you hear the adhan, make this prayer for guidance and forgiveness in your heart.
During gatherings in masjid, encourage others to join in this islamic prayer for forgiveness.
At times of reflection, use this maghfirat ki dua to ask Allah for guidance and forgiveness for all.

data.title: Dua Before Wudu (Ablution Dua)
data.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said that, whoever doesn't say Bismillaah, his ablution will be invalidated.
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
data.transliteration: Bismillaah
data.translation: In the Name of Allah

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ رُبَيْحِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ وُضُوءَ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed that: The Messenger of Allah said: "There is no ablution for one who does not mention the Name of Allah (before doing it)." Sunan Ibn Majah 397 [Irwa'ul-Ghalil 1/122 ,Ibn Majah No. 397]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua Before Wudu (Ablution Dua)
benefits.description: Saying Bismillah before wudu brings Allah’s name to every step, making the act of ablution full of Barakah and helping a muslim start Salah with a clean heart and pure Amal.
points: Bismillah before wudu brings more Barakah and reward in every ablution.
Dua before ablution helps muslims get more purity in wudu and Salah.
Wudu dua makes the washing steps count as acts of Iman and Amal.
Saying Bismillah in arabic before wudu keeps shaitan away from the act.
Ablution dua helps muslims remember Allah before every namaz and prayer.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Before Wudu
when_to_recite.description: This dua before wudu brings Barakah to your ablution, making every step of wudu in Islam more pure and helping your Iman grow strong with the simple words Bismillah before you start.
points: Before touching water for wudu, muslims should say the dua before wudu for Barakah.
When teaching kids how to make wudu, remind them to recite Bismillah in arabic first.
At the masjid, before starting ablution, use the ablution dua to begin with zikr Allah.
If you forget at first, say the wudu dua as soon as you remember during wudu steps.
Before every salah, start your wudu in islam with Bismillah for more reward in amal.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua before Wudu
how_to_perform.description: Saying Bismillah before wudu is a short but important islamic dua that brings Barakah and makes your ablution accepted, helping you start your wudu in the name of Allah with a clean heart and pure niyyah.
steps: Begin by standing near clean water and softly say Bismillah with full niyyah for wudu.
Before touching water, let your lips move with this dua before ablution for Barakah.
As you wash each part, remember the meaning of Bismillah in your heart and mind.
If you forget at the start, say this wudu dua as soon as you remember during ablution.
Teach children and family to always use this wazu ki dua before making wudu for every Salah.

data.title: Dua After Wudu (Ablution)
data.introduction: After doing ablution well, one should say:
data.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوْلُهُ
data.transliteration: Ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu wa 'ash-hadu 'anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluhu
data.translation:
I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner; and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger (ﷺ).

Uqba bin 'Amir (RA) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: If any Muslim performs ablution well, then stands and prays two rak'ahs setting about them with his heart as well as his face, Paradise would be guaranteed to him.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الأَسْوَدَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَرَأَ ‏{‏ وَالنَّجْمِ‏}‏ فَسَجَدَ فِيهَا وَسَجَدَ مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ شَيْخًا أَخَذَ كَفًّا مِنْ حَصًى أَوْ تُرَابٍ فَرَفَعَهُ إِلَى جَبْهَتِهِ وَقَالَ يَكْفِينِي هَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ بَعْدُ قُتِلَ كَافِرًا ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abdullah (b. 'Umar) reported: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) recited (Surat) al Najm and performed prostration during its recital and all those who were along with him also prostrated themselves except one old man who took a handful of pebbles or dust in his palm and lifted it to his forehead and said: This is sufficient for me. 'Abdullah said: I saw that he was later killed in a state of unbelief. Sahih Muslim 576 [Muslim: 234 , 576]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Wudu (Ablution)
benefits.description: This dua after wudu makes a muslim’s Iman strong, brings Barakah to every Salah, and helps keep the heart clean by remembering Allah and the truth of Muhammad ﷺ as His Messenger.
points: Ash hadu alla ilaha illallah after wudu brings more reward for every Amal.
Dua after ablution helps muslims keep their Iman fresh and strong in heart.
Saying lailahaillallah after wudu makes Salah more accepted by Allah.
Wudu dua after washing reminds muslims of the shahada and true faith.
After wudu dua brings peace and Barakah before every namaz and prayer.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Wudu
when_to_recite.description: This dua after wudu helps your Iman shine, bringing Barakah to your amal and making your ablution in Islam more strong with the words of shahada and praise for Allah and His Messenger ﷺ.
points: Right after finishing wudu steps, muslims should recite the dua after wudu for Barakah.
When teaching kids how to perform wudu, remind them to say lailahaillallah after ablution.
At the masjid, after making wudu, use the after wudu dua before going for salah.
If you forget at first, say the dua for after wudu as soon as you remember for reward.
Before entering prayer area, recite the shahada after wudu to complete your wudu prayer.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Wudu
how_to_perform.description: Reciting the dua after wudu is a strong way to show your Iman and thank Allah for letting you finish your ablution, making your Salah and Amal more accepted and full of Barakah.
steps: Right after washing your last part, say the shahada dua after wudu with a clear voice.
While still at the wudu place, recite ash hadu alla ilaha illallah wa ashhadu anna muhammadur rasulullah.
If you forget, say this wudu dua after as soon as you remember for your ablution.
Teach kids and family to always use this dua after ablution to keep their Amal strong.
In gatherings, remind others about this muslim prayer for after wudu to get more reward.

data.title: After Wudu Dua (Ablution)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنَ التَّوَّابِيْنَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِيْنَ
data.transliteration: Allaahummaj'alnee minat-tawwaabeena waj'alnee minal-mutatahhireen
data.translation:
O Allah, make me among those who turn to You in repentance, and make me among those who are purified.

It has been narrated in Sahih Hadith that the dua should be recited after the previous dhikr. The eight gates of Paradise will be opened for the one who recites these two duas; He will enter (Paradise) through whichever door he wishes.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ الثَّعْلَبِيُّ الْكُوفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ حُبَابٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الدِّمَشْقِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، وَأَبِي، عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ فُتِحَتْ لَهُ ثَمَانِيَةُ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ أَيِّهَا شَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ وَعُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى حَدِيثُ عُمَرَ قَدْ خُولِفَ زَيْدُ بْنُ حُبَابٍ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَرَوَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ وَغَيْرُهُ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ ‏.‏ وَعَنْ رَبِيعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ ‏.‏ وَهَذَا حَدِيثٌ فِي إِسْنَادِهِ اضْطِرَابٌ وَلاَ يَصِحُّ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هَذَا الْبَابِ كَبِيرُ شَيْءٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ وَأَبُو إِدْرِيسَ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ مِنْ عُمَرَ شَيْئًا ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Umar bin Al-Khattab narrated that: Allah's Messenger said: 'Whoever performs Wudu, making Wudu well, then says: (Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, wahdahu la sharika lahu, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan-abduhu wa rasuluhu, Allahummajalni minat tawwabin, waj'alni minal mutatahhirin) 'I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone, there are no partners for Him. And I testify that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah! Make me among the repentant, and make me among those who purify themselves.' Then eight gates of Paradise are opened for him, that may enter by whichever of them wishes." Jami` at-Tirmidhi 55 [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 55]

benefits.title: Benefits of After Wudu Dua
benefits.description: This after wudu dua brings a muslim closer to Allah by asking for forgiveness and purity, making every ablution a chance to earn Barakah and keep the heart clean for Salah and Amal.
points: Allahumma in this after wudu dua helps a muslim get Barakah in every Salah.
Dua after ablution makes the heart soft for tawbah and forgiveness of sins.
Dua for after wudu lets a muslim join those who love purity and clean Amal.
Wudu dua after helps keep Iman strong and brings peace before every namaz.
Dua for repentance in islam gives hope for Allah’s mercy and forgiveness always.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite After Wudu Dua
when_to_recite.description: This after wudu dua brings Barakah to your ablution, asking Allah for tawbah and to be counted among the pure, making your Iman and amal better with every wudu you do in Islam.
points: After finishing ablution, muslims should recite the after wudu dua for Barakah.
When teaching kids about wudu, remind them to say this dua after ablution for tawbah.
At the masjid, after making wudu, use the dua for after wudu before entering prayer area.
If you forget at first, say the after wudu dua as soon as you remember for forgiveness.
Before starting salah, recite the after wudu dua to ask Allah for purity and repentance.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform After Wudu Dua
how_to_perform.description: This after wudu dua is a simple islamic prayer for forgiveness and tawbah, asking Allah to make you from those who always turn back to Him and keep their hearts and bodies clean after every ablution.
steps: Once you finish your wudu, quietly say allahumma aj’alni minat-tawwabeen waj’alni minal-mutatahhireen.
While your hands are still wet, recite this dua for repentance and forgiveness in islam.
If you forget, say this after wudu dua as soon as you remember for Barakah in your Amal.
Teach your family and friends to use this islamic prayer for forgiveness after every ablution.
In masjid or at home, remind others about this dua for after wudu to keep their hearts pure.

data.title: Dua After Ablution (Wudu Dua)
data.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوْبُ إِلَيْكَ
data.transliteration: Subhaanaka Allaahumma wa bihamdika, 'ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta, 'astaghfiruka wa 'atoobu 'ilayk
data.translation:
Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise; I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.

Abu Sayed (RA) said, Rasulullah (ﷺ) said, if someone says this dua after ablution, it will be written in a letter and sealed (under the throne). That seal will not be broken before the Resurrection.
data.reference: An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah, p. 173. See also Al-Albani, 'Irwa'ul-Ghalil 1/135 and 2/94.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua After Ablution
benefits.description: This dua after ablution helps a muslim remember Allah’s greatness and ask for forgiveness, making every wudu a time to clean the heart and get ready for Salah with Barakah and Iman.
points: Subhanaka allahumma wa bihamdika in this dua after ablution brings Barakah.
La ilaha illa anta subhanaka makes a muslim’s Iman strong after every wudu.
Astaghfar in wudu dua after helps clean old sins and brings hope for forgiveness.
Dua for after wudu lets a muslim start namaz with a pure heart and clean Amal.
Repentance dua after wudu gives a chance to get closer to Allah’s mercy always.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Ablution
when_to_recite.description: This dua after ablution is a way to thank Allah for cleanliness, ask for forgiveness, and renew your Iman after every wudu, making your amal and salah full of Barakah and blessings.
points: After finishing wudu, recite the dua after ablution to thank Allah for purity.
Before leaving the wudu area, use the wudu dua after to ask for forgiveness and Barakah.
When you want to renew your niyyah, say subhanaka allahumma wa bihamdika after wudu.
If you feel your heart heavy, make the dua for after wudu for repentance and istighfar.
Before starting your fard salah, recite the wazu ki dua to seek Allah’s mercy and help.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Ablution
how_to_perform.description: This dua after ablution is a strong islamic prayer for forgiveness and tawbah, helping you thank Allah, ask for forgiveness, and keep your heart clean after every wudu.
steps: Right after finishing wudu, say subhanaka allahumma wa bihamdika with full focus.
While your hands are still wet, recite this dua for after wudu to seek Allah’s forgiveness.
If you forget, say this wudu dua after as soon as you remember for more Barakah.
Teach your kids and family to use this istighfar dua after ablution for every Salah.
In masjid or at home, remind others about this repentance dua to keep their Amal pure.

data.title: Dua for going to the Mosque (Dua e noor)
data.introduction: When the Mu'adhdhin gave the call to prayer, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to go out for the prayer while reciting this supplication -
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِيْ نُوْرًا وَّفِي لِسَانِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ فِي سَمْعِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ فِي بَصَرِىْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ مِنْ خَلْفِي نُوْرًا وَّمِنْ أَمَامِيْ نُوْرًا وَّاجْعَلْ مِنْ فَوْقِىْ نُوْرًا وَّمِنْ تَحْتِىْ نُوْرًا اَللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِىْ نُوْرًا
data.transliteration: Allaahumma-j‛al fee qalbee noor-an, wa fee lisaanee noor-an, waj‛al fee sam‛ee noor-an, waj‛al fee basaree noor-an, waj‛al min khalfee noor-an, wamin amaamee noor-an, waj‛al min fawqee noor-an, wa min t'ahtee noor-an, Allaahumma a‛tinee noor-an
data.translation: O Allah, place within my heart light, and upon my tongue light, and within my ears light, and within my eyes light, and place behind me light, and in front of me light, and above me light, and beneath me light. O Allah, bestow upon me light.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَى حَاجَتَهُ، غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ نَامَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَأَتَى الْقِرْبَةَ فَأَطْلَقَ شِنَاقَهَا، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا بَيْنَ وُضُوءَيْنِ لَمْ يُكْثِرْ، وَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ، فَصَلَّى، فَقُمْتُ فَتَمَطَّيْتُ كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يَرَى أَنِّي كُنْتُ أَتَّقِيهِ، فَتَوَضَّأْتُ، فَقَامَ يُصَلِّي، فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، فَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي فَأَدَارَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، فَتَتَامَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ فَنَامَ حَتَّى نَفَخَ ـ وَكَانَ إِذَا نَامَ نَفَخَ ـ فَآذَنَهُ بِلاَلٌ بِالصَّلاَةِ، فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ، وَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُعَائِهِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَسَارِي نُورًا، وَفَوْقِي نُورًا، وَتَحْتِي نُورًا، وَأَمَامِي نُورًا، وَخَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا ‏" ‏‏.‏ قَالَ كُرَيْبٌ وَسَبْعٌ فِي التَّابُوتِ‏.‏ فَلَقِيتُ رَجُلاً مِنْ وَلَدِ الْعَبَّاسِ فَحَدَّثَنِي بِهِنَّ، فَذَكَرَ عَصَبِي وَلَحْمِي وَدَمِي وَشَعَرِي وَبَشَرِي، وَذَكَرَ خَصْلَتَيْنِ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: One night I slept at the house of Maimuna. The Prophet (ﷺ) woke up, answered the call of nature, washed his face and hands, and then slept. He got up (late at night), went to a water skin, opened the mouth thereof and performed ablution not using much water, yet he washed all the parts properly and then offered the prayer. I got up and straightened my back in order that the Prophet (ﷺ) might not feel that I was watching him, and then I performed the ablution, and when he got up to offer the prayer, I stood on his left. He caught hold of my ear and brought me over to his right side. He offered thirteen rak`at in all and then lay down and slept till he started blowing out his breath as he used to do when he slept. In the meantime Bilal informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of the approaching time for the (Fajr) prayer, and the Prophet offered the Fajr (Morning) prayer without performing new ablution. He used to say in his invocation, Allahumma ij`al fi qalbi nuran wa fi basari nuran, wa fi sam`i nuran, wa`an yamini nuran, wa`an yasari nuran, wa fawqi nuran, wa tahti nuran, wa amami nuran, wa khalfi nuran, waj`al li nuran." Kuraib (a sub narrator) said, "I have forgotten seven other words, (which the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned in this invocation). I met a man from the offspring of Al-`Abbas and he narrated those seven things to me, mentioning, '(Let there be light in) my nerves, my flesh, my blood, my hair and my body,' and he also mentioned two other things." [Bukhari: 6316]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Going to the Mosque
benefits.description: This dua for going to the mosque fills a muslim’s heart and life with Allah’s noor, making every step to the masjid a way to get Barakah, light, and blessings in Amal and Iman.
points: Allahumma in dua e noor brings light to the heart and makes Amal shine bright.
Dua for light helps a muslim’s face and words glow with noor from Allah always.
Noor dua for going to the mosque keeps the path safe and brings Barakah in Salah.
Prayer for light gives strength to Iman and helps see right from wrong every day.
Dua for noor on face lets a muslim feel Allah’s mercy in every part of life and namaz.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Going to the Mosque
when_to_recite.description: This dua for going to the mosque fills your heart with noor, asking Allah for light in every step, on your face, and in your amal, making your way to salah full of Barakah and blessings.
points: Before leaving your house, recite the dua for going to the mosque for noor and guidance.
While walking to the masjid, use the dua e noor to ask Allah for light in your path.
As you enter the mosque, say the dua for light to fill your heart and face with noor.
When feeling weak in Iman, make the dua for noor on face before joining jamaah.
If you want more Barakah in your namaz, recite the noor dua before starting your salah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for going to the mosque
how_to_perform.description: This dua for going to the mosque, known as dua e noor, is a beautiful prayer for light and guidance. Reciting this dua noor brings Barakah and helps fill your heart and face with noor before entering Allah’s house.
steps: Make fresh wudu at home and as you step out, softly recite this dua for going to the mosque.
Walk towards the masjid with calm steps and keep saying the dua e noor in your heart.
Before entering the mosque door, pause and repeat the noor dua asking Allah for light.
While waiting for salah, quietly say the dua for noor on face and ask for more Barakah.
After finishing your namaz, thank Allah for the chance to pray and remember this muslim prayer for light.

data.title: Dua For Going To The Masjid
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُورًا، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا، وَعَظِّمْ لِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُورًا، اَللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي عَصَبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُورًا، وَفِي دَمِي نُورا، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُورًا
data.transliteration: Allaahummaj'al fee qalbee nooran, wa fee lisaaanee nooran, wa fee sam'ee nooran, wa fee basaree nooran, wa min fawqee nooran, wa min tahtee nooran, wa 'an yameenee nooran, wa 'an shimaalee nooran, wa min 'amaamee nooran, wa min khalfee nooran, waj'al fee nafsee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran, wa 'adhdhim lee nooran, waj'al lee nooran, waj'alnee nooran, Allaahumma 'a'tinee nooran, waj'al fee 'asabee nooran, wafee lahmee nooran, wafee damee nooran, wa fee sha'ree nooran, wa fee basharee nooran.
data.translation: O Allah, place light in my heart, and on my tongue light, and in my ears light and in my sight light, and above me light, and below me light, and to my right light, and to my left light, and before me light and behind me light. Place in my soul light. Magnify for me light, and amplify for me light. Make for me light and make me a light. O Allah, grant me light, and place light in my nerves, and in my body light and in my blood light and in my hair light and in my skin light.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَى حَاجَتَهُ، غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ نَامَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَأَتَى الْقِرْبَةَ فَأَطْلَقَ شِنَاقَهَا، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا بَيْنَ وُضُوءَيْنِ لَمْ يُكْثِرْ، وَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ، فَصَلَّى، فَقُمْتُ فَتَمَطَّيْتُ كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يَرَى أَنِّي كُنْتُ أَتَّقِيهِ، فَتَوَضَّأْتُ، فَقَامَ يُصَلِّي، فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، فَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي فَأَدَارَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، فَتَتَامَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ فَنَامَ حَتَّى نَفَخَ ـ وَكَانَ إِذَا نَامَ نَفَخَ ـ فَآذَنَهُ بِلاَلٌ بِالصَّلاَةِ، فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ، وَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُعَائِهِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَسَارِي نُورًا، وَفَوْقِي نُورًا، وَتَحْتِي نُورًا، وَأَمَامِي نُورًا، وَخَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا ‏" ‏‏.‏ قَالَ كُرَيْبٌ وَسَبْعٌ فِي التَّابُوتِ‏.‏ فَلَقِيتُ رَجُلاً مِنْ وَلَدِ الْعَبَّاسِ فَحَدَّثَنِي بِهِنَّ، فَذَكَرَ عَصَبِي وَلَحْمِي وَدَمِي وَشَعَرِي وَبَشَرِي، وَذَكَرَ خَصْلَتَيْنِ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: One night I slept at the house of Maimuna. The Prophet (ﷺ) woke up, answered the call of nature, washed his face and hands, and then slept. He got up (late at night), went to a water skin, opened the mouth thereof and performed ablution not using much water, yet he washed all the parts properly and then offered the prayer. I got up and straightened my back in order that the Prophet (ﷺ) might not feel that I was watching him, and then I performed the ablution, and when he got up to offer the prayer, I stood on his left. He caught hold of my ear and brought me over to his right side. He offered thirteen rak`at in all and then lay down and slept till he started blowing out his breath as he used to do when he slept. In the meantime Bilal informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of the approaching time for the (Fajr) prayer, and the Prophet offered the Fajr (Morning) prayer without performing new ablution. He used to say in his invocation, Allahumma ij`al fi qalbi nuran wa fi basari nuran, wa fi sam`i nuran, wa`an yamini nuran, wa`an yasari nuran, wa fawqi nuran, wa tahti nuran, wa amami nuran, wa khalfi nuran, waj`al li nuran." Kuraib (a sub narrator) said, "I have forgotten seven other words, (which the Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned in this invocation). I met a man from the offspring of Al-`Abbas and he narrated those seven things to me, mentioning, '(Let there be light in) my nerves, my flesh, my blood, my hair and my body,' and he also mentioned two other things." [Bukhari: 6316]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Going to the Masjid
benefits.description: This dua for going to the masjid fills a muslim’s heart, body, and soul with Allah’s noor, making every step to the mosque a way to get Barakah, light, and blessings in Amal and Iman.

Noor dua for going to the masjid helps a muslim’s Amal shine with Barakah.
Dua for noor face lets a muslim’s words and actions glow with Allah’s mercy.
Dua for going to the mosque keeps the path safe and Iman strong every day.
Dua for light gives hope for forgiveness and makes Salah full of blessings.

when_to_recite.description: This dua for going to the masjid asks Allah for noor in every part of your life, filling your heart, body, and soul with light as you walk to salah, making your amal and Iman shine bright.
points: Before stepping out for salah, recite the dua for going to the masjid for noor.

how_to_perform.description: This dua for going to the masjid, called the dua of light, is a special muslim prayer asking Allah for noor in every part of your life. Reciting this dua noor brings peace, Barakah, and helps you walk to the mosque with a clean heart.

Take each step to the masjid with the dua of light in your heart and lips, asking for noor.

While waiting for namaz, keep saying the noor dua softly and ask for more Barakah in your Amal.

data.title: Dua When Entering Masjid (Wassalatu Wassalamu)
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
data.transliteration: Bismillaahi, Wassalaatu Wassalaamu 'alaa Rasoolillaah. Allahum-maftah lee 'abwaaba rahmatik.
data.translation: In the Name of Allah, And blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). O Allah, open before me the doors of Your mercy.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حُمَيْدٍ، أَوْ أَبَا أُسَيْدٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ لْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ فَإِذَا خَرَجَ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Usaid al-Ansari reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying: when any of you enters the mosque he should invoke blessing on the prophet (ﷺ) and then he should say: O Allah, open to me the gates of thy mercy. And when he goes out, he should say: O Allah, I ask thee out of Thine abundance. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 465, Muslim: 713]

Dua enter mosque opens the doors of Allah’s Rahmah for the one who enters.

Dua before entering mosque helps a muslim start Salah with a clean heart.
Entering mosque dua makes the masjid a place of mercy and Iman for muslims.

As you reach the masjid door, use the dua for entering masjid to seek Barakah.
When feeling the need for forgiveness, say the dua enter mosque before your first step.
If you want your salah to be accepted, make the dua before entering mosque for blessings.

how_to_perform.description: This dua when entering masjid is a simple muslim prayer that asks Allah to open His doors of mercy for you. Saying this dua for entering masjid brings Barakah and helps you remember Rasulullah, peace be upon him, before every salah.

As you step inside, remember to send peace and blessings on Rasulullah, peace be upon him.
Stand still for a moment and ask Allah to open the doors of His mercy with this dua.
Before you start your sunnah salah, repeat the dua for entering mosque to keep your heart clean.

data.title: Dua For Entering Mosque (Allahumma Salli Ala Muhammad)
data.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to say when he entered the mosque:
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
data.transliteration: Bismillaahi, Allaahumma salli 'ala muhammad, Allaahummaf ta'hlii abwaba ra'hmatik
data.translation: In the Name of Allah, Ya Allah please send blessings and peace upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). O Allah, open before me the doors of Your mercy.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ، - أَوْ عَنْ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ، - قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا خَرَجَ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ يَحْيَى يَقُولُ كَتَبْتُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ مِنْ كِتَابِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ يَحْيَى الْحِمَّانِيَّ يَقُولُ وَأَبِي أُسَيْدٍ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Usaid reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you enters the mosque, he should say: " O Allah! open for me the doors of Thy mercy" ; and when he steps out he should say: 'O Allah! I beg of Thee Thy Grace." (Imam Muslim said: I heard Yahya saying: I transcribed this hadith from the compilation of Sulaiman b. Bilal.) Sahih Muslim 713a [Hasan (Albani). Ibn Sunni: 88, Muslim: 713]

Doors of Allah’s Rahmah open for the muslim who uses dua entering mosque.
Bismillah in masjid enter dua keeps Iman strong and Amal pure before Salah.
Entering mosque dua helps muslims remember the Prophet ﷺ and his Sunnah.
Masjid me dakhil hone ki dua protects from evil and keeps mind ready for namaz.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Entering Mosque
when_to_recite.description: This dua for entering mosque brings Barakah and mercy as you step inside, asking Allah to open His doors of Rahmah and sending peace on Muhammad ﷺ with every entry to the masjid.
points: Before your first step inside, recite the dua for entering mosque for Allah’s Rahmah.
As you touch the masjid door, use the dua entering mosque to seek Barakah and blessings.
When you want to follow sunnah, say allahumma salli ala muhammad before entering mosque.
If you feel your heart needs peace, make the masjid enter dua before joining the jamaah.
While entering for salah, recite the dua before entering mosque to ask for Allah’s mercy.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for entering mosque
how_to_perform.description: This dua for entering mosque is a short and blessed muslim prayer that brings Allah’s mercy and sends peace on Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him. Reciting this dua entering masjid fills your heart with Barakah and keeps your niyyah pure before salah.
steps: Step into the mosque with your right foot and quietly say bismillah and the dua for entering mosque.
As you walk inside, send blessings by saying allahumma salli ala muhammad with full Iman.
Stand for a moment and ask Allah to open the doors of His mercy using this masjid enter dua.
Before starting your sunnah prayer, repeat the dua entering mosque to keep your Amal clean.
While waiting for jamaat, remember this masjid me dakhil hone ki dua and ask for more Barakah.

data.title: Dua To Enter Mosque (Rabbighfirli dhunubi)
data.introduction: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered the mosque he would say Durood. Then Say:
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوْبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
data.transliteration: Rabbig-firli dhunubi waftah li abwaaba rahmatik
data.translation: O Allah, forgive me my sins and open to me the gates of Your mercy.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا خَرَجَ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ فَضْلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated that Fatimah the daughter of the Messenger of Allah said: "Whenever the Messenger of Allah entered the mosque he would say: 'Bismillah, was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah, Allahummagh-firli dhunubi waftah li abwaba rahmatika. (In the Name of Allah, and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, forgive me my sins and open to me the gates of Your mercy).' When he left he would say: 'Bismillah, was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah, Allahummagh-firli dhunubi waftah li abwaba fadlika. (In the Name of Allah, and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, forgive me my sins and open to me the gates of Your bounty).'" [Sahih (Albani). Ibn Majah: 771]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua to Enter Mosque

Asking for forgiveness in masjid enter dua helps muslims clean their Amal.
Dua entering mosque opens doors of Rahmah and makes Iman stronger.
Masjid me dakhil hone ki dua keeps heart soft and ready for namaz and zikr.
Istighfar in dua for entering mosque helps muslims get Allah’s blessings always.

points: Entering the masjid, read the dua to enter mosque for Allah’s forgiveness and mercy.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua to enter mosque
how_to_perform.description: This dua to enter mosque is a simple forgiveness prayer in Islam, asking Allah to forgive your sins and open His doors of mercy. Reciting this dua before entering masjid brings Barakah and helps you start your namaz with a clean heart.

data.title: Dua Before Entering The Mosque (Auzubillah)
data.introduction: If some hadiths are combined, the Dua for entering the mosque will be as follows:
data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيْمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
data.transliteration: A'oodhu billahil-Aatheem wa bi wajhihil-kareem wa sultanihil-qadeem minash-shaytanir-rajeem, bismil-lahi, wassalatu wassalamu 'Aala rasoolil-lah, Allaahumma iftah lee abwaaba rahmatik
data.translation: I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حُمَيْدٍ، أَوْ أَبَا أُسَيْدٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ لْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ فَإِذَا خَرَجَ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Usaid al-Ansari reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying: when any of you enters the mosque he should invoke blessing on the prophet (ﷺ) and then he should say: O Allah, open to me the gates of thy mercy. And when he goes out, he should say: O Allah, I ask thee out of Thine abundance. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 465, 466]

data.title: Dua For Leaving Masjid (Allahumma Inni As Aluka)
data.introduction: If some hadiths are combined, the Dua for going out the mosque will be as follows:
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
data.transliteration: Bismillahi Allaahumma salli 'ala muhammad, Allaahumma inni as-aluka min fadlik
data.translation: In the name of Allah (I am going out).Oh Allah! Please send bessings and peace upon muhammad (ﷺ). Oh Allah! I want from your bounty.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ، - أَوْ عَنْ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ، - قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا خَرَجَ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ يَحْيَى يَقُولُ كَتَبْتُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ مِنْ كِتَابِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ يَحْيَى الْحِمَّانِيَّ يَقُولُ وَأَبِي أُسَيْدٍ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Usaid reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you enters the mosque, he should say: " O Allah! open for me the doors of Thy mercy" ; and when he steps out he should say: 'O Allah! I beg of Thee Thy Grace." (Imam Muslim said: I heard Yahya saying: I transcribed this hadith from the compilation of Sulaiman b. Bilal.) Sahih Muslim 713a [Hasan (Albani). Ibn Sunni: 88, Muslim: 713]

data.title: Dua When Leaving Masjid (Wassalatu Wassalamu)
data.introduction: Start with the left foot and say-
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، اَللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
data.transliteration: Bismillaahi wassalaatu wassalaamu 'alaa Rasoolillaah, Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka min fadhlik, Allaahumma'simnee minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem.
data.translation: In the Name of Allah, and peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). O Allah, I ask for Your favor, O Allah, protect me from Satan the outcast.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدٌ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَإِذَا خَرَجَ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ وَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that: The Mesenger of Allah said: "When anyone of enters the mosque, let him send peace upon the Prophet, then let him say: 'Allahumma aftahli abwaba rahmatik (O Allah, open to me the gates of Your mercy).' And when he leaves, let him send peace upon the Prophet and say: 'Allahumma- simni minash-shaitanir-rajim (O Allah, protect me from the accursed Shaitan).'" [Sahih (Albani). Ibn Majah: 773]

data.title: Masjid Leaving Dua (Allahummaghfirli)
data.introduction: When someone leaves the mosque, he should send a durood on the Prophet (ﷺ) and say:
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوْبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ فَضْلِكَ
data.transliteration: Allaahummaghfirli dhunubi, waftahli abwaba fadlik
data.translation: O Lord pardon my sins, and open the gates of Your blessings for me.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا خَرَجَ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ فَضْلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated that Fatimah the daughter of the Messenger of Allah said: "Whenever the Messenger of Allah entered the mosque he would say: 'Bismillah, was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah, Allahummagh-firli dhunubi waftah li abwaba rahmatika. (In the Name of Allah, and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, forgive me my sins and open to me the gates of Your mercy).' When he left he would say: 'Bismillah, was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah, Allahummagh-firli dhunubi waftah li abwaba fadlika. (In the Name of Allah, and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, forgive me my sins and open to me the gates of Your bounty).'" [Sahih (Albani). Ibn Majah: 771]

When you reach the masjid exit, use the masjid leaving dua to ask for rizq and Barakah.
As you step outside, say allahummaghfirli for forgiveness and new blessings in your day.
If you feel your heart heavy with sins, make this forgiveness dua while leaving the mosque.
While leaving after any fard prayer, remember the mosque dua to seek Allah’s mercy and success.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Masjid Leaving Dua
how_to_perform.description: When you step out from the masjid, saying the masjid leaving dua brings Barakah and keeps your heart close to Allah. This simple dua upon leaving the mosque asks for forgiveness and Allah’s blessings, making every exit a moment of hope and Iman.
steps: Stand at the masjid door and quietly recite allahummaghfirli with full focus.
After finishing your salah, remember to say this leaving mosque dua before stepping out.
If you are with family or friends, softly say the masjid leaving dua together for more Barakah.
When you feel the need for forgiveness in Islam, use this dua for forgiveness and rizq dua.
As you walk away from the mosque, keep repeating this Muslim prayer for Allah’s mercy and success.

data.title: Dua for the one who announces lost items in the mosque
data.introduction: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When you see someone announcing about something lost then say:
data.arabic: لَا رَدَّهَا اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ
data.transliteration: laa raddahAllahu 'alaik
data.translation:
May Allah not return it to you.

This is because the mosques were not built for this purpose.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْخَلاَّلُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَارِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ خُصَيْفَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ مَنْ يَبِيعُ أَوْ يَبْتَاعُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقُولُوا لاَ أَرْبَحَ اللَّهُ تِجَارَتَكَ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ مَنْ يَنْشُدُ فِيهِ ضَالَّةً فَقُولُوا لاَ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى حَدِيثُ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ ‏.‏ وَالْعَمَلُ عَلَى هَذَا عِنْدَ بَعْضِ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ كَرِهُوا الْبَيْعَ وَالشِّرَاءَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏ وَهُوَ قَوْلُ أَحْمَدَ وَإِسْحَاقَ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ رَخَّصَ بَعْضُ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ فِي الْبَيْعِ وَالشِّرَاءِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When you see someone selling or buying in the Masjid then say: 'May Allah not profit your business.' And when you see someone announcing about something lost then say: 'May Allah not return it to you.'" The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is Hasan Gharib. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. They dislike selling and buying in the Masjid. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge permitted selling and buying in the Masjid. [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 1321]

Masjid dua reminds Muslims to respect Allah’s house and its calmness.
Dua for lost things teaches the right way to act when losing something in masjid.
Lost item dua keeps the focus on Salah and zikr allah inside the mosque.
Islamic dua for missing things helps Muslims follow sunnah and good manners.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Mosque Dua for Lost Items
when_to_recite.description: This mosque dua is said when someone announces a lost item inside the masjid, reminding us to keep Allah’s house for zikr and salah, not for lost and found matters.
points: When a person calls out for lost and found in the masjid, recite this mosque dua.
If someone announces a missing thing during salah time, use the masjid dua for lost item.
While hearing anyone searching for lost things in the mosque, say the dua for lost things.
After someone interrupts zikr allah with a lost item call, make this dua for losing something.
If you see someone looking for missing things in the masjid, remember the dua for lost item.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Mosque Dua for Lost Items Announcer
how_to_perform.description: When someone shouts about lost things inside the masjid, this mosque dua teaches us the right way to answer. It helps keep the masjid pure for zikr allah and reminds us to follow the Sunnah in every action.
steps: Listen for anyone calling out about lost and found or lost item inside the masjid.
Respond by saying laa raddahAllahu 'alaik as taught in this masjid dua.
Remind others kindly that the mosque is not for lost and found, but for zikr allah.
Use this dua for lost things only when someone breaks the rule and announces in the masjid.
Keep your heart clean and follow this Muslim prayer to protect the respect of the mosque.

data.title: Dua for the person who trades in the mosque
data.introduction: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When you see someone selling or buying in the Masjid then say:
data.arabic: لَا أَرْبَحَ اللَّهُ تِجَارَتَكَ
data.transliteration: laa arba'ha Allahu tijaarataka
data.translation:
May Allah not profit your business.

This is because the mosques were not built for this purpose.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْخَلاَّلُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَارِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ خُصَيْفَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ مَنْ يَبِيعُ أَوْ يَبْتَاعُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقُولُوا لاَ أَرْبَحَ اللَّهُ تِجَارَتَكَ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ مَنْ يَنْشُدُ فِيهِ ضَالَّةً فَقُولُوا لاَ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى حَدِيثُ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ ‏.‏ وَالْعَمَلُ عَلَى هَذَا عِنْدَ بَعْضِ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ كَرِهُوا الْبَيْعَ وَالشِّرَاءَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏ وَهُوَ قَوْلُ أَحْمَدَ وَإِسْحَاقَ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ رَخَّصَ بَعْضُ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ فِي الْبَيْعِ وَالشِّرَاءِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When you see someone selling or buying in the Masjid then say: 'May Allah not profit your business.' And when you see someone announcing about something lost then say: 'May Allah not return it to you.'" The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is Hasan Gharib. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. They dislike selling and buying in the Masjid. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge permitted selling and buying in the Masjid. [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 1321]

benefits.title: Benefits of Masjid Dua for Trading in Mosque
benefits.description: This masjid dua reminds Muslims to keep the mosque pure for Salah and zikr allah, teaching the right way to respect Allah’s house and keep business outside its doors.
points: Masjid dua helps Muslims remember not to mix business with Salah and Amal.
Mosque dua keeps the house of Allah safe from noise and trading talks.
Islamic business rules are followed when Muslims avoid trading in masjid.
Karobar ki dua teaches respect for masjid and brings Barakah in halal business.
Masnoon dua helps Muslims focus on prayer and zikr allah inside the mosque.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Masjid Dua for Trading
when_to_recite.description: This masjid dua is said when someone does business inside the mosque, reminding us to keep the masjid for zikr allah and salah, not for trading or karobar ki dua.
points: When a person starts trading in the masjid, recite this masjid dua for halal business.
If you see someone doing business talks after salah, use the mosque dua for trading.
While hearing anyone selling things inside the masjid, say the masjid dua for Islamic business.
After someone interrupts namaz with business deals, make this dua for karobar ki dua.
If you notice business happening in the mosque, remember the masjid dua to keep the place pure.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Masjid Dua for Trading in Mosque
how_to_perform.description: When someone tries to do business inside the masjid, this masjid dua reminds us to keep the mosque for zikr allah and not for trading. It helps protect the masjid’s respect and teaches the right way to act in Allah’s house.

Say laa arba'ha Allahu tijaarataka softly as this masjid dua guides for such times.
Remind the person kindly that Islamic business should not happen in the masjid.
