Recite the allahumma inna nasta inuka part slowly, thinking about its deep meaning.
Ask for Allah’s help and forgiveness by reading the dua e qunoot with care and focus.
When you finish, show your surrender to Allah by lowering your hands and bowing your head.
Try to learn the dua qunut transliteration so your Amal in witr namaz brings more Barakah.

data.title: Dua before Tahajjud (Last 10 verses of Surah AL Imran)
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to get up from his bed and recite the last ruku' of Surah Ali-Imran. [1]
data.arabic: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لِّأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ ﴿١٩٠﴾ الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّـهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَـٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ ﴿١٩١﴾ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ ﴿١٩٢﴾ رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا ۚ رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ ﴿١٩٣﴾ رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ ﴿١٩٤﴾فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لَا أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ ۖ بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ ۖ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا وَأُخْرِجُوا مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُوا فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُوا وَقُتِلُوا لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ثَوَابًا مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّـهِ ۗ وَاللَّـهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ ﴿١٩٥﴾ لَا يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ ﴿١٩٦﴾ مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۚ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ ﴿١٩٧﴾ لَـٰكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلًا مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّـهِ ۗ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّـهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلْأَبْرَارِ ﴿١٩٨﴾ وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّـهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّـهِ لَا يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّـهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۗ أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ ﴿١٩٩﴾ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ﴿٢٠٠﴾
data.transliteration: Inna fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ardi wakhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari la-aayaatil-li-ulil-albaab. Allazeena yazkuroonallaaha qiyaaman wa qu'oodan wa 'alaa junoobihim wa yatafakkaroona fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ardi Rabbanaa maa khalaqta haazaa baatilan Subhaanaka faqinaa 'azaaban-Naar. Rabbanaa innaka man tudkhilin-Naara faqad akhzaitahoo wa maa lizzaalimeena min ansaar. Rabbanaa innanaa sami'naa munaadiyan yunaadee lil-eemaani an aaminoo bi-Rabbikum fa-aamannaa; Rabbanaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wa kaffir 'annaa sayyi-aatinaa wa tawaffanaa ma'al-abraar. Rabbanaa wa aatinaa maa wa'adtanaa 'alaa rusulika wa laa tukhzinaa Yawmal-Qiyaamah; innaka laa tukhliful-mee'aad. Fastajaaba lahum Rabbuhum annee laaa udee'u 'amala 'aamilim-minkum min zakarin aw unthaa; ba'dukum min ba'd; fallazeena haajaroo wa ukhrijoo min diyaarihim wa oozoo fee sabeelee wa qaataloo wa qutiloo la-ukaffiranna 'anhum sayyi-aatihim wa la-udkhilannahum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar; thawaaban min 'indillaah; wallaahu 'indahoo husnuth-thawaab. Laa yaghurrannaka taqallubul-lazeena kafaroo fil-bilaad. Mataa'un qaleelun thumma ma'waahum Jahannamu wa bi'sal-mihaad. Laakinil-lazeena-ttaqaw Rabbahum lahum jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa nuzulan min 'indillaah; wa maa 'indallaahi khairul-lil-abraar. Wa inna min Ahlil-Kitaabi laman yu'minu billaahi wa maaa unzila ilaikum wa maaa unzila ilaihim khaashi'eena lillaahi laa yashtaroona bi-aayaatillaahi thamanan qaleelaa; ulaaa'ika lahum ajruhum 'inda Rabbihim; innallaaha saree'ul-hisaab. Yaaa ayyuhal-lazeena aamanus-biroo wa saabiroo wa raabitoo wattaqullaaha la'allakum tuflihoon.
data.translation:
(190) Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding. (191) Who remember Allah while standing or sitting or [lying] on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying], "Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire. (192) Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers. (193) Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous. (194) Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise." (195) And their Lord responded to them, "Never will I allow to be lost the work of [any] worker among you, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated or were evicted from their homes or were harmed in My cause or fought or were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds, and I will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow as reward from Allah, and Allah has with Him the best reward." (196) Be not deceived by the [uninhibited] movement of the disbelievers throughout the land. (197) [It is but] a small enjoyment; then their [final] refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place. (198) But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as accommodation from Allah . And that which is with Allah is best for the righteous. (199) And indeed, among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah and what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, [being] humbly submissive to Allah . They do not exchange the verses of Allah for a small price. Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, Allah is swift in account. (200) O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful. (Surah Al-Imran 3:190-200)

In another narration, The Prophet (ﷺ) used to get up from his bed and look at the sky and recite the first five verses of the last Ruku' of Surah Ali-Imran. [2]

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، بَاتَ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ، وَهْىَ خَالَتُهُ، فَاضْطَجَعْتُ فِي عَرْضِ وِسَادَةٍ، وَاضْطَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَهْلُهُ فِي طُولِهَا، فَنَامَ حَتَّى انْتَصَفَ اللَّيْلُ أَوْ قَرِيبًا مِنْهُ، فَاسْتَيْقَظَ يَمْسَحُ النَّوْمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى شَنٍّ مُعَلَّقَةٍ، فَتَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي فَصَنَعْتُ مِثْلَهُ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى رَأْسِي، وَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي يَفْتِلُهَا، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَوْتَرَ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى جَاءَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ، خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: Once I passed the night in the house of Maimuna (his aunt). I slept across the bed while Allah's Apostle and his wife slept length-wise. The Prophet (ﷺ) slept till midnight or nearly so and woke up rubbing his face and recited ten verses from Surat "Al-`Imran." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went towards a leather skin and performed ablution in the most perfect way and then stood for the prayer. I did the same and stood beside him. The Prophet (ﷺ) put his right hand on my head, twisted my ear and then prayed two rak`at five times and then ended his prayer with witr. He laid down till the Mu'adh-dhin came then he stood up and offered two rak`at (Sunnah of Fajr prayer) and then went out and offered the Fajr prayer. (See Hadith 183 ) [[1] Bukhari: 992 [2] Sahih (Albani). Nasai: 1626]

benefits.title: Benefits of Last 10 Verses of Surah Al Imran
benefits.description: These last 10 verses of Surah Al Imran fill the heart with hope and Iman, guiding a muslim to remember Allah deeply before tahajjud and ask for forgiveness, mercy, and Jannah.
points: Surah al imran last 10 verses open the door of Allah’s mercy at tahajjud.
Dua before tahajjud brings forgiveness and wipes away old sins from the heart.
Last 10 ayat of al imran help a muslim get Barakah and strong Amal in every day.
Rabbana dua in tahajjud prayer makes the heart soft and full of Allah’s fear.
These verses promise Jannah and reward for those who keep patience and Iman.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Before Tahajjud (Last 10 Verses of Surah Al Imran)
when_to_recite.description: Reciting the last 10 verses of surah al imran before tahajjud fills the heart with Iman and Barakah, reminding us of Allah’s signs and His promise for those who stand in night prayer with hope.
points: At the time you wake up for tahajjud, read the last 10 verses of surah al imran for Barakah.
Before starting your tahajjud salah, recite the dua before tahajjud to seek Allah’s mercy.
When you feel weak in Iman, use surah al imran last 10 verses to ask for forgiveness.
After making wudu for night prayer, recite al imran 191 and the rest for strong Amal.
If you want your tahajjud dua accepted, begin with surah al imran last 10 ayat for Rabbana’s help.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Last 10 Verses of Surah Al Imran
how_to_perform.description: Reciting the last 10 verses of Surah Al Imran before tahajjud is a strong masnoon dua that brings Barakah and helps your Iman grow. These ayat remind us of Allah’s power and mercy, and the best time to read them is before tahajjud salah.
steps: Wake up in the last part of night and sit quietly to read the last 10 verses of surah al imran.
Begin by thinking about Allah’s creation and say the surah al imran last 10 verses with care.
Read the ayat slowly, making dua before tahajjud and asking for forgiveness and Barakah.
After finishing, raise your hands and make rabbana dua for your needs and for your family.
Try to learn the meaning of surah al imran last 10 ayat so your Amal in tahajjud gets more reward.

data.title: When waking up for Tahajjud prayer (Dhikr & Dua)
data.introduction: Say 10 times -
data.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
data.transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar
data.translation: Allah is the greatest.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua Before Tahajjud
benefits.description: Saying Allahu Akbar before tahajjud prayer fills the heart with strength and helps a muslim remember Allah’s greatness in the quiet of night, making every tahajjud more special and full of Barakah.
points: Allahu akbar before tahajjud brings the heart close to Allah’s greatness.
Takbir at night prayer gives a muslim strength and hope for the new day.
Dhikr before tahajjud makes the mind calm and ready for tahajjud ki namaz.
Saying allah is the greatest helps a muslim start tahajjud with pure Iman.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Before Tahajjud
when_to_recite.description: Saying Allahu Akbar as dua before tahajjud wakes the heart for night prayer, brings Barakah, and reminds every Muslim that Allah is the greatest before standing in tahajjud ki namaz.
points: When you first open your eyes for tahajjud, say allahu akbar to start with dhikr.
Before making wudu for tahajjud prayer, say allahu akbar for strong Iman.
As you stand for tahajjud ki namaz, begin with takbir to remember Allah is the greatest.
After finishing your tahajjud dua, repeat allahu akbar for more Barakah in your Amal.
If you feel sleepy at night, say allahu akbar to wake up your heart for night prayer islam.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua before Tahajjud
how_to_perform.description: Saying Allahu Akbar as dhikr before tahajjud prayer is a simple but strong way to remember Allah and get your heart ready for night prayer. This takbir brings Barakah and helps you start tahajjud with Iman and hope.
steps: When you wake up for tahajjud, softly say allahu akbar to remember Allah’s greatness.
Stand up for tahajjud prayer and let the takbir fill your heart with hope and Barakah.
Before you start your tahajjud namaz, repeat allahu akbar as dhikr and clear your mind.
Use this takbir to remind yourself that Allah is the greatest before your night prayer.
Try to keep saying allahu akbar in your heart as you pray tahajjud for more reward.

data.title: Istikhara Dua
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيْرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوْبِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ (وَيُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ) خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِيْنِيْ وَمَعَاشِيْ وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِيْ، فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ. [اَللَّهُمَّ] وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِيْنِيْ وَمَعَاشِيْ وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِيْ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِيْ بِهِ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika, Wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratika, Wa as'aluka min fadlika Al-'azim Fa-innaka taqdiru Wala aqdiru, Wa ta'lamu Wala a'lamu, Wa anta 'allamul-ghuyub. Allaahumma, in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra Khairun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa'aqibati `Amri, Faqdurhu li wa yas-sirhu li thumma barik li Fih, (Allaahumma) Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra shar-run li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa'aqibati `Amri Fasrifhu anni was-rifni anhu. Waqdur li al-khaira haithu kana Thumma ardini bih
data.translation:
O Allah! I ask guidance from Your knowledge, And Power from Your Might and I ask for Your great blessings. You are capable and I am not. You know and I do not and You know the unseen. O Allah! If You know that this job is good for my religion and my subsistence and in my Hereafter. Then You ordain it for me and make it easy for me to get, And then bless me in it, and if You know that this job is harmful to me In my religion and subsistence and in the Hereafter. Then keep it away from me and let me be away from it. And ordain for me whatever is good for me, And make me satisfied with it.

On the authority of Jaabir Ibn 'Adbullaah (RA), he said: The Prophet (ﷺ) would instruct us to pray for guidance in all of our concerns, just as he would teach us a Soorah from the Quran. He would say: 'If any of you intends to undertake a matter then let him pray two supererogatory units [two rak'ah naafilah] of prayer and after which he should supplicate: (the above mentioned dua)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَوَالِي، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَسَنِ يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ السَّلَمِيُّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُ أَصْحَابَهُ الاِسْتِخَارَةَ فِي الأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا، كَمَا يُعَلِّمُ السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا هَمَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بِالأَمْرِ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ الْفَرِيضَةِ ثُمَّ لِيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ هَذَا الأَمْرَ ـ ثُمَّ تُسَمِّيهِ بِعَيْنِهِ ـ خَيْرًا لِي فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ قَالَ أَوْ فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي، وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي، ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، اللَّهُمَّ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ رَضِّنِي بِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah: As-Salami: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to teach his companions to perform the prayer of Istikhara for each and every matter just as he used to teach them the Suras from the Qur'an He used to say, "If anyone of you intends to do some thing, he should offer a two rak`at prayer other than the compulsory prayers, and after finishing it, he should say: O Allah! I consult You, for You have all knowledge, and appeal to You to support me with Your Power and ask for Your Bounty, for You are able to do things while I am not, and You know while I do not; and You are the Knower of the Unseen. O Allah If You know It this matter (name your matter) is good for me both at present and in the future, (or in my religion), in my this life and in the Hereafter, then fulfill it for me and make it easy for me, and then bestow Your Blessings on me in that matter. O Allah! If You know that this matter is not good for me in my religion, in my this life and in my coming Hereafter (or at present or in the future), then divert me from it and choose for me what is good wherever it may be, and make me be pleased with it." (See Hadith No. 391, Vol. 8) Sahih al-Bukhari 7390 [Al-Bukhari 7/162, No. 1162, 7390]

benefits.title: Benefits of Istikhara Dua
benefits.description: This istikhara dua helps a muslim trust Allah’s plan, asking for the best in every matter, and brings peace to the heart when making big or small choices in life.
points: Istikhara dua gives clear guidance from Allah when a muslim feels unsure.
Salatul istikhara brings Barakah and makes hard choices easy for the heart.
Dua for guidance in istikhara keeps a muslim safe from harm and bad Amal.
Istikhara prayer lets Allah pick what is best for deen, dunya, and akhirah.
Dua e istikhara fills the heart with peace and makes a muslim happy with Qadr.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Istikhara Dua
when_to_recite.description: The istikhara dua is a strong prayer for guidance, asking Allah to help you choose what is best for your Deen, Dunya, and Akhirah, and to fill your Amal with Barakah and peace in every step.
points: After praying two rakah of istikhara namaz, recite the istikhara dua for guidance.
When you feel unsure about a big choice, use istikhara dua before making your decision.
At night before going to bed, make dua istikhara for Allah’s help in your heart.
If you want to start something new, read salatul istikhara dua for Barakah and ease.
When your heart feels confused, turn to istikhara prayer and ask with this dua for clarity.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Istikhara Dua
how_to_perform.description: When you feel unsure about a big choice, the istikhara dua is a trusted way to ask Allah for help and Barakah. This dua for guidance is a simple step in Islam that brings peace to your heart and helps you find the best path.
steps: Start by making wudu and pray two rakats of salatul istikhara with pure niyyah for guidance.
After finishing your istikhara prayer, recite the istikhara dua with full hope in Allah’s mercy.
Mention your need or matter clearly in your heart when you reach the part of the dua for guidance.
Trust Allah’s plan and wait for signs or ease in your heart after making this dua e istikhara.
Repeat the istekhara dua for a few nights if you still feel unsure, asking for clear direction from Allah.

data.title: Dua for Repentance after Sin (2 Rakat Prayer)
data.introduction: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a servant commits a sin, then performs ablution properly, then stands up and prays two rak'ats and seeks forgiveness from Allah, Allah will surely forgive him." Then he recited this verse –
data.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فَاحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا لِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَن يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلُوا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ ﴿١٣٥﴾ أُولَٰئِكَ جَزَاؤُهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَجَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ ﴿١٣٦﴾
data.transliteration: Wallazeena izaa fa'aloo faahishatan aw zalamooo anfusahum zakarullaaha fastaghfaroo lizunoobihim wa man yaghfiruz-zunooba illallaahu wa lam yusirroo 'alaa maa fa'aloo wa hum ya'lamoon. Ulaaa'ika jazaaa'uhum maghfiratum-mir-Rabbihim wa jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa; wa ni'ma ajrul-'aamileen.
data.translation: (135) And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except Allah ? - and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know. (136) Those - their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens beneath which rivers flow [in Paradise], wherein they will abide eternally; and excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers. (Sura Ali Imran 3:135-136)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ الأَسَدِيِّ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ الْفَزَارِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا، - رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ - يَقُولُ كُنْتُ رَجُلاً إِذَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدِيثًا نَفَعَنِي اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِمَا شَاءَ أَنْ يَنْفَعَنِي وَإِذَا حَدَّثَنِي أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ اسْتَحْلَفْتُهُ فَإِذَا حَلَفَ لِي صَدَّقْتُهُ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَصَدَقَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ - رضى الله عنه - أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذْنِبُ ذَنْبًا فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏ {‏ وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فَاحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ ‏} ‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated AbuBakr as-Siddiq: Asma' bint al-Hakam said: I heard Ali say: I was a man; when I heard a tradition from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), Allah benefited me with it as much as He willed. But when some one of his companions narrated a tradition to me I adjured him. When he took an oath, I testified him. AbuBakr narrated to me a tradition, and AbuBakr narrated truthfully. He said: I heard the apostle of Allah (ﷺ) saying: When a servant (of Allah) commits a sin, and he performs ablution well, and then stands and prays two rak'ahs, and asks pardon of Allah, Allah pardons him. He then recited this verse: "And those who, when they commit indecency or wrong their souls, remember Allah" (Al-Qur'an 3:135) . [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1521]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Repentance
benefits.description: This dua for repentance after sin helps a muslim turn back to Allah with a clean heart, seeking forgiveness and mercy, and brings hope for Jannah and a new start after every mistake.
points: Dua for repentance brings Allah’s forgiveness and wipes away old sins fast.
Salatul tawbah helps a muslim get Jannah and rivers under it as a reward.
Astaghfirullah in prayer keeps the heart soft and away from repeating sins.
Dua for forgiveness of sins makes Allah’s mercy and Barakah fill daily life.
Repentance in islam gives hope and makes a muslim’s Amal strong and pure.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Repentance
when_to_recite.description: The dua for repentance is a strong way to seek Allah’s forgiveness after sin, bringing Barakah and hope for Jannah to every Muslim who turns back with a soft heart and true tawbah.
points: After making a mistake, pray two rakat salatul tawbah and recite the dua for repentance.
When you feel regret for your sins, use this dua for forgiveness to ask Allah for mercy.
At night before going to bed, make istighfar and read the dua for repentance for peace.
If you remember a past sin, turn to Allah with this dua for forgiveness of all sins.
When your heart feels heavy, recite the prayer of repentance for Allah’s Maghfirah and ease.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Repentance after Sin
how_to_perform.description: When you feel sad for your mistakes, the dua for repentance is a way to ask Allah for forgiveness and mercy. This prayer of repentance helps clean your heart and brings you closer to Allah’s Rahmah.
steps: Begin by making wudu and pray two rakats of salatul tawbah with a true heart for forgiveness.
After finishing your prayer, say astaghfirullah and make sincere dua for forgiveness of all sins.
Remember your mistake and ask Allah to forgive you, promising not to repeat the sin again.
Keep your tongue busy with istighfar and dua tawbah, seeking Allah’s mercy every day.
Try to do good deeds and give sadaqah after your repentance prayer to get more Barakah from Allah.

data.title: Dua for the deceased
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِيْنَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
data.transliteration: Alla-humma'gfir lahu (person's name), warfa'a darajatahu fil mahdiyin, wa'khlufhu fi 'aqibihi fil ga-birin, wagfir lana wa lahu ya rabbal' a-lamin, wafsa'ah lahu fi qabrihi, wa nau-wir lahu fihi
data.translation:
O Allah, forgive him (person's name), raise his degree among those who are rightly guided, grant him a successor in his descendants who remain. Forgive us and him, O Lord of the Universe, and make his grave spacious, and grant him light in it.

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to Abu Salama (RA) (as he died). His eyes were fixedly open. Rasoolullah (ﷺ) closed them, and then said: When the soul is taken away the sight follows it. Some of the people of his family wept and wailed. So he said: Do not supplicate for yourselves anything but good, for angels say "Amen" to what you say. He then said- (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ ذُؤَيْبٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى أَبِي سَلَمَةَ وَقَدْ شَقَّ بَصَرُهُ فَأَغْمَضَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الرُّوحَ إِذَا قُبِضَ تَبِعَهُ الْبَصَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَضَجَّ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَدْعُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ فَإِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ يُؤَمِّنُونَ عَلَى مَا تَقُولُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لأَبِي سَلَمَةَ وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ ‏.‏ وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Umm Salama reported: The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon came to Abu Salama (as he died). His eyes were fixedly open. He closed them, and then said: When the soul is taken away the sight follows it. Some of the people of his family wept and wailed. So he said: Do not supplicate for yourselves anything but good, for angels say" Amen" to what you say. He then said: O Allah, forgive Abu Salama, raise his degree among those who are rightly guided, grant him a successor in his descendants who remain. Forgive us and him, O Lord of the Universe, and make his grave spacious, and grant him light in it. [Muslim: 920]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for the Deceased
benefits.description: This dua for the deceased brings hope and mercy for the one who passed away, asking Allah to forgive, give light in the grave, and raise their place among the guided with Barakah for their family.
points: Dua for the deceased asks Allah to forgive and raise the person’s darajat.
Janazah dua brings light and peace to the grave of the dead muslim.
Prayer for the dead helps the family get Barakah and Allah’s mercy too.
Dua for maghfirat makes Allah forgive both the deceased and those who pray.
Islamic prayer for the dead gives hope for Jannah and rest for the soul.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for the Deceased
when_to_recite.description: The dua for the deceased is a gentle prayer asking Allah for Maghfirah, Barakah, and light in the grave, bringing comfort to the hearts of Muslims who remember loved ones and seek forgiveness for them.
points: After finishing salatul janazah, recite the dua for the deceased for Allah’s mercy.
When you visit a graveyard, use this prayer for the dead to ask for light and ease.
At home after hearing news of someone’s death, make dua for the deceased for Maghfirat.
During your own salah, remember a loved one and recite the dua for forgiveness of sins.
On Fridays, pray the dua for a deceased person to ask ya rabbal alamin for Barakah and peace.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for the Deceased
how_to_perform.description: When someone leaves this world, the dua for the deceased is a way to ask Allah for forgiveness and light for their soul. This islamic prayer for the dead brings comfort to hearts and hope for the person who passed away.
steps: Stand after janazah prayer and softly recite the dua for the deceased with full yaqeen in Allah.
Mention the name of the dead person in your dua for maghfirat, asking Allah to forgive their sins.
Pray for Allah to make their grave wide and fill it with noor, using the words from the janazah dua.
Ask Allah to raise their rank among the guided and give Barakah to their family left behind.
Keep making this prayer for the dead, especially after salah and when you visit their grave for more reward.

data.title: Dua and Sunnah After Janaza Prayer (Hadith)
data.introduction: It is narrated in Sahih Hadith that after burying the dead, it is Sunnah for those present to throw soil three times with both hands. Abu Hurairah (RA) said: "The Prophet (ﷺ) offered a janaza prayer. Then he went to the grave of the dead man and threw soil on him three times from the side of his head."

data.title: Dua when placing the deceased in Grave
data.introduction: Ibn 'Umar (RA) said, "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say this dua when he put the dead body in the grave:
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ (ﷺ)
data.transliteration: Bismillaahi wa 'alaa sunnati Rasulillaah
data.translation: With the Name of Allah and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا وَضَعَ الْمَيِّتَ فِي الْقَبْرِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ هَذَا لَفْظُ مُسْلِمٍ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: When the Prophet (ﷺ) placed the dead in the grave, he said: In the name of Allah, and following the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). This is Muslim's version. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 3213]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Grave
benefits.description: This dua for grave brings peace and Barakah when placing the deceased, following the Sunnah and asking Allah to make the burial easy and full of mercy for the one in the grave.
points: Bismillah at burial keeps the grave safe with Allah’s name and protection.
Dua for grave follows the Sunnah and brings blessings to the dead muslim.
Islamic burial dua helps the soul rest easy and gives hope for Allah’s mercy.
Qabar par mitti dalne ki dua makes the burial simple and full of Barakah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Grave
when_to_recite.description: This dua for grave is said with Iman and respect, asking Allah for mercy and following the Sunnah during muslim burial, as we place our loved one in the grave in the name of Allah.
points: When lowering the body into the grave in islam, recite bismillah and this dua for grave.
At the time of qabar par mitti dalne ki dua, use this islamic burial dua for Barakah.
After salatul janazah prayer, say the dua for funeral before placing the deceased.
While standing by the grave in islam, make this dua for grave with a soft heart.
During muslim burial, remember to recite in the name of allah and follow the Sunnah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua when placing the deceased in Grave
how_to_perform.description: At the time of burial, the dua for grave is a simple but important act in Islamic burial. Saying this masnoon dua brings peace and follows the Sunnah, giving Barakah to the one being buried.
steps: Before lowering the body, quietly say bismillah and remember the Sunnah of Rasulullah.
As you place the deceased in the grave, softly recite the dua for grave with full respect.
Make sure the head faces the qiblah, following the right way of muslim burial in islam.
Ask Allah to give ease and mercy to the person in the grave, using this islamic prayer.
Keep your heart humble and make silent dua for forgiveness as you finish the burial steps.

data.title: Dua when placing the body in Grave
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, ‘When you put death body in grave, say:
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ
data.transliteration: Bismillaahi wa 'alaa millati Rasoolillaah
data.translation:
With the Name of Allah and according to the millat of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).

Sunnah is to place the dead in the grave on his right side. There is no evidence to place the dead on his back and hands on the chest. When giving soil, there is no Dua to recite except Bismillah.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ إِذَا أُدْخِلَ الْمَيِّتُ الْقَبْرَ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو خَالِدٍ مَرَّةً إِذَا وُضِعَ الْمَيِّتُ فِي لَحْدِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ هِشَامٌ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said: “When the deceased was placed in the grave, the Prophet (ﷺ) would say: ‘Bismillah, wa ‘ala millati rasul-illah (In the Name of Allah and according to the religion of the Messenger of Allah).’” Abu Khalid said on one occasion, when the deceased was placed in the grave: “Bismillah wa ‘ala sunnati rasul- illah (In the Name of Allah and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah).” Hisham said in his narration: “Bismillah, wa fi sabil-illah, wa ‘ala millati rasul-illah (In the Name of Allah, for the sake of Allah and according to the religion of the Messenger of Allah).” [Sahih (Albani). Ibn Majah: 1550]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Funeral
benefits.description: This dua for funeral brings comfort and Barakah when placing the body in the grave, following the way of the Messenger of Allah and asking for Allah’s mercy and protection for the deceased.
points: Bismillah at burial gives the grave safety and peace with Allah’s name.
Dua for funeral follows the Messenger of Allah’s way and brings blessings.
Islamic burial dua helps the soul rest easy and keeps the burial simple.
Qabar par mitti dalne ki dua brings hope for Allah’s mercy on the deceased.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Funeral
when_to_recite.description: This dua for funeral is recited with a heart full of Iman, asking Allah for mercy and following the Messenger of Allah’s way as we place the body in the grave in the name of Allah.
points: When placing the body in the grave in Islam, recite this dua for funeral with bismillah.
At the time of qabar par mitti dalne ki dua, use this Islamic burial dua for the deceased.
After finishing funeral prayer in Islam, say the dua for grave before burial starts.
While attending a Muslim funeral service, make this dua for funeral for Barakah and mercy.
During burial in Islam, remember to recite in the name of Allah and follow the Messenger of Allah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua when placing the body in Grave
how_to_perform.description: At the time of burial, the dua for funeral is a short but blessed act that follows the way of the Messenger of Allah. This Islamic burial step brings comfort and Barakah for the person being buried.
steps: Quietly say bismillah before you lower the body, remembering Allah’s name in your heart.
As you place the body in the grave, recite the dua for funeral with full respect and care.
Make sure the body faces the qiblah, following the right way of Muslim burial in Islam.
Ask Allah to give the person ease and forgiveness, using this masnoon dua for grave.
After finishing, keep making silent dua for the deceased, hoping for Allah’s mercy and light.

data.title: Dua when put the body in Grave
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, When you put death body in grave, say:
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
data.transliteration: Bismillahi wa fi sabilillahi wa 'ala millati rasoolillah (ﷺ)
data.translation: With the Name of Allah, in the path of Allah and according to the millat of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ جِئْتُكَ مِنْ عِنْدِ قَوْمٍ مَا يَتَزَوَّدُ لَهُمْ رَاعٍ وَلاَ يَخْطِرُ لَهُمْ فَحْلٌ ‏.‏ فَصَعِدَ الْمِنْبَرَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيئًا طَبَقًا مَرِيعًا غَدَقًا عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ رَائِثٍ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ فَمَا يَأْتِيهِ أَحَدٌ مِنْ وَجْهٍ مِنَ الْوُجُوهِ إِلاَّ قَالُوا قَدْ أُحْيِينَا ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said: “A Bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, I have come to you from people who have no place to graze their flocks and even their male camels have become weak. He mounted the pulpit and praised Allah, then he said: ‘O Allah, send upon us all abundant, wholesome rain, productive and plentiful, sooner rather than later.’ Then the rain came down, and no one came to him from any direction but they said: ‘We have been revived.’” [Sahih (Albani). Ibn Majah: 1270]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for the Dead
benefits.description: This dua for the dead brings peace and mercy when placing the body in the grave, following the path of Allah and the Messenger, and asking for Barakah and safety for the deceased.
points: Bismillah at burial gives the grave protection and Allah’s special care.
Fi sabilillah in this dua shows the burial is done for Allah’s sake only.
Dua for grave follows the Messenger’s way and brings blessings to the dead.
Qabar par mitti dalne ki dua brings hope for Allah’s mercy and forgiveness.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For The Dead
when_to_recite.description: This dua for the dead is recited with Iman and hope, asking Allah for mercy and Barakah as we place the body in the grave, following the path of Allah and the Messenger of Allah in every step.
points: When putting the body in the grave in Islam, recite this dua for the dead with fi sabilillah.
At the time of qabar par mitti dalne ki dua, use this Islamic burial dua for the deceased.
After janaza ki dua, say the dua for grave before the burial is fully done.
While standing by the grave in Islam, make this dua for the dead for Barakah and forgiveness.
During Muslim burial, remember to recite in the name of Allah and follow the Messenger of Allah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for the Dead at Burial
how_to_perform.description: When a Muslim is placed in the grave, this dua for the dead is recited to ask Allah for mercy and to follow the way of the Messenger of Allah. It is a simple masnoon dua that brings Barakah and peace at the time of burial.
steps: Stand by the grave and softly say in the name of Allah fi sabilillah and on the millat of the Messenger of Allah.
As you lower the body, recite this dua for grave to remember the path of Islamic burial.
When putting soil on the grave, say this qabar par mitti dalne ki dua for the dead.
After the burial, make janaza ki dua and ask Allah to forgive the person in the grave.
While leaving the graveyard, remember to do zikr Allah and pray for all Muslims who have passed away.

data.title: Dua for Visiting the Grave (Assalamualaikum ya ahlal quboor)
data.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُسْلِمِيْنَ إِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُوْنَ أَسْاَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
data.transliteration: As-salamu 'alaykum ahlad diyari min al-mu'minina wal-muslimin, inna In sha' Allahu bikum lahikun, as-alullaha lana walakumul 'afiyah
data.translation:
Peace be upon you, the inhabitants of the grave, among the believers, and Muslims, and if Allah will then we shall join you. I pray to Allah peace for us and for you.

Buraida ibnul husaib aslami (RA) narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach them to recite this dua when anyone went to the graveyard.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، الأَسَدِيُّ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُهُمْ إِذَا خَرَجُوا إِلَى الْمَقَابِرِ فَكَانَ قَائِلُهُمْ يَقُولُ - فِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ - السَّلاَمُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الدِّيَارِ - وَفِي رِوَايَةِ زُهَيْرٍ - السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَلَاحِقُونَ أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمْ الْعَافِيَةَ.
hadith.translation: Sulaiman b. Buraida narrated on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach them when they went out to the graveyard. One of the narrators used to say this in the narration transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr: " Peace be upon the inhabitants of the city (i. e. graveyard)." In the hadith transmitted by Zuhair (the words are):" Peace be upon you, the inhabitants of the city, among the believers, and Muslims, and God willing we shall join you. I beg of Allah peace for us and for you." [Muslim: 975]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Visiting the Grave
benefits.description: This dua for visiting the grave brings peace to both the living and those resting, reminding us of our return to Allah and the bond between Muslims even after death.
points: Allah gives Barakah to the one who makes dua for visiting the grave with Iman.
Saying assalamu alaikum ya ahlal kubur brings peace to the people of the grave.
Qabristan jane ki dua helps Muslims remember death and keep Amal strong.
This dua at graveyard asks Allah for safety and mercy for both living and dead.
Using this masnoon dua for graveyard keeps the heart soft and full of zikr Allah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Visiting The Grave
when_to_recite.description: This dua for visiting the grave is recited with a soft heart, sending peace to the believers in the graveyard and asking Allah for safety for both the living and those who have passed away.
points: When entering the graveyard, greet with assalamu alaikum ya ahlal kubur and recite this dua for visiting the grave.
After making intention for qabristan jane ki dua, use this dua for graveyard before any other zikr.
While standing by the graves, say the dua for visiting graves and pray for peace and Barakah.
When leaving the graveyard, remember to recite this dua for visiting the grave for all Muslims.
During any visit to qabristan, make this dua at graveyard for the believers and your own safety.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Visiting the Grave
how_to_perform.description: When you visit the graveyard, this dua for visiting the grave brings peace to the dead and reminds us of our own return to Allah. It is a masnoon dua that every Muslim should say with a soft heart and full Iman.
steps: Enter the graveyard with right foot and greet with assalamu alaikum ya ahlal kubur.
Stand near the graves and recite this dua for visiting graves for the believers resting there.
While walking between graves, quietly say this dua for graveyard and remember your own end.
Raise your hands and ask Allah for safety and Barakah for both you and those in the graves.
Before leaving, make qabristan ki dua and pray for all Muslims buried in the graveyard.

data.title: Dua for Entering Graveyard (Masnoon Dua)
data.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُسْلِمِيْنَ وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقْدِمِيْنَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتَأْخِرِيْنَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَلَاحِقُونَ
data.transliteration: As-salamu 'ala ahlid diya-ri minal mu’minin wal muslimin, wa yarhamullahul mustaq’dimina minna-wal mustakhirin, wa inna- insa allahu bikum lala-’hiqun
data.translation:
Peace be upon the inhabitants of this place among the believers and Muslims. May Allah have mercy upon those who have gone on ahead of us and those who come later on, and we will join you, if Allah wills.

A’isha (RA) asked Allah’s messenger (ﷺ) what she should say, i.e. when visiting graves, and he told her to say (The Dua is mentioned above).

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: "وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: كَيْفَ أَقُولُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ تَعْنِي فِي زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ قَالَ: "" قُولِي: السَّلَامُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ للاحقون "" . رَوَاهُ مُسلم
hadith.translation: She said she asked God’s messenger what she should say, i.e. when visiting graves, and he told her to say, “Peace be upon the inhabitants of the abodes, believers and Muslims, and God show mercy to those of us who go before and those who go later. If God will we shall join you."" Muslim transmitted it. [Sahih (Albani). Mishkatul Masabih: 1767]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Entering Graveyard
benefits.description: This dua for entering graveyard reminds Muslims of the shortness of life, brings mercy for those who passed, and keeps the heart soft with hope in Allah’s forgiveness and kindness.
points: Allah shows Rahmah to Muslims who use this dua for entering graveyard.
Masnoon dua for dead person brings maghfirat for those resting in qabristan.
This dua for forgiveness in Islam helps Muslims remember their own akhirah.
Qabristan ki dua keeps the heart full of zikr Allah and Amal for the dead.
Using this masnoon dua at graveyard asks Allah to forgive both early and late ones.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Entering Graveyard
when_to_recite.description: This dua for entering graveyard is recited with Iman, sending peace to the believers resting in qabristan and asking Allah for forgiveness and mercy for those who passed and those still living.
points: When stepping into the graveyard, recite this dua for entering graveyard for all Muslims.
After reaching qabristan, use this masnoon dua for dead and pray for maghfirat.
While walking among the graves, say the dua for graveyard and ask Allah for forgiveness in Islam.
When visiting for dua for dead person, make this dua for entering graveyard for Barakah.
During any visit to qabristan, remember to recite this dua for grave and mercy for all.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Entering Graveyard
how_to_perform.description: When you step into the qabristan, this dua for entering graveyard is a way to greet the dead and ask Allah for forgiveness for all. It is a masnoon dua that brings Barakah and reminds us of our own return to Allah.
steps: Enter the graveyard with right foot and say this masnoon dua for dead with a soft voice.
Stand still and recite dua for maghfirat, asking Allah to forgive those in the graves.
Remember to pray for both early and late Muslims by saying this dua for forgiveness in Islam.
While walking, quietly repeat this dua for graveyard and think about your own akhirah.
Before leaving, make dua for dead person and ask Allah to give mercy to all buried in qabristan.

data.title: Dua for Visiting the Grave (Graveyard Dua)
data.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِيْنَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُوْنَ
data.transliteration: As-salamu 'alaikum dara qaumin mu’minin, wa inna-insha- allahu bikum la-‘hikun
data.translation:
Peace be upon you, O you who believe. We will meet you, if Allah willing.

Abu Hurairah said, "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to the graveyard and said these words."

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَسُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، - قَالَ ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَلاَءُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَى الْمَقْبُرَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ وَدِدْتُ أَنَّا قَدْ رَأَيْنَا إِخْوَانَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا أَوَلَسْنَا إِخْوَانَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتُمْ أَصْحَابِي وَإِخْوَانُنَا الَّذِينَ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا كَيْفَ تَعْرِفُ مَنْ لَمْ يَأْتِ بَعْدُ مِنْ أُمَّتِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً لَهُ خَيْلٌ غُرٌّ مُحَجَّلَةٌ بَيْنَ ظَهْرَىْ خَيْلٍ دُهْمٍ بُهْمٍ أَلاَ يَعْرِفُ خَيْلَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَأْتُونَ غُرًّا مُحَجَّلِينَ مِنَ الْوُضُوءِ وَأَنَا فَرَطُهُمْ عَلَى الْحَوْضِ أَلاَ لَيُذَادَنَّ رِجَالٌ عَنْ حَوْضِي كَمَا يُذَادُ الْبَعِيرُ الضَّالُّ أُنَادِيهِمْ أَلاَ هَلُمَّ ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ إِنَّهُمْ قَدْ بَدَّلُوا بَعْدَكَ ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ سُحْقًا سُحْقًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to the graveyard and said: "Peace be upon you! The abode of the believing people and we, if God so wills, are about to join you. I love to see my brothers." They (the hearers) said: Aren't we your brothers, O Messenger of Allah? He said: You are my companions, and our brothers are those who have, so far, not come into the world. They said: Messenger of Allah, how would you recognise those persons of your Ummah who have not yet been born? He said: Supposing a man had horses with white blazes on foreheads and legs among horses which were all black, tell me, would he not recognise his own horses? They said: Certainly, O Messenger of Allah. He said: They would come with white faces and arms and legs owing to ablution, and I would arrive at the Cistern before them. Some people would be driven away from my Cistern as the stray camel is driven away. I would call out: Come, come. Then it would be said (to me): These people changed themselves after you, and I would say: Be off, be off. Sahih Muslim 249a [Muslim: 249]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Visiting the Grave
benefits.description: This dua for visiting the graveyard brings peace to the hearts, connects believers, and reminds us of our own return to Allah, making every visit full of hope and kindness.
points: Allah gives peace to the dead when Muslims say assalamualaikum at graveyard.
Using this dua for visiting the grave keeps Iman strong and hearts soft with zikr.
Qabristan ki dua helps Muslims remember insha allah we all meet again one day.
This dua for the dead brings hope of maghfirat and mercy for those resting.
Saying peace be upon you at graveyard keeps the bond of Muslims alive always.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Visiting the Grave
when_to_recite.description: This dua for visiting the grave brings peace to the hearts, reminds us of the hereafter, and helps us send Barakah and dua e maghfirat for the deceased with true Iman and hope in Allah’s mercy.
points: When entering the graveyard, greet with assalamualaikum and recite this dua for visiting the grave.
While standing near a loved one's grave, use the graveyard dua to ask Allah for peace.
After finishing your ziarat, say the dua for deceased and remember insha allah we will meet.
On Fridays, many Muslims visit qabristan and make this dua for the dead with hope for maghfirat.
If you pass by a grave while walking, quietly recite peace be upon you and make dua for graveyard.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Visiting the Grave
how_to_perform.description: When you visit the graveyard, this dua for visiting the grave is said to greet the believers and remember our own meeting with them, insha allah. It is a simple Islamic dua that brings peace and Barakah to the dead.
steps: Enter the graveyard and softly say assalamualaikum to the believers resting there.
Stand by the grave and recite peace be upon you, remembering the meaning of this dua.
While walking between graves, quietly say this dua for the dead and think of your own end.
Raise your hands and make dua e maghfirat for all deceased Muslims in the graveyard.
Before leaving, repeat alaikum salam and pray insha allah for mercy on all buried in qabristan.

data.title: Dua for Visiting Muslim Graves (Graveyard Dua)
data.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَأَتَاكُمْ مَا تُوعَدُونَ غَدًا مُؤَجَّلُونَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَهْلِ بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ
data.transliteration: As-salamu 'alaikum da-ra kaumin mu’minin, wa ata-kum ma-tu’aadun ‘gadan muajjalun, wa inna-insha- allahu bikum la-’hikun. Alla-humma’gfir liahli baki‘eil garqad.
data.translation:
Peace be upon you, O you who believers inhabitants of the grave! The promise that was given to you has come to you, and you are waiting for the day to come. And we will meet you by the will of Allah. O Allah, forgive the inhabitants of the Baqi graveyard.

Ayesha (RA) said, "When Rasoolullah (ﷺ) stayed in my house, he used to go to the Baqi' graveyard at the last hour of night and say these words.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي نَمِرٍ - عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - كُلَّمَا كَانَ لَيْلَتُهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - يَخْرُجُ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ إِلَى الْبَقِيعِ فَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَتَاكُمْ مَا تُوعَدُونَ غَدًا مُؤَجَّلُونَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لأَهْلِ بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يُقِمْ قُتَيْبَةُ قَوْلَهُ ‏"‏ وَأَتَاكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: A'isha reported (that whenever it was her turn for Allah's Messenger [may peace be upon him] to spend the night with her) he would go out towards the end of the night to al-Baqi' and say: Peace be upon you, abode of a people who are believers. What you were promised would come to you tomorrow, you receiving it after some delay; and God willing we shall join you. O Allah, grant forgiveness to the inhabitants of Baqi' al-Gharqad. Qutaiba did not mention his words:" would come to you". [Muslim: 974]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Graveyard
benefits.description: This dua for graveyard brings hope for forgiveness, connects hearts with those resting, and reminds every Muslim of Allah’s promise and the mercy waiting for all believers.
points: Allah gives maghfirat to the dead when Muslims use this dua for graveyard.
Saying assalamualaikum at Jannatul Baqi keeps the bond of Iman strong always.
This dua for forgiveness in Islam brings hope for mercy to all in the qabristan.
Muslim prayer for the dead asks Allah to forgive every believer resting in graves.
Using peace be upon you at graveyard reminds us of in sha allah meeting again.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Graveyard
when_to_recite.description: This dua for graveyard is recited to send peace, ask forgiveness for the dead, and remember the promise of Allah, bringing Barakah and hope for Jannatul Baqi and all believers resting in graves.
points: When you enter a graveyard, greet with assalamualaikum and recite this dua for graveyard.
While visiting Jannatul Baqi, use the dua for forgiveness and ask Allah for mercy.
After making salam to the graves, quietly say this Muslim prayer for the dead with Iman.
On days of Eid or special visits, remember to recite the dua for dead person and seek maghfirat.
If you pass by a graveyard, softly say peace be upon you and make this forgiveness prayer for all.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Graveyard
how_to_perform.description: When you visit the graveyard, this dua for graveyard is recited to greet the believers, remember the promise of Allah, and ask for forgiveness for those buried, especially in Jannatul Baqi. It is a masnoon dua that brings peace and mercy.
steps: Enter the graveyard and gently say assalamualaikum to the Muslims resting there.
Stand by the graves and recite peace be upon you, thinking of the promise from Allah.
While walking, quietly make this dua for the dead and ask forgiveness in Islam for all.
Raise your hands and say the forgiveness prayer for the people of Jannatul Baqi.
Before leaving, repeat salamu alaikum and pray in sha allah for mercy on every dead person.

data.title: Dua for Deceased in the Funeral (Masnun Dua)
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say in funeral prayer:
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا اَللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
data.transliteration: Allahum-maghfir lihayyinaa, wa mayyitinaa, wa sagheerinaa wa kabeerinaa, wa thakarinaa wa 'unthaanaa, wa shaahidinaa, wa ghaa'ibinaa. Allaahumma man 'ahyaytahu minnaa fa'ahyihi 'alal-'Imaan, wa man tawaffaytahu minnaa fatawaffahu 'alal-'Islam, Allaahumma laa tahrimnaa 'ajrahu wa laa tudhillanaa ba'dahu
data.translation: O Allah, forgive those of us who are living and those of us who are dead, those of us who are present and those of us who are absent, our young and our old, our male and our female. O Allah, to whomsoever of us You givest life grant him life as a believer, and whomsoever of us You takest in death take him in death as a follower of Islam. O Allah, do not withhold from us the reward (of faith) and do not lead us astray after his death.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ مَرْوَانَ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْحَاقَ - عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى جَنَازَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated AbuHurayrah: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed over a dead person, he said: O Allah, forgive those of us who are living and those of us who are dead, those of us who are present and those of us who are absent, our young and our old, our male and our female. O Allah, to whomsoever of us Thou givest life grant him life as a believer, and whomsoever of us Thou takest in death take him in death as a follower of Islam. O Allah, do not withhold from us the reward (of faith) and do not lead us astray after his death. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 3201]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Deceased in the Funeral (Masnun Dua)
benefits.description: This janaja dua brings hope and comfort for families, asking Allah to forgive and bless the deceased, and to keep the living strong in Iman and Amal during funeral prayer in Islam.
points: Allah grants maghfirat to the dead when Muslims make this janaza dua with heart.
This dua for deceased helps keep Iman strong for those alive and those who passed.
Janaza dua brings Barakah and reward for the one who prays and the dead person.
Asking dua for forgiveness in salat al janaza brings peace to the dead in grave.
Allah keeps the Muslims on right path after funeral in Islam with this masnun dua.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Janaja Dua
when_to_recite.description: This janaja dua is recited to ask Allah for forgiveness and Barakah for both the living and the dead, bringing hope, Iman, and comfort to families during funeral prayer in Islam and times of loss.
points: During the funeral prayer Islam, recite janaza dua for the deceased and all Muslims.
After salat al janaza, quietly make dua for forgiveness and maghfirat for the dead.
When visiting a grave after burial, use this janaza dua for dead person and pray for mercy.
At home after hearing news of a death, remember to recite this prayer for deceased Muslim.
If you attend a janaza, softly say this dua for dead parents and all who passed with Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Janaja Dua
how_to_perform.description: This janaja dua is recited during the funeral prayer in Islam, asking Allah for forgiveness and mercy for the deceased and all Muslims. It is a masnun dua that brings Barakah and comfort to the hearts of those present.
steps: Stand in rows behind the imam for salat al janaza and make your niyyah for funeral prayer in Islam.
After the first takbeer, quietly recite surah al fatiha as part of the janaza prayer.
On the second takbeer, say this janaja dua for deceased, asking Allah for maghfirat.
At the third takbeer, pray for the dead person and all Muslims using this dua for forgiveness.
When the prayer ends, send a condolence message in Islam and make dua for dead parents and all believers.

data.title: Dua for a Deceased Male (Janaza dua)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ]
data.transliteration: Allahum-maghfir lahu warhamhu, wa 'aafihi, wa'fu 'anhu, wa 'akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi' mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bilmaa'i waththalji walbarad, wa naqqihi minal-khataayaa kamaa naqqaytath-thawbal-'abyadha minad-danas, wa 'abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahlihi, wa zawjan khayran min zawjihi, wa 'adkhilhul-jannata, wa 'a'idhhu min 'adhaabil-qabr (wa 'adhaabin-naar)
data.translation:
O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him and give him strength and pardon him. Be generous to him and cause his entrance to be wide and wash him with water and snow and hail. Cleanse him of his transgressions as white cloth is cleansed of stains. Give him an abode better than his home, and a family better than his family and a spouse better than his spouse. Take him into Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave [and from the punishment of Hell-fire].

Awf ibn Malik (RA) said, When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) performed the funeral prayer, I memorized this dua from him. Hearing this dua, I wished that the dead body would be me! (The dua is Mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَوْفَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى جَنَازَةٍ فَحَفِظْتُ مِنْ دُعَائِهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ وَأَهْلاً خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ أَوْ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حَتَّى تَمَنَّيْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَنَا ذَلِكَ الْمَيِّتَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَيْضًا ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Jubair b. Nufair says: I heard it from 'Auf b. Malik that the Prophet (ﷺ) said prayer on the dead body, and I remembered his prayer: " O Allah! forgive him, have mercy upon him, give him peace and absolve him. Receive him with honour and make his grave spacious; wash him with water, snow and hail. Cleanse him from faults as Thou wouldst cleanse a white garment from impurity. Requite him with an abode more excellent than his abode, with a family better than his family, and with a mate better than his mate. Admit him to the Garden, and protect him from the torment of the grave and the torment of the Fire." ('Auf bin Malik) said: I earnestly desired that I were this dead body. Sahih Muslim 963a, 963b [Muslim: 963]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for a Deceased Male (Janaza dua)
benefits.description: This dua for a deceased asks Allah to forgive, show mercy, and grant the dead a better home and family in Jannah, bringing hope and comfort to those who pray during funeral prayer in Islam.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for a Deceased

data.title: Dua for Namaz e Janaza (Male)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ (إِنَّهُ) عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ كَانَ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُوْلُكَ وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِي إِحْسَانِهِ وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيْئًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَلَا تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهُ
data.transliteration: Alla-humma, (innahu) ‘abduka, wabnu‘ 'abdika, wabnu amatika, ka-na yashhadu an laa ilaaha illa anta, wa anna mu’hmmadan ‘abduka wa rasooluka, wa aanta a'laamu bihi. Alla-humma, in kaana mu'hhsinan fajid fi e'hsaa-nihi, wa in ka-na musi-an fataja-waz ‘an saiyyi-aa-tihi. Alla-humma laa-ta'harimna-ajrahu, wala-taftinna ba'adahu
data.translation: O Allah, this man is Your servant, the son of Your male servant, the son of female servant. He testified that there is no true ilaah but you and that Muhammad (ﷺ) is your servant and your messenger. And you are more aware of it. O Allah, if he is a doer of good, then increase his goodness. And if he has sinned, then forgive him. O Allah, do not deprive us of His reward and do not tempt us after that.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Namaz e Janaza (Male)

This dua for namaz e janaza brings maghfirat for the dead if he had mistakes in life.
Janaza prayer helps Muslims get reward and Barakah for praying for the deceased.

Making this dua for the dead in funeral prayer in Islam brings peace to the heart.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Namaz e Janaza

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Namaz e Janaza

data.title: Dua for Namaz e Janaza (Allahumma abduka wabnu amatika)
data.introduction: Narrated by Yazid Ibn Rukana Ibn Muttalib (RA): When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) perform Janazah prayer, he used to say:
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ اِحْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma 'abduka wabnu 'amatika ihtaaja 'ilaa rahmatika, wa 'Anta ghaniyyun 'an 'adhaabihi, 'in kaana mu'hsinan fazid fee hasanaatihi, wa 'in kaana musee'an fatajaawaz 'anhu
data.translation: O Allah, he is the son of One of Your male & female slave, he is in need of Your mercy, and You are not in need of his torment. If he was pious, then increase his rewards and if he was a sinner then pardon him.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Namaz e Janaza (Allahumma abduka wabnu amatika)

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Namaz e Janaza
how_to_perform.description: This dua for namaz e janaza is recited in the funeral prayer, asking Allah to show mercy, forgive the dead, and increase his good deeds if he was pious. It is a masnun dua that brings hope and comfort to the hearts of Muslims.

data.title: Dua for the deceased at funeral prayer (Janaza dua)
data.introduction: It is narrated on the authority of Wasila ibn al-Aska (RA) that he said, 'The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) performed the janaza of a Muslim man with us. There I heard him said -
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ (فُلَانَ بْنَ فُلَانٍ) فِي ذِمَّتِكَ وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ اَللَّهُمَّ فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma 'inna (fulanabna fulan) fee dhimmatika, wa habli jiwaarika, faqihi min fitnatil-qabri wa 'adhaabin-naari, wa 'Anta 'ahlul-wafaa'i walhaqq. Allaahumma Faghfir lahu warhamhu 'innaka 'Antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem.
data.translation: O Allah, surely [name the person] is under Your protection, and in the rope of Your security, so save him from the trial of the grave and from the punishment of the Fire. You fulfill promises and grant rights, so forgive him and have mercy on him. Surely You are Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى الرَّازِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، - وَحَدِيثُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَتَمُّ - حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ جُنَاحٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ بْنِ حَلْبَسٍ، عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْنِ الأَسْقَعِ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ فَقِهِ فِتْنَةَ الْقَبْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَمْدِ اللَّهُمَّ فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ جُنَاحٍ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Wathilah ibn al-Asqa': The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in prayer over bier of a Muslim and I heard him say: O Allah, so and so, son of so and so, is in Thy protection, so guard him from the trial in the grave. (AbdurRahman in his version said: "In Thy protection and in Thy nearer presence, so guard him from the trial in the grave) and the punishment in Hell. Thou art faithful and worthy of praise. O Allah, forgive him and show him mercy. Thou art the forgiving and the merciful one." AbdurRahman said: "On the authority of Marwan ibn Janah." [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 3202]

Making this dua for someone who passed away brings peace to muslim hearts.

data.title: Dua for Namaz e Janaza (Female)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا وَعَافِهَا وَاعْفُ عَنْهَا وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهَا وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهَا وَاغْسِلْهَا بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهَا مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهَا دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهَا وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهَا وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهَا وَأَدْخِلْهَا الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهَا مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ [عَذَابِ النَّارِ]
data.transliteration: Allahum-maghfir laha warhamha, wa 'aafiha, wa'fu 'anha, wa 'akrim nuzulaha, wa wassi' mudkhalaha, waghsilha bilmaa'i waththalji walbarad, wa naqqiha minal-khataayaa kamaa naqqaytath-thawbal-'abyadha minad-danas, wa 'abdilha daaran khayran min daariha, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahliha, wa zawjan khayran min zawjiha, wa 'adkhilhal-jannata, wa 'a'idh-ha min 'adhaabil-qabr [or, 'adhaabin-naar instead of 'adhaabil-qabr].
data.translation: O Allah, forgive her and have mercy on her and give her strength and pardon her. Be generous to her and cause her entrance to be wide and wash her with water and snow and hail. Cleanse her of his transgressions as white cloth is cleansed of stains. Give her an abode better than her home, and a family better than her family and a spouse better than his spouse. Take her into Paradise and protect her from the punishment of the grave [and from the punishment of Hell-fire].

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَوْفَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى جَنَازَةٍ فَحَفِظْتُ مِنْ دُعَائِهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ وَأَهْلاً خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ أَوْ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حَتَّى تَمَنَّيْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَنَا ذَلِكَ الْمَيِّتَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَيْضًا ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Jubair b. Nufair says: I heard it from 'Auf b. Malik that the Prophet (ﷺ) said prayer on the dead body, and I remembered his prayer: " O Allah! forgive him, have mercy upon him, give him peace and absolve him. Receive him with honour and make his grave spacious; wash him with water, snow and hail. Cleanse him from faults as Thou wouldst cleanse a white garment from impurity. Requite him with an abode more excellent than his abode, with a family better than his family, and with a mate better than his mate. Admit him to the Garden, and protect him from the torment of the grave and the torment of the Fire." ('Auf bin Malik) said: I earnestly desired that I were this dead body. Sahih Muslim 963a, 963b [Muslim: 963]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Namaz e Janaza (Female)

data.title: Dua for Namaz e Janaza (Allahumma innaha amatuka)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ (إِنَّهَا) أَمَتُكَ وَبِنْتُ عَبْدِكَ وَبِنْتُ أَمَتِكَ كَانَتْ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُوْلُكَ وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَتْ مُحْسِنَةً فَزِدْ فِي إِحْسَانِهَا وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مُسِيْئَةً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهَا اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهَا وَلَا تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهَا
data.transliteration: Alla-humma, (innaha) ‘amatuka, wa bintu 'abdika, wa bintu amatika, kaanat yashhadu an laa ilaaha illaa anta, wa anna mu’hammadan ‘abduka wa rasooluka, wa aanta a’lamu bihi. Alla-humma, in kaanat mu'hsinatan fajid fi ehsaa-niha, wa in kaanat musi-atan fataja-waz ‘an saiyyi-aa-tiha. Alla-humma laa-ta'harimna-ajraha, wala-taftinna ba'adaha.
data.translation: O Allah, this woman is Your servant, the daughter of Your male servant, the daughter of female servant. She testified that there is no true ilaah but you and that Muhammad (ﷺ) is your servant and your messenger. And you are more aware of it. O Allah, if she is a doer of good, then increase her goodness. And if she has sinned, then forgive her. O Allah, do not deprive us of her reward and do not tempt us after that.

data.title: Dua for Deceased Female (Janaza dua)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَمَتُكَ وَبِنْتُ أَمَتِكَ اِحْتَاجَتْ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهَا، إِنْ كَانَتْ مُحْسِنَةً فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهَا، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مُسِيئَةً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهَا

data.translation: O Allah, she is the daughter of One of Your male & female slave, she is in need of Your mercy, and You are not in need of her torment. If she was pious then increase her rewards and if she was a sinner then pardon her.

data.title: Dua for Deceased Female (Salat al Janaza)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ (فُلَانَةَ بِنْتُ فُلَانٍ) فِي ذِمَّتِكَ وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، اَللَّهُمَّ فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma 'inna (fulanata bintu fulan) fee dhimmatika, wa habli jiwaarika, faqihi min fitnatil-qabri wa 'adhaabin-naari, wa 'Anta 'ahlul-wafaa'i walhaqq. Allaahumma faghfir laha warhamha 'innaka 'Antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem
data.translation: O Allah, surely [name the person] is under Your protection, and in the rope of Your security, so save her from the trial of the grave and from the punishment of the Fire. You fulfill promises and grant rights, so forgive her and have mercy on her. Surely You are Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى الرَّازِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، - وَحَدِيثُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَتَمُّ - حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ جُنَاحٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ بْنِ حَلْبَسٍ، عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْنِ الأَسْقَعِ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ فَقِهِ فِتْنَةَ الْقَبْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَمْدِ اللَّهُمَّ فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ جُنَاحٍ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Wathilah ibn al-Asqa': The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in prayer over bier of a Muslim and I heard him say: O Allah, so and so, son of so and so, is in Thy protection, so guard him from the trial in the grave. (AbdurRahman in his version said: "In Thy protection and in Thy nearer presence, so guard him from the trial in the grave) and the punishment in Hell. Thou art faithful and worthy of praise. O Allah, forgive him and show him mercy. Thou art the forgiving and the merciful one." AbdurRahman said: "On the authority of Marwan ibn Janah." [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 3202]

data.title: Janazah Dua for Forgiveness (Masnun Dua)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبُّهَا، وَأَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهَا، وَأَنْتَ هَدَيْتَهَا لِلْإِسْلَامِ، وَأَنْتَ قَبَضْتَ رُوْحَهَا، وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِسِرِّهَا وَعَلَانِيَتِهَا، جِئْنَا شُفَعَاءَ فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا
data.transliteration: Alla-humma, anta rabbuhaa, wa anta khalaqtahaa, wa anta hadaitahaa lil islaam, wa anta qabadta ru'hahaa, wa anta a'lamu bisirriha wa 'ala-niyatihaa, ji'na shufa'a-a fagfir laha
data.translation: O Allah, You are his Lord, You have created him, You have shown him the way to Islam, You have accepted his soul, You know all his open and secrets. We have come to intercede for him, so forgive him.
