data.title: Dua for Deceased Child (Masnoon Dua)
data.introduction: Following Dua is good -
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطًا وَذُخْرًا لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعًا مُجَابًا، اَللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجُورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلَافِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
data.transliteration: Allahum-maj'alhu faratan wa dhukhran liwaalidayhi, wa shafee'an mujaaban. Allaahumma thaqqil bihi mawaazeenahumaa wa 'a'dhim bihi 'ujoorahumaa, wa 'alhiqhu bisaalihil-mu'mineen, waj'alhu fee kafaalati 'Ibraaheema, wa qihi birahmatika 'adhaabal-jaheem, wa 'abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahlihi, Allahum-maghfir li'aslaafinaa, wa 'afraatinaa wa man sabaqanaa bil'eemaan.
data.translation: O Allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. O Allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good) and magnify their reward. Make him join the righteous of the believers. Place him in the care of Ibrahim (As). Save him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell. Give him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those who have gone (i.e. passed away) before us, our lost children (by death), and those who have preceded us in Faith.
data.reference: See Al-Mughni, Lee Ibn Kudama, 3/416; See also Ad-Durusul Muhimmah Li ‘Ammatil Ummah, Lish Sheikh Abdil Aziz Ibn Abdillah Ibn Baz, Rahemahullah, p. 15.

points: At the time of janaza dua, recite this death dua after the third takbeer for the child.
When you visit the grave of a young one, use this dua for the deceased for reward.
After hearing about a child’s passing, quietly make this deceased dua at home for comfort.
While teaching prayer for the dead, share this dua for the dead with others for learning.
During family gatherings remembering lost children, softly read this prayer for deceased soul.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Death Dua for Deceased Child
how_to_perform.description: This death dua is a gentle islamic prayer asking Allah to make the child a source of Barakah and reward for the family. It is a masnoon dua that brings hope and comfort to hearts in times of loss.
steps: Begin by joining the janaza prayer and after takbeer, recite this dua for the deceased child.
When you visit the grave, softly say this prayer for deceased soul and ask for Allah’s mercy.
After namaz dua, include this deceased dua in your zikr allah for the child’s reward and peace.
While giving condolences, share this dua for the dead to bring comfort to the grieving family.
In your daily duas from quran, remember this janaza dua to keep the child in your prayers.

data.title: Forgiveness Dua for Deceased (Janaza dua)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَثَبِّتْهُ
data.transliteration: Allahum-maghfir lahu wa thabbithu
data.translation:
O Allah, forgive him, strengthen him (During question of grave)

Narrated Uthman ibn Affan (RA) : Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) became free from burying the dead, he used to stay at him (i.e. his grave) and say: Seek forgiveness for your brother, and beg steadfastness for him, for he will be questioned now.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَحِيرٍ، عَنْ هَانِئٍ، مَوْلَى عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ دَفْنِ الْمَيِّتِ وَقَفَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اسْتَغْفِرُوا لأَخِيكُمْ وَسَلُوا لَهُ التَّثْبِيتَ فَإِنَّهُ الآنَ يُسْأَلُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ بَحِيرُ بْنُ رَيْسَانَ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Uthman ibn Affan: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) became free from burying the dead, he used to stay at him (i.e. his grave) and say: Seek forgiveness for your brother, and beg steadfastness for him, for he will be questioned now. Abu Dawud said: The full name of the narrator Buhair is Buhair b. Raisan. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 3221]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua of Forgiveness for Deceased
benefits.description: This short janaza dua asks Allah for forgiveness and strength for the dead, bringing hope and peace to families and reminding muslims to trust Allah’s mercy in every moment of loss.
points: Allah forgives the dead when muslims make this dua of forgiveness in janaza.
This islamic prayer for the dead gives strength during grave’s hard questions.
Janaza dua brings comfort and Barakah to the family in their time of sadness.
Prayer for deceased soul in islam helps muslims remember Allah’s Rahmah always.
Saying allahummaghfirlahu shows true Amal and care for the muslim ummah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Forgiveness Dua for Deceased (Janaza dua)
when_to_recite.description: This dua of forgiveness is recited for the deceased, asking Allah to forgive and give strength to the soul during the grave’s questions, bringing peace and Barakah to the departed in line with Islamic prayers.
points: After the funeral prayer in islam, recite allahummaghfirlahu for the deceased soul.
When visiting a graveyard, muslims use this janaza dua as a prayer for the dead.

If you hear news of a muslim passing, offer this islamic prayer for the dead right away.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua of Forgiveness for Deceased
how_to_perform.description: This dua of forgiveness is a short but strong islamic prayer for the dead, asking Allah to forgive and give strength to the deceased in the grave. It is a masnoon dua every Muslim should use in janaza dua and daily zikr allah.
steps: Stand with the jamaat for funeral prayer in islam and recite allahummaghfirlahu after takbeer.
At the grave, quietly say this dua for deceased and ask Allah to keep him firm in questioning.
When you hear news of death, softly read this prayer for the dead and make dua for forgiveness.
After namaz dua, include this islamic prayer for deceased in your daily duas from quran.
While giving islamic condolences, share this janaza dua to comfort the family and pray for Barakah.

data.title: Dua for Death and Patience (Masnun Dua)
data.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى وَكُلٌّ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى
data.transliteration: Inna lillaahi maa 'akhadha, wa lahu maa 'a'taa, wa kullun 'indahu bi'ajalin musamma
data.translation:
Whatever Allah takes is His, and whatever He gives is His, and everything with Him has a limited fixed term (in this world).

Narrated by Usama bin Zaid (RA): We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when suddenly there came to him a messenger from one of his daughters who was asking him to come and see her son who was dying. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the messenger), (The dua is Mentioned above). So order her to be patient and hope for Allah's reward.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ جَاءَهُ رَسُولُ إِحْدَى بَنَاتِهِ يَدْعُوهُ إِلَى ابْنِهَا فِي الْمَوْتِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ارْجِعْ فَأَخْبِرْهَا أَنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَمُرْهَا فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَعَادَتِ الرَّسُولَ أَنَّهَا أَقْسَمَتْ لَتَأْتِيَنَّهَا، فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَامَ مَعَهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ وَمُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ، فَدُفِعَ الصَّبِيُّ إِلَيْهِ وَنَفْسُهُ تَقَعْقَعُ كَأَنَّهَا فِي شَنٍّ فَفَاضَتْ عَيْنَاهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ سَعْدٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ رَحْمَةٌ جَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِ عِبَادِهِ، وَإِنَّمَا يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الرُّحَمَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Usama bin Zaid: We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when suddenly there came to him a messenger from one of his daughters who was asking him to come and see her son who was dying. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the messenger), "Go back and tell her that whatever Allah takes is His, and whatever He gives is His, and everything with Him has a limited fixed term (in this world). So order her to be patient and hope for Allah's reward." But she sent the messenger to the Prophet (ﷺ) again, swearing that he should come to her. So the Prophet got up, and so did Sa`d bin 'Ubada and Mu`adh bin Jabal (and went to her). When the child was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) his breath was disturbed in his chest as if it were in a water skin. On that the eyes of the Prophet (ﷺ) became flooded with tears, whereupon Sa`d said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is this?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is mercy which Allah has put in the heart of His slaves, and Allah bestows His mercy only on those of His slaves who are merciful (to others)." [Bukhari: 7377]

benefits.title: Benefits of Death Dua and Patience (Inna Lillahi)
benefits.description: This masnun dua reminds Muslims that all things belong to Allah and every loss has a set time, helping hearts find patience and trust in Allah’s plan during hard moments of death.
points: Muslims say inna lillahi to show full trust in Allah’s Qadr and wisdom.
This death dua brings sabr and peace to hearts when someone passes away.
Saying innalillahiwainnailaihirojiun helps Muslims accept Allah’s will.
Dua for patience in Islam gives hope and Barakah in times of sadness.
Remembering this masnoon dua keeps Iman strong and Amal steady in every loss.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Death Dua and Patience (Masnun Dua)
when_to_recite.description: This death dua reminds us that all things belong to Allah, helping hearts find patience and Sabr when facing loss, and guiding Muslims to trust Allah’s plan with every test and every blessing.
points: When hearing news of a Muslim’s death, recite inna lillahi for patience and Barakah.
At times of giving condolences message Islam, use this dua for sabr and comfort.
After losing a loved one, Muslims say this death dua to remember Allah’s Qadr.
While visiting a grieving family, offer this dua for patience in Islamic way.
When reflecting on Islamic quotes on death, recite this dua for strength and Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Death Dua for Patience
how_to_perform.description: This death dua teaches us to trust Allah’s plan and find sabr when someone passes away. It is a masnun dua that brings calm and helps Muslims remember everything belongs to Allah.
steps: When you hear about a death, say inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi rajiun with this dua for patience.
At the home of the grieving family, gently recite this dua for sabr and remind them of Allah’s mercy.
During condolences message Islam, share this Islamic quotes on death to give hope and comfort.
After salah, include this dua in your zikr Allah to ask for patience in Islam and strong Iman.
While talking to children, explain this hadith on patience and help them learn this masnoon dua.

data.title: Condolence Dua for Death (Masnun Dua)
data.introduction: It is better to recite this dua in giving condolence
data.arabic: أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ
data.transliteration: A'dhamAllahu 'ajraka, wa 'ahsana 'azaa'aka wa ghafara limayyitik.
data.translation: May Allah increase your reward, grant you the tawfiq of patience (in mourning), and forgive the dead person.

benefits.title: Benefits of Condolence Dua for Death
benefits.description: This masnun dua gives comfort to grieving hearts, asking Allah to reward, forgive, and help the family stay patient, showing true care and support in times of loss and sadness.
points: Allah gives more reward to the family when Muslims say this condolence dua for death.
This dua for deceased brings hope and Barakah to the hearts of those in pain.
Islamic condolences help the family find sabr and tawfiq in their hard days.
Prayer for dead in Islam asks Allah to forgive the one who passed away.
Saying this dua for the deceased shows real Amal and love for the Muslim ummah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Condolence Dua for Death (Masnun Dua)
when_to_recite.description: This condolence dua for death brings comfort to grieving hearts, asking Allah to reward the mourner, give Sabr, and forgive the deceased, following the way of Islamic condolences and Barakah in every word.
points: When meeting a grieving family, offer this condolence dua for death for comfort.
At the time of giving condolence message in Islam, recite this dua for deceased.
After hearing news of someone’s passing, Muslims use this dua for the dead.
While attending a janaza, make this prayer for dead to ask Allah for mercy and reward.
When remembering a loved one, say this dua for someone who passed away for Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Condolence Dua for Death
how_to_perform.description: This condolence dua for death is a gentle way to comfort someone who lost a loved one, asking Allah to give them patience and forgive the deceased. It is a masnun dua every Muslim should know for times of loss.
steps: When you meet a grieving family, softly recite this condolence dua for death to show care.
At the home of the deceased, say this dua for deceased after giving your Islamic condolences.
If you hear news of someone’s passing, use this dua for someone who passed away right away.
While sending a condolence message in Islam, write this masnun dua to bring peace to hearts.
After janazah prayer, repeat this dua for the dead to ask Allah for mercy and Barakah for the deceased.

data.title: Laylatul Qadr Dua (Allahumma Innaka Afuwwun Karim Dua)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ (كَرِيْمٌ) تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
data.transliteration: Allaahumma innaka `Afuwwun [Karimun], tu'hibbul-`afwa fa`fu `annī.
data.translation:
O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning [Generous], You love pardon, so pardon me.

Ayesha (RA) said, "O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), should I make du'a on Lailatul Qadr?" Then he (ﷺ) taught me this du'a. This du'aa 'can be recited in the prostration of Salat on Laylat al-Qadr, before Salam, after salaam and on all other days and nights in all Salats and at normal times.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الضُّبَعِيُّ، عَنْ كَهْمَسِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ عَلِمْتُ أَىُّ لَيْلَةٍ لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ مَا أَقُولُ فِيهَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُولِي اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Aishah narrated: “I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, what is your view if I know when the Night of Al-Qadr is, then what should I say in it?” He said: ‘Say: “O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning, [Generous,] You love pardon, so pardon me (Allāhumma innaka `Afuwwun [Karīmun], tuḥibbul-`afwa fa`fu `annī).’” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3513]

benefits.title: Benefits of Laylatul Qadr Dua
benefits.description: This special dua for laylatul qadr asks Allah for full pardon and mercy, bringing hope, forgiveness, and Barakah to Muslims in the blessed nights of Ramadan.
points: Allahumma innaka afuwwun dua brings full forgiveness on shab e qadr night.
Laylatul qadr dua helps Muslims get Barakah and mercy in last 10 days of Ramadan.
This dua for forgiveness wipes away old sins and gives a fresh start in life.
Shab e qadr ki dua brings hope and closeness to Allah in the night of power.
Making this dua of laylatul qadr keeps Iman strong and Amal pure for Muslims.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Laylatul Qadr Dua (Allahumma Innaka Afuwwun Karim Dua)
when_to_recite.description: This laylatul qadr dua is recited in the blessed nights of Ramadan, asking Allah for forgiveness and Barakah, especially when hearts are soft and the night of power brings hope for mercy and new Amal.
points: During the last 10 days of Ramadan, Muslims recite laylatul qadr dua for forgiveness.
On shab e qadr, use allahumma innaka afuwwun tuhibbul afwa for Barakah and mercy.
While praying in the night of power, make dua for laylatul qadr with full Iman.
After finishing lailatul qadr prayer, say this dua of laylatul qadr for Allah’s pardon.
When seeking signs of laylatul qadr, repeat this qadr night dua for more blessings.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Laylatul Qadr Dua
how_to_perform.description: On the blessed night of Laylatul Qadr, this laylatul qadr dua is recited to seek Allah’s forgiveness and mercy. It is a simple masnoon dua that brings Barakah and is loved by every Muslim during Ramadan.
steps: After finishing your salah in the last 10 nights, recite the laylatul qadr dua with full hope.
When you feel the night is special, whisper allahumma innaka afuwwun with a soft heart.
During your qadr night dua, raise your hands and ask Allah for forgiveness and mercy.
If you sit for zikr Allah or quranic dua, say this dua for laylatul qadr to get Allah’s pardon.
Before going to bed on shab e qadr, repeat this dua of laylatul qadr for more Barakah and peace.

data.title: Dua of the beginning of fasting
data.introduction: There is no masnun dua at the beginning of fasting. However, it is important to make the intention for fasting the night before the start of fasting. The conscious purpose in the mind is called intention. This is the intention of the believer to fast before fasting, before going to bed at night or during sahri. It is not Sunnah to say "Nawaituan" or to do so in any other way.

data.title: Moon Sighting Dua
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَهْلِلْهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيْمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ رَبِّيْ وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma ahlilhu `alaina bil-yumni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-Islam, rabbi wa rabbuk Allah
data.translation:
O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and security and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.

Rasulullah (ﷺ) used to say this dua when he saw the new moon. It is masnun to recite this dua after seeing the new moon of Ramadan and all the months.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ الْمَدَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي بِلاَلُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا رَأَى الْهِلاَلَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَهْلِلْهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالإِسْلاَمِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Bilal bin Yahya bin Talhah bin `Ubaidullah narrated : from his father, from his grandfather Talhah bin `Ubaidullah that when the Prophet (ﷺ) would see a crescent moon, he would say: “O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and security and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah (Allāhumma ahlilhu `alainā bil-yumni wal-Īmān, was-salāmati wal-Islām, rabbī wa rabbuk Allāh).” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3451]

benefits.title: Benefits of Moon Sighting Dua
benefits.description: This moon sighting dua asks Allah for Barakah, Iman, and safety with every new moon, bringing hope and peace to Muslims as they welcome Ramadan or Eid with faith and happiness.
points: Allah gives Barakah and Iman to Muslims who make this moon sighting dua.
Dua for new moon brings peace, safety, and Islam in every new month.
Chand dekhne ki dua helps Muslims start Ramadan or Eid with pure Amal.
New moon dua reminds hearts that Allah is the Lord of all creation and time.
Saying this dua for moon brings hope and unity to the Muslim ummah always.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Moon Sighting Dua
when_to_recite.description: This moon sighting dua is recited when seeing the new moon, asking Allah for Barakah, Iman, and peace, making every new month start with hope and zikr Allah in the heart of every Muslim.
points: When first seeing the new moon, recite moon sighting dua for blessing and Iman.
At the start of Ramadan moon sighting, Muslims use this dua for new moon with Amal.
During Eid moon sighting, make chand dekhne ki dua for Barakah and safety.
After spotting the Ramadan crescent, say this dua for moon to thank Allah for the month.
When teaching kids about rukyatul hilal, repeat new moon dua for zikr Allah and joy.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Moon Sighting Dua
how_to_perform.description: When you see the new moon, this moon sighting dua is recited to ask Allah for Barakah, Iman, and safety. It is a masnoon dua that brings peace and is used by Muslims at the start of Ramadan or Eid.
steps: As soon as you spot the new moon, quietly say the moon sighting dua with Iman.
When standing with family for Ramadan moon sighting, recite this dua for new moon together.
After seeing the crescent, look up and say chand dekhne ki dua for Barakah and peace.
If you join others for Eid moon sighting, share this dua for moon to spread happiness.
While making rukyatul hilal, remember to say this masnun dua for a blessed Islamic month.

data.title: Dua for Iftar (Iftar Dua)
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say when he breaks his fast:
data.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَاءُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوْقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
data.transliteration: Dhahabadh-dhama'u wabtallatil-'urooqu, wa thabatal-'ajru 'inshaa'Allah
data.translation:
The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

Note that, the widely practiced hadith 'Allahumma laka samtu wa 'ala rizqika aftartu' but, the hadith is da'if (weak). [2]
data.reference: [1] Hasan (Albani). Abu Dawud: 2357 [2] Weak (Albany). Abu Dawud: 2358

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَالِمٍ - الْمُقَفَّعُ - قَالَ رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ يَقْبِضُ عَلَى لِحْيَتِهِ فَيَقْطَعُ مَا زَادَ عَلَى الْكَفِّ وَقَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَفْطَرَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Marwan ibn Salim al-Muqaffa' said: I saw Ibn Umar holding his beard with his hand and cutting what exceeded the handful of it. He (Ibn Umar) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said when he broke his fast: Thirst has gone, the arteries are moist, and the reward is sure, if Allah wills. [[1] Hasan (Albani). Abu Dawud: 2357 [2] Weak (Albany). Abu Dawud: 2358]

data.title: Dua of Iftar
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
data.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka birahmatikal-latee wasi'at kulla shay'in 'an taghfira lee
data.translation:
O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses all things, that You forgive me.

Abdullah bin Amr (RA) used to say this dua during Iftar.
data.reference: Hasan (Hafiz Ibn Hazar). Takhrijul Adhkar, Sharhul Adhkar: 4/342

data.title: Dua when insulted while fasting
data.arabic: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
data.transliteration: Innee saa'imun, 'innee saa'imun
data.translation:
I am fasting. I am fasting.

Narrated Abu Huraira (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Fasting is a shield; So if any one of you observes fasting, let him not commit adultery or foolishness; If someone fights him or insults him, let him say - (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الصِّيَامُ جُنَّةٌ، فَلاَ يَرْفُثْ وَلاَ يَجْهَلْ، وَإِنِ امْرُؤٌ قَاتَلَهُ أَوْ شَاتَمَهُ فَلْيَقُلْ إِنِّي صَائِمٌ‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَخُلُوفُ فَمِ الصَّائِمِ أَطْيَبُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى مِنْ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ، يَتْرُكُ طَعَامَهُ وَشَرَابَهُ وَشَهْوَتَهُ مِنْ أَجْلِي، الصِّيَامُ لِي، وَأَنَا أَجْزِي بِهِ، وَالْحَسَنَةُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Fasting is a shield (or a screen or a shelter). So, the person observing fasting should avoid sexual relation with his wife and should not behave foolishly and impudently, and if somebody fights with him or abuses him, he should tell him twice, 'I am fasting." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "By Him in Whose Hands my soul is, the smell coming out from the mouth of a fasting person is better in the sight of Allah than the smell of musk. (Allah says about the fasting person), 'He has left his food, drink and desires for My sake. The fast is for Me. So I will reward (the fasting person) for it and the reward of good deeds is multiplied ten times." [Bukhari: 1894]

data.title: Dua for Iftar at Someone's House
data.arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
data.transliteration: Aftara 'indakumus-saa'imoona, wa 'akala ta'aamakumul-'abraaru, wa sallat 'alaykumul-malaa'ikah.
data.translation: With you, those who are fasting have broken their fast, you have fed those who are righteous, and the angels recite their prayers upon you.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَ إِلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ فَجَاءَ بِخُبْزٍ وَزَيْتٍ فَأَكَلَ ثُمَّ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الأَبْرَارُ وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Anas ibn Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) came to visit Sa'd ibn Ubaydah, and he brought bread and olive oil, and he ate (them). Them). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said: May the fasting (men) break their fast with you, and the pious eat your food, and the angels pray for blessing on you. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 3854]

data.title: Responding to Meal Invites While Fasting
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) says: If any one of you is invited to a meal when he is fasting, he should say:" I am fasting."

data.title: Powerful Dua for Travel (Masnun Dua)
data.introduction: Rasulullah (ﷺ) used to say Bismillah while boarding the ride, he said the rest after setting down:
data.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِيْنَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اَللّهُ أَكْبَرُ، (لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ) سُبْحَانَكَ، إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِيْ فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
data.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaah. Subhaanal-ladhee sakhkhara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahu muqrineen. Wa 'innaa 'ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon. Alhamdu lillaah, alhamdu lillaah, alhamdu lillaah, Allahu 'Akbar, Allahu 'Akbar, Allahu 'Akbar, (laa ilahaa 'illaa 'Anta) subhaanaka 'innee dhalamtu nafsee faghfir lee, fa'innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba 'illaa 'Anta
data.translation: Praise is to Allah. Glory is to Him Who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our efforts. Surely, unto our Lord we are returning. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Glory is to You. O Allah, I have wronged my own soul. Forgive me, for surely none forgives sins but You.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ عَلِيًّا أُتِيَ بِدَابَّةٍ لِيَرْكَبَهَا فَلَمَّا وَضَعَ رِجْلَهُ فِي الرِّكَابِ قَالَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ ثَلاَثًا فَلَمَّا اسْتَوَى عَلَى ظَهْرِهَا قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏:‏ ‏
hadith.translation: (‏ سبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ ‏) ‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ثَلاَثًا وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ثَلاَثًا سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي قَدْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ضَحِكَ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مِنْ أَىِّ شَيْءٍ ضَحِكْتَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَنَعَ كَمَا صَنَعْتُ ثُمَّ ضَحِكَ فَقُلْتُ مِنْ أَىِّ شَيْءٍ ضَحِكْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْجَبُ مِنْ عَبْدِهِ إِذَا قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ غَيْرُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضى الله عنهما ‏.‏ قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ ‏.‏ Ali bin Rabi’ah said: “I witnessed Ali having an animal brought to him to ride. When he placed his foot in the stirrup he said: ‘In the Name of Allah,’ (Bismillāh) [three times]. So then, once he had ascended upon its back, he said: ‘All praise is due to Allah.’ (Al-ḥamdulillāh) then he said: Glory is to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we were not able to do it. And, surely, to our Lord are we returning (Subḥān alladhī sakh-khara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahū muqrinīn. Wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn). Then he said: ‘All praise is due to Allah (Al-ḥamdulillāh)’ – three times – and ‘Allah is the Greatest (Allāhu Akbar)’ – three times – ‘Glory is to You, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for indeed none forgives sins except You (Subḥānaka innī qad ẓalamtu nafsī faghfirlī fa-innahū lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant).’ Then he laughed. So I said: ‘O Commander of the Believer! What caused you to laugh?’ He said: ‘I saw the Messenger of Allah do as I did, then he (ﷺ) laughed, so I said, ‘What cause you to laugh?’ He said: ‘Indeed, your Lord is very pleased with His worshipper when he says: “O my Lord, forgive me my sins, indeed, no one other than You forgives sins.” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3446]

data.title: Dua for Journey & Protection (Travel dua)
data.introduction: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite this dua at the beginning of his journey:
data.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِيْنَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اَللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيْفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوْءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
data.transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar, Allahu 'Akbar, Allahu 'Akbar. Subhaanal-lathee sakhkhara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahu muqrineen. Wa 'innaa 'ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon. Allaahumma 'innaa nas'aluka fee safarinaa haadhal-birra wattaqwaa, waminal-'amali maa tardhaa, Allaahumma hawwin 'alaynaa safaranaa haadhaa watwi 'annaa bu'dahu, Allaahumma 'Antas-saahibu fis-safari, walkhaleefatu fil-'ahli, Allaahumma 'innee 'A'oodhu bika min wa'thaa'is-safari, wa ka-'aabatil-mandhari, wa soo'il-munqalabi fil-maali wal 'ahli
data.translation:
Allah is the Most Great (3 times). Glory is to Him Who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our efforts. Surely, unto our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You on this our journey for goodness and piety, and for works that are pleasing to You. O Allah, lighten this journey for us and make its distance easy for us. O Allah, You are our Companion on the road and the One in Whose care we leave our family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from this journey's hardships, and from the wicked sights in store and from finding our family and property in misfortune upon returning.

And when the Prophet (ﷺ) returned from his journey, he would recite it and add to it:

data.title: Prophetic Farewell Dua for a traveller
data.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ اللَّهَ الَّذِيْ لَا تَضِيْعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
data.transliteration: Astawdi'ukAllahal-ladhee laa tadhee'u wadaa'i'uhu
data.translation:
I leave you in the care of Allah, as nothing is lost that is in His care.

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave me a send-off and said: (The dua is mentioned above). So, musaafir should say this dua to the farewell giver.But Musaafir and farewell giver both can supplicate this dua for each other.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ وَرْدَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ وَدَّعَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave me a send-off and said: ‘I command you to Allah’s keeping, Whose trust is never lost.’” [Sahih (Albani). Ibn Majah: 2825]

data.title: Powerful Dua of Journey for Safe Travel
data.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِيْنَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيْمَ عَمَلِكَ
data.transliteration: Astawdi'ullaaha deenaka, wa 'amaanataka, wa khawaateema 'amalika
data.translation:
I leave your religion in the care of Allah, as well as your safety, and the last of your deeds.

Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) said, The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: when he bid farewell, he grab his hand and did musafaha and said the above mentioned dua.In another narration, Abdullah Ibn Yazid Khatmi (RA) said, The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) bid farewell by saying these words. But in this case, he used plural (kum) instead of singular (ka): “Astad’iullaha diinaakum wa amaanatakum wa khawatima a’maalikum” I leave your religion in the care of Allah, as well as your safety, and the last of your deeds.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْفَزَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ يَقُولُ لِلرَّجُلِ إِذَا أَرَادَ سَفَرًا ادْنُ مِنِّي أُوَدِّعْكَ كَمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُوَدِّعُنَا ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ مِنْ حَدِيثِ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Salim narrated that : when he intended to undertake a journey, Ibn `Umar used to say to a person to “Come close to me so that I may bid you farewell as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to bid us farewell.” Then he would say: “I entrust to Allah your religion, and your trusts, and the last of your deeds (Astawdi`ullāha dīnaka wa amānataka wa khawātīma `amalik).” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3443]

data.title: Prophetic Dua for Safe Travel & Blessings
data.arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى وَغَفَرَ لَكَ ذَنْبَكَ وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ
data.transliteration: Zawwadakal-laahut-taqwaa, wa ghafara thanbaka, wa yassara lakal-khayra haythu maa kunta
data.translation:
May Allah give you piety as your provision, forgive your sins, and make goodness easy for you wherever you are.

Anas ibn Malik (RA) said, "A man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said, 'I have decided to travel. Give me a Travel allowance.' Then he said these words and prayed for him.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارٌ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ سَفَرًا فَزَوِّدْنِي ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ زِدْنِي ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ زِدْنِي بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Anas said: “A man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: ‘I intend to undertake a journey, so give me provision. He said: ‘May Allah grant you Taqwa as your provision (Zawwadak Allāhut-taqwā).’ He said: ‘Give me more.’ He said: ‘And may He forgive your sin (Wa ghafara dhanbak).’ He said: ‘Give me more, may my father be ransomed for you, and my mother.’ He said: ‘And may He make goodness easy for you wherever you are (Wa yassara lakal-khaira ḥaithu mā kunt).’” [Hasan (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3444]

data.title: Powerful Dua for Protection (Travellers dua)
data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
data.transliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq
data.translation:
I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

We have seen that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: If a person goes to a place or stops somewhere on a journey and says this dua, then nothing can harm him while he is there.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، وَاللَّفْظُ، لَهُ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ، أَنَّ يَعْقُوبَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ بُسْرَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ خَوْلَةَ بِنْتَ حَكِيمٍ السُّلَمِيَّةَ، تَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ نَزَلَ مَنْزِلاً ثُمَّ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ‏.‏ لَمْ يَضُرُّهُ شَىْءٌ حَتَّى يَرْتَحِلَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ ذَلِكَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Khaula bint Hakim Sulamiyya reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When anyone lands at a place, and then says:" I seek refuge in the Perfect Word of Allah from the evil of what He has created," nothing would harm him until he marches from that stopping place. [Muslim: 2708]

data.title: Islamic Dua for Safety in New City (Masnoon Dua)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَّبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الْأَرَضِيْنَ السَّبْعِ ومَا أَقْلَلْنَ، ورَبَّ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ ومَا أَضْلَلْنَ، ورَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، (وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا) وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا وشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
data.transliteration: Allaahumma Rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i wa maa 'adhlalna, wa Rabbal-'aradheenas-sab'i wa maa 'aqlalna, wa Rabbash-shayaateeni wa maa 'adhlalna, wa Rabbar-riyaahi wa maa tharayna. 'As'aluka khayra haathihil-qaryati wa khayra 'ahlihaa, (wa khayra maa feehaa), wa na‛oodhu bika min sharrihaa, wa sharri 'ahlihaa, wa sharri maa feehaa
data.translation:
O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they overshadow, Lord of the seven worlds and all they uphold, Lord of the devils and all they lead astray, Lord of the winds and all they scatter. I ask You for the goodness of this town and for the goodness of its people, and for the goodness it contains. I seek refuge in You from its evil, from the evil of its people and from the evil it contains.

Suhaib (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say these words whenever he saw a town before entering it.

benefits.title: Benefits of Islamic Dua for Safety in New City

data.title: Islamic Dua for entering market (Masnun Dua)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهَا وَخَيْرِ أَهْلِهَا وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا
data.transliteration: Allaahumma inni As'aluka min khayrihaa wa khayri 'ahlihaa wa 'a'oodhu bika min sharrihaa, wa sharri 'ahlihaa
data.translation:
Ya Allah! I ask you for the blessing of this place and the goodness of it’s inhabitant’s. And I take refuge in you from harm of this place and harm of it’s inhabitant’s.

It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA) that he stood at the entrance of the market, recited the du'a and entered the market.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الأَسْوَدِ أَبُو عَمْرٍو الْبَصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَأَى الرِّيحَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهَا وَخَيْرِ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرِ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ رضى الله عنه وَهَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Aishah [may Allah be pleased with her] narrates, saying: “When the Prophet (ﷺ) would see the wind he would say: ‘O Allah, indeed, I ask You for its good, the good of what is in it, and the good of what it has been sent with. And I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of what is in it, and the evil of what it has been sent with (Allāhumma innī as’aluka min khairihā wa khairi mā fīhā, wa khairi mā ursilat bihī, wa a`ūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā fīhā, wa sharri mā ursilat bih).’” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3449]

data.title: Powerful Dua for entering market (Masnun Dua)
data.introduction: Umar ibnul khattab (RA) narrated that: the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Whoever enters the marketplace and says:
data.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
data.transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyee wa yumeetu, wa Huwa hayyun laa yamootu, biyadihil-khayru, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer
data.translation:
None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partener. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He brings life and He causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His Hand is all good, and He is Able to do all things.

Allah will write a million rewards for him, remove a million sins from him and raise his status by one million levels.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ وَاسِعٍ، قَالَ قَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ فَلَقِيَنِي أَخِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ فَحَدَّثَنِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ دَخَلَ السُّوقَ فَقَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكُ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَىٌّ لاَ يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ حَسَنَةٍ وَمَحَا عَنْهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ سَيِّئَةٍ وَرَفَعَ لَهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ دَرَجَةٍ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ رَوَاهُ عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ - وَهُوَ قَهْرَمَانُ آلِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ نَحْوَهُ.
hadith.translation: Salim bin Abdullah bin Umar narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that : the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Whoever enters the marketplace and says: ‘There is none worthy of worship except Allah, Alone, without partner, to Him belongs the dominion, and to Him is all the praise, He gives life and causes death, He is Living and does not die, in His Hand is the good, and He has power over all things, (Lā ilāha illallāh, waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, yuḥyī wa yumītu, wa huwa ḥayyun lā yamūtu, biyadihil-khairu, wa huwa `alā kulli shay’in qadīr)’ Allah shall record a million good deeds for him, wipe a million evil deeds away from him, and raise a million ranks for him.” [Hasan (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3428]

data.title: Power of Saying Bismillah
data.introduction: Abu al-Malih (RA) reported on the authority of a man: I was riding on a mount behind the prophet (ﷺ) It stumbled. Thereupon I said: May the devil perish! He said: do not say; may the devil perish! For you say that, he will swell so much so that he will be like a house, and say: by my power. But say: (The dua is mentioned above)
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
data.transliteration: Bismillaah
data.translation:
With the Name of Allah.

Abu al-Malih (RA) reported on the authority of a man : I was riding on a mount behind the prophet (ﷺ). It stumbled. Thereupon I said: May the devil perish! He said: do not say; may the devil perish! For you say that, he will swell so much so that he will be like a house, and say: by my power. But say: (The dua is mentioned above) For when you say that, he will diminish so much so that he will be like a fly.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ بَقِيَّةَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ - عَنْ خَالِدٍ، - يَعْنِي الْحَذَّاءَ - عَنْ أَبِي تَمِيمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ رَدِيفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَثَرَتْ دَابَّتُهُ فَقُلْتُ تَعِسَ الشَّيْطَانُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُلْ تَعِسَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَإِنَّكَ إِذَا قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ تَعَاظَمَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ مِثْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيَقُولَ بِقُوَّتِي وَلَكِنْ قُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّكَ إِذَا قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ تَصَاغَرَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ مِثْلَ الذُّبَابِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu al-Malih reported on the authority of a man : I was riding on a mount behind the prophet (May peace be upon him). It stumbled. Thereupon I said: May the devil perish! He said: do not say; may the devil perish! For you say that, he will swell so much so that he will be like a house, and say: by my power. But say: in the name of Allah; for when you say that, he will diminish so much so that he will be like a fly. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 4982]

data.title: Dua for a traveller when dawn approaches
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say at the end of the night while on a journey:
data.arabic: سَمِعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلَائِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
data.transliteration: Sami'a saami'un bihamdillaahi wa husni balaa'ihi 'alaynaa. Rabbanaa saahibnaa, wa 'afdhil 'alaynaa 'aa'ithan billaahi minan-naar.
data.translation: He Who listens has heard that we praise Allah for the good things He gives us. Our Lord, be with us and bestow Your favor upon us. I seek the protection of Allah from the Fire.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ، بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ وَأَسْحَرَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ وَحُسْنِ بَلاَئِهِ عَلَيْنَا رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Huraira reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out on a journey in the morning, he used to say: " A listener listened to our praising Allah (for) His goodly trial of us. Our Lord! acompany us, guard us and bestow upon us Thy grace. I am seeker of refuge in Allah from the Fire." [Muslim: 2718]

data.title: Dua for Travelling in Names of Allah (Masnun Dua)
data.introduction: Noah (AS) took a boat ride while reading the following prayer:
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسٰىهَآ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
data.transliteration: Bismillahi majraha wa mursaha inna rabbee laGhafoorur-Raheem
data.translation:

Note that, this Dua cannot be said while mounting an animal or any means of transport. However, in our country, this dua is written in front of many vehicles and the supervisor says this dua when starting the journey, which is wrong.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَلِيًّا الأَزْدِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَلَّمَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اسْتَوَى عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ خَارِجًا إِلَى سَفَرٍ كَبَّرَ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ ‏"‏ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mounted his camel while setting out on a journey, he glorified Allah (uttered Allah-o-Akbar) thrice, and then said: Hallowed is He Who subdued for us this (ride) and we were not ourselves powerful enough to use It as a ride, and we are going to return to our Lord. O Allah, we seek virtue and piety from Thee in this journey of ours and the act which pleaseth Thee. O Allah, lighten this journey of ours, and make its distance easy for us. O Allah, Thou art (our) companion during the journey, and guardian of (our) family. O Allah, I seek refuge with Thee from hardships of the journey, gloominess of the sights, and finding of evil changes in property and family on return. And he (the Holy Prophet) uttered (these words), and made this addition to them: We are returning, repentant, worshipping our Lord. and praising Him. Sahih Muslim 1342 [Muslim 2/978, No.1342]

data.title: Islamic Travel dua for Protection
data.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to recite this du'a when he was on a journey:
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ اَللَّهُمَّ اطْوِ لَنَا الْأَرْضَ وَهَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا السَّفَرَ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma 'Antas-saahibu fis-safari wal-khaleefatu fil-'ahli, Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oodhu bika min wa'thaa'is-safari, wa kaabatil munqalabi wa su'il manzari fil-ahli wal maali, Allaahummatwi lanal-arda wa hawwin alainas-safara
data.translation: O Allah, You are the Companion in the journey, and the One Who looks after the family; O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the difficulty of travelling, finding harm when I return, and unhappiness in what I see coming to my family and property. O Allah, make the length of his journey short for us, and the journey easy for us.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدٌ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَافَرَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ اللَّهُمَّ اطْوِ لَنَا الأَرْضَ وَهَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا السَّفَرَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated AbuHurayrah: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) proceeded on journey, he would say: O Allah, Thou art the Companion in the journey, and the One Who looks after the family; O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the difficulty of travelling, finding harm when I return, and unhappiness in what I see coming to my family and property. O Allah, make the length of his journey short for us, and the journey easy for us. [Hasan Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 2598]

data.title: Islamic Travel Prayer for Safety (Masnun Dua)
data.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to recite this du'a when he was on a journey:
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِيْ هَذَا مِنَ الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اَللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا الْمَسِيرَ وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَ الْأَرْضِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ اَللَّهُمَّ اصْحَبْنَا فِي سَفَرِنَا وَاخْلُفْنَا فِي أَهْلِنَا
data.transliteration: Allaahumma inni as’aluka fi safari hadha minal-birri wat-taqwa, wa minal-`amali maa tarda. Allaahumma hawwin `alainal-masira, watwi `anna bu`dal-ard. Allaahumma antas-saahibu fis safari wal-khalifatu fil-ahli. Allaahumma ashaabna fi safarina wakhlufna fi ahlina
data.translation: O Allah, I ask You in this journey of mine from the righteousness and piety and actions that which you are pleased with. O Allah, ease for us the path, and make near for us the distance of the land. O Allah, You are the companion in the journey, and the caretaker for the family. O Allah, accompany us in our journey, and take care of our families

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَارِقِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا سَافَرَ فَرَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ كَبَّرَ ثَلاَثًا وَيَقُولُ ‏:‏ ‏
hadith.translation: (‏ سبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ ‏) ‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِي هَذَا مِنَ الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا الْمَسِيرَ وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَ الأَرْضِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ اصْحَبْنَا فِي سَفَرِنَا وَاخْلُفْنَا فِي أَهْلِنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ إِذَا رَجَعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ ‏"‏ آيِبُونُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏ Ibn `Umar narrated that: When the Prophet (ﷺ) wanted to travel, when he mounted his riding camel, he would say the Takbir three times and say: Glory is to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we were not able to do it. And, surely, to our Lord are we returning (Subḥān alladhī sakh-khara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahū muqrinīn. Wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn). Then he would say: “O Allah, I ask You in this journey of mine from the righteousness and piety and actions that which you are pleased with. O Allah, ease for us the path, and make near for us the distance of the land. O Allah, You are the companion in the journey, and the caretaker for the family. O Allah, accompany us in our journey, and take care of our families (Allāhumma innī as’aluka fī safarī hādhā minal-birri wat-taqwā, wa minal-`amali mā tarḍā. Allāhumma hawwin `alainal-masīra, waṭwi `annā bu`dal-arḍ. Allāhumma antaṣ-ṣāḥibu fis safari wal-khalīfatu fil-ahli. Allāhumma aṣḥabnā fī safarinā wakhlufnā fī ahlinā).” And when he would return to his family, he would say: “(We are) Returning, if Allah wills, repenting, worshipping, and to our Lord directing the praise (Ā’ibūna in shā’ Allāh, tā’ibūna `ābidūna lirabbinā hāmidūn).” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3447]

data.title: Talbiyah For Hajj (Labaik Allahuma Labaik Dua)
data.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
data.transliteration: Labbayk Allaahumma labbayk, labbayka laa shareeka laka labbayk, 'innal-hamda, wanni'mata, laka wal mulk, laa shareeka lak.
data.translation:
I am here at Your service, O Allah, I am here at Your service. I am here at Your service, You have no partener, I am here at Your service. Surely the praise, and blessings are Yours, and the dominion. You have no partener.

Narrated Ibn 'Umar: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reciting this talbiyyah with his hair tied together. (The Dua is motioned above) He did not utter more words than this.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ تَلْبِيَةَ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar: The Talbiya of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was: 'Labbaika Allahumma labbaik, Labbaika la sharika Laka labbaik, Inna-l-hamda wan-ni'mata Laka walmulk, La sharika Laka' (I respond to Your call O Allah, I respond to Your call, and I am obedient to Your orders, You have no partner, I respond to Your call All the praises and blessings are for You, All the sovereignty is for You, And You have no partners with you. Sahih al-Bukhari 1549 [Bukhari, 1549, Muslim 2/841, No. 1184]

benefits.title: Benefits of Talbiyah Hajj (Labbayk Allahumma Labbayk)
benefits.description: Talbiyah hajj fills the heart with Iman and brings Allah’s mercy, making every step in Hajj and Umrah full of Barakah, acceptance, and closeness to Allah for all muslims.
points: Labbaik allahumma labbaik shows full surrender to Allah in hajj and umrah rituals.
Talbiyah hajj brings Barakah and makes the journey of hajj easy for every muslim.
Saying this hajj dua helps muslims get forgiveness and Allah’s special blessings.
Labbayk allahumma labbayk keeps hearts away from shirk and grows true Iman.
Dua for hajj and umrah with talbiyah brings peace and acceptance of all Amal.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Talbiyah Hajj
when_to_recite.description: The talbiyah hajj is a special zikr allah for every muslim in ihram, showing full submission, Iman, and love for Allah during hajj and umrah, asking for Barakah and acceptance of your amal.
points: After wearing ihram, start reciting the talbiyah hajj to begin your sacred journey.
While walking towards the Kaaba, repeat labbaik allahumma labbaik with a strong heart.
During the days of hajj, keep saying the talbiyah hajj at every main stop and movement.
When entering Mina, Arafat, or Muzdalifah, raise your voice with this hajj dua for Barakah.
Before each main hajj ritual, say the talbiyah hajj to renew your niyyah and Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Talbiyah Hajj
how_to_perform.description: Talbiyah hajj is a special zikr allah that every Muslim says during Hajj and Umrah, showing full Iman and answering Allah’s call with a heart full of Barakah and hope for His mercy.
steps: When you wear your ihram, start saying labbaik allahumma labbaik with a clean heart.
While walking to Mina or Arafat, keep repeating this talbiyah hajj loudly with other Muslims.
If you feel tired or weak, softly say this hajj dua to keep your Amal strong and pure.
During the main hajj rituals, recite this talbiyah to remember Allah’s greatness and oneness.
After finishing your hajj or umrah, thank Allah by saying this dua for hajj with deep love.

data.title: Takbeer When Passing the Black Stone
data.introduction: Narrated Ibn `Abbas (RA): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed Tawaf (of the Ka`ba) ending a camel (at that time the Prophet [ﷺ] had foot injury). Whenever he came to the Corner (having the Black Stone) he would point out towards it with a thing in his hand and say, "Allahu-Akbar."

data.title: Dua Between Yemeni Corner and Black Stone
data.arabic: رَبَّنَا اٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
data.transliteration: Rabbanaa 'aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil-'aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa 'athaaban-naar
data.translation:
Our Lord, grant us the good things in this world and the good things in the next life and save us from the punishment of the Fire.

Narrated Abdullah Ibn Sa'ib (RA): I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recite this prayer in the middle of two rukans. (The dua is Mentioned above)
data.reference: The hadith is Hasan. Abu Dawud, 1892

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ مَا بَيْنَ الرُّكْنَيْنِ ‏{‏ رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ ‏}‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abdullah ibn as-Sa'ib: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say between the two corners: O Allah, bring us a blessing in this world and a blessing in the next and guard us from punishment of Hell. Sunan Abi Dawud 1892 [Hasan the hadith. Abu Dawood, 1892]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua Between Yemeni Corner and Black Stone
benefits.description: This powerful dua for tawaf asks Allah for good in both worlds and safety from Jahannam, making it a special prayer for every muslim during the blessed moments of tawaf.

This dua for tawaf brings Barakah in amal and keeps hearts close to Allah’s mercy.
Asking rabbana atina fid dunya hasanah saves from Jahannam ki azaab and fear.
Tawaf dua helps muslims get the best from this life and the next with Allah’s help.
Reciting rabbana dua at yemeni corner and black stone brings peace in every zikr.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Tawaf
when_to_recite.description: This dua for tawaf is a powerful masnun dua asking Allah for Barakah, good in dunya and akhirah, and safety from Jahannam, making your tawaf full of Iman and hope in every round.
points: While walking between the yemeni corner and black stone, recite the dua for tawaf.
During each round of tawaf, use the rabbana atina fid dunya hasanah for Barakah.
After finishing a full circle, make this tawaf dua to ask Allah for ease and forgiveness.
When feeling weak or tired in tawaf, repeat the rabbana atina dua for strength and Iman.
Before ending your tawaf, say the rabbana atina fid dunya hasanah full dua for acceptance.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua Between Yemeni Corner and Black Stone
how_to_perform.description: This dua for tawaf is recited between the Yemeni Corner and Black Stone during Hajj or Umrah. It is a best dua from the Quran, asking Allah for good in both worlds and safety from Jahannam. Every Muslim should know this powerful dua and use it with full Iman and hope in Allah’s mercy.
steps: Stand between the yemeni corner and black stone and recite rabbana atina fid dunya hasanah.
As you walk in tawaf, let your lips move with this rabbana dua and keep your heart focused.
When you feel tired, remember this is a masnoon dua and keep saying it for more Barakah.
After finishing your round, thank Allah for letting you say this powerful dua for tawaf.
If you forget, quietly repeat rabbana atina dua and ask Allah to accept your amal and prayers.

data.title: Dua for the day of Arafah
data.introduction: Narrated by Amr Ibn Shuaib (RA) from his grandfather through his father, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, “The best dua is the dua on the day of Arafa. The best prayer I and my predecessors have read is -
data.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
data.transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer
data.translation:
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without any partener. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.

Narrated by Amr Ibn Shuaib (RA) from his grandfather through his father, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, “The best dua is the dua on the day of Arafa. The best prayer I and my predecessors have read is - (The dua is Mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَمْرٍو، مُسْلِمُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الْحَذَّاءُ الْمَدِينِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ خَيْرُ الدُّعَاءِ دُعَاءُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ وَخَيْرُ مَا قُلْتُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّونَ مِنْ قَبْلِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏ وَحَمَّادُ بْنُ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ هُوَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ وَهُوَ أَبُو إِبْرَاهِيمَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ الْمَدَنِيُّ وَلَيْسَ هُوَ بِالْقَوِيِّ عِنْدَ أَهْلِ الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏ `
hadith.translation: Amr bin Shu`aib narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “The best of supplication is the supplication of the Day of `Arafah. And the best of what I and the Prophets before me have said is: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, Alone, without partner, to Him belongs all that exists, and to Him belongs the Praise, and He is powerful over all things. (Lā ilāha illallāh, waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, wa huwa `alā kulli shai’in qadīr).’” Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3585 [Hasan the hadith. Tirmizi, 3585]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for the Day of Arafah

Arafah dua gives Barakah in amal and makes Iman stronger on this blessed day.

Arafah fasting with this dua brings more reward and keeps hearts soft for zikr allah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Arafah Dua
when_to_recite.description: This arafah dua is a strong zikr allah for muslims on the day of arafah, asking for Barakah, forgiveness, and showing full Iman in Allah’s power and mercy during this blessed time.
points: On the day of arafah, keep repeating the arafah dua from morning till sunset.
While standing in Arafat, recite la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu with hope.
After salah on arafah day, use this dua for arafah to ask Allah for forgiveness.
During fasting on the day of arafah, make this arafah day dua for Barakah and mercy.
When making dua for family and ummah, add the arafah dua for more acceptance.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for the day of Arafah
how_to_perform.description: On the day of Arafah, this arafah dua is a best zikr allah for every Muslim. It is a masnoon dua that brings Barakah and forgiveness, and is loved by Allah. Recite it with full Iman, especially while fasting or making namaz dua.
