While standing in prayer or making dua for arafah, keep repeating this arafah day dua.
During your fast, let your tongue stay busy with this powerful arafah dua for more reward.
After salah, remember to say this masnoon dua and ask Allah for mercy and forgiveness.
If you are with family, invite them to join you in this zikr allah and make dua together for Barakah.

data.title: Al-Mash'ar al-Haram – Sacred Site in Muzdalifah
data.introduction: Narrated Jabir Ibn Abdillah (RA): At one point in his long hadith of the Hajj of the Prophet (ﷺ), he said, “Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) lay down until dawn. After the morning became clear, he performed the Fajr prayer with one Azan and one Iqamah. Then he came to Al-Mash'arul Haram on a Qaswaa [1].There he turned to the Qibla and supplicated to Allah and proclaimed the superiority, sovereignty and unity of Allah. He stayed there until the morning light became extremely bright. Then he left before the sun rose.' [2]
data.reference: [1] The name of the vehicle of the Prophet (ﷺ) [2] Muslim: 1218

data.title: When throwing each pebble at the Jamarat
data.introduction: Ibn `Umar (RA) used to do Rami of the Jamrat-ud-Dunya (the Jamra near to the Khaif mosque) with seven small stones and used to recite Takbir on throwing every pebble. He then would go ahead till he reached the level ground where he would stand facing the Qibla for a long time to invoke (Allah) while raising his hands (while invoking). Then he would do Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Wusta (middle Jamra) and then he would go to the left towards the middle ground, where he would stand facing the Qibla. He would remain standing there for a long period to invoke (Allah) while raising his hands, and would stand there for a long period. Then he would do Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Aqaba from the middle of the valley, but he would not stay by it, and then he would leave and say, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) doing like this."

data.title: Takbir when passing the black stone
data.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
data.transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar
data.translation:
Allah is the Most Great.

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed Tawaf (of the Ka`ba) ending a camel (at that time the Prophet [ﷺ] had foot injury). Whenever he came to the Corner (having the Black Stone) he would point out towards it with a thing in his hand and say, "Allahu-Akbar." (The dua is Mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ طَافَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْبَيْتِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ، كُلَّمَا أَتَى الرُّكْنَ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَىْءٍ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ وَكَبَّرَ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: The Prophet (ﷺ) performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba riding a camel, and every time he came in front of the Corner (having the Black Stone), he pointed towards it with something he had with him and said Takbir. [Bukhari: 1613, 1632]

benefits.title: Benefits of Takbir When Passing the Black Stone
benefits.description: Saying Allahu Akbar at the black stone during tawaf fills the heart with Allah’s greatness and brings more reward for every muslim making hajj or umrah.
points: Allahu akbar at hajar al aswad reminds muslims of Allah’s power and kingdom.
Takbir during tawaf brings Barakah in every step and keeps amal strong for muslims.
Saying this takbeer at black stone helps muslims focus on zikr allah and hajj dua.
Allahu akbar meaning lifts Iman and makes hearts soft for Allah’s mercy and help.
Takbir at hajj pilgrimage gives muslims more reward and keeps the mind on Allah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua During Tawaf
when_to_recite.description: This dua during tawaf is a short takbir showing Allah’s greatness, bringing Barakah and Iman to your tawaf, and making your heart remember Allah with every step near the black stone.
points: When reaching the black stone, say allahu akbar before starting each tawaf round.
While passing hajar al aswad, raise your voice with takbir for more reward.
At the start of every new circle, use the takbeer to begin your tawaf with zikr allah.
During umrah or hajj, repeat allahu akbar at the black stone for Barakah and ease.
After finishing tawaf, remember Allah with takbir to keep your heart full of Iman.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Takbir when passing the Black Stone
how_to_perform.description: Saying allahu akbar at the black stone is a simple but strong dua during tawaf. This takbir shows your love for Allah and is a sunnah for every Muslim doing hajj or umrah. It brings Barakah and keeps your heart close to zikr allah.
steps: When you reach hajar al aswad, raise your hand and say allahu akbar with full Iman.
As you pass the black stone, let your lips softly say this takbir for tawaf.
If you touch or point to hajar al aswad, say allahu akbar and feel the meaning in your heart.
After each round, remember this masnoon dua and thank Allah for letting you do this amal.
If you forget, quietly say allahu akbar and ask Allah to accept your hajj dua and prayers.

data.title: Sacred Site in Muzdalifah
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) rode on a camel called 'Kaswa'.When he finally came to Mash'arul Haram (a place in Muzdalifah), he prayed facing the Qibla and said takbeer -
data.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
data.transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar
data.translation:
Allah is the Most Great.

He recited La ila-ha illallah

benefits.title: Benefits of Takbir at the Sacred Site in Muzdalifah
benefits.description: At Muzdalifah, saying Allahu Akbar fills the heart with Allah’s greatness and helps every muslim remember Him during the important hajj rituals.
points: Allahu akbar at muzdalifah hajj keeps the mind on Allah’s power and mercy.
Takbir at this sacred site brings Barakah in hajj rituals and makes amal strong.
Saying allahu akbar helps muslims stay focused on zikr allah and hajj dua.
Takbeer at muzdalifah gives muslims more reward and lifts Iman in every step.
Allahu akbar at hajj ka tarika reminds muslims of Allah’s kingdom and greatness.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Sacred Site in Muzdalifah
when_to_recite.description: This takbir at Muzdalifah is a key part of hajj rituals, showing your Iman and love for Allah, and brings Barakah as you follow the hajj guide and remember Allah after the day of Arafah.
points: After leaving Arafah, say allahu akbar at Muzdalifah to start your zikr allah.
While collecting pebbles for stoning of the devil, repeat the takbeer for hajj ka tarika.
During the night at muzdalifah hajj, use this takbir to keep your heart close to Allah.
Before moving to Mina, recite allahu akbar as part of your hajj rituals and hajj dua.
When feeling tired in muzdalifah, remember allah akbar to gain strength and Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua at Sacred Site in Muzdalifah
how_to_perform.description: During muzdalifah hajj, saying allahu akbar is a simple but strong zikr allah. This takbir is part of the hajj rituals and brings Barakah to your amal. Every Muslim should say this masnoon dua with a heart full of Iman and hope.
steps: When you reach muzdalifah, say allahu akbar and remember Allah’s greatness in your heart.
After collecting pebbles for stoning of the devil, softly say this takbir for more reward.
While resting at muzdalifah, keep your tongue busy with allahu akbar and make dua for your family.
Before leaving muzdalifah, say this masnoon dua and thank Allah for letting you finish this hajj step.
If you feel tired, quietly repeat allahu akbar and ask Allah for Barakah and strength in your amal.

data.title: Sunnah of Rami at the Jamarat
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say when throwing pebbles in three jamarat:
data.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
data.transliteration: Allahu 'Akbar
data.translation:
Allah is the Most Great.

Then he would move forward a little and stand facing the Qibla and would do Dua with both hands raised in the first Jamra and the second Jamra. But at the time of throwing every pebble at Jamratul Akbaba, he would say ‘Allahu Akbar’ and return without staying there.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَرْمِي الْجَمْرَةَ الدُّنْيَا بِسَبْعِ حَصَيَاتٍ، يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى إِثْرِ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ، ثُمَّ يَتَقَدَّمُ حَتَّى يُسْهِلَ فَيَقُومَ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ فَيَقُومُ طَوِيلاً، وَيَدْعُو وَيَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ يَرْمِي الْوُسْطَى، ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ فَيَسْتَهِلُ وَيَقُومُ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ فَيَقُومُ طَوِيلاً وَيَدْعُو وَيَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ، وَيَقُومُ طَوِيلاً، ثُمَّ يَرْمِي جَمْرَةَ ذَاتِ الْعَقَبَةِ مِنْ بَطْنِ الْوَادِي، وَلاَ يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا ثُمَّ يَنْصَرِفُ فَيَقُولُ هَكَذَا رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَفْعَلُهُ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Salim: Ibn `Umar used to do Rami of the Jamrat-ud-Dunya (the Jamra near to the Khaif mosque) with seven small stones and used to recite Takbir on throwing every pebble. He then would go ahead till he reached the level ground where he would stand facing the Qibla for a long time to invoke (Allah) while raising his hands (while invoking). Then he would do Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Wusta (middle Jamra) and then he would go to the left towards the middle ground, where he would stand facing the Qibla. He would remain standing there for a long period to invoke (Allah) while raising his hands, and would stand there for a long period. Then he would do Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Aqaba from the middle of the valley, but he would not stay by it, and then he would leave and say, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) doing like this." [Bukhari: 1751]

benefits.title: Benefits of Takbir at the Jamarat in Hajj
benefits.description: Saying Allahu Akbar at the jamarat in hajj makes the heart strong and helps every Muslim follow the sunnah while stoning the devil.
points: Allahu akbar at jamarat in hajj reminds Muslims of Allah’s power and help.
Takbir during stoning of the devil brings Barakah and keeps amal pure for Muslims.
Saying allahu akbar at jamarat bridge helps Muslims focus on zikr Allah and hajj dua.
Takbeer at hajj rituals gives more reward and lifts Iman in every Muslim’s heart.
Allahu akbar at jamarat in hajj keeps the mind on Allah’s greatness and kingdom.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Sunnah of Rami at the Jamarat
when_to_recite.description: This takbir at the jamarat in hajj is a strong way to show your Iman, follow the hajj guide, and bring Barakah while doing the stoning of the devil and other hajj rituals with full heart.
points: As you throw each pebble at the jamarat in hajj, say allahu akbar for every throw.
While standing on the jamarat bridge, repeat the takbeer to follow the hajj rituals.
After finishing the stoning of the devil, use allahu akbar to thank Allah for His help.
Before moving to the next jamarat, recite takbeerat to keep your zikr Allah strong.
When feeling weak during rami, remember allahu akbar for strength and Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Sunnah of Rami at the Jamarat
how_to_perform.description: When doing jamarat in hajj, saying allahu akbar is a main part of the hajj rituals. This takbir is a masnoon dua that brings Barakah and keeps your heart close to zikr Allah. Every Muslim should follow this sunnah with full Iman and hope for Allah’s mercy.
steps: As you throw each pebble at the jamarat bridge, say allahu akbar with a strong voice.
After stoning of the devil, let your lips softly repeat this takbeer for more reward.
When you finish your rami, thank Allah for letting you do this hajj dua and ask for Barakah.
If you feel weak, quietly say allahu akbar and ask Allah for help in your amal and prayers.
While waiting your turn, keep your tongue busy with this masnoon dua and remember Allah’s greatness.

data.title: Dua for Safa Marwa
data.introduction: When the Prophet (ﷺ) approached mount as-Safaa he would recite:
data.arabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ
data.transliteration: Inna assafa wal-marwata min shaAAa-iri Allah
data.translation:
Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. [1]

And then say: I begin by that which Allah began. so he started with as-Safaa and climbed it until he could see the Ka'bah, he then faced it and said:
data.reference: [1] Al-Baqarah: 158 [2] Muslim 2/888, No. 1218; And the verse is verse 158 of Surah Al-Baqara.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Safa Marwa
benefits.description: This dua for safa marwa reminds every Muslim that these places are special signs from Allah, making the heart full of respect and hope during the sa’i.
points: Saying dua for safa marwa helps Muslims remember Allah’s signs and mercy.
Safa and marwa dua brings Barakah in every step and keeps amal strong in sa’i.
Dua at safa and marwa lifts Iman and fills the heart with hope for Allah’s help.
Safa marwa dua reminds Muslims to follow the sunnah and trust Allah’s wisdom.
Making dua for safa and marwa keeps zikr Allah alive in every Muslim’s heart.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Safa Marwa
when_to_recite.description: This dua for safa marwa reminds you that safa and marwa are signs of Allah, bringing Barakah and Iman as you follow the hajj guide and make zikr Allah during your walk between the two hills.
points: At the start of sa’i, recite dua for safa marwa when you reach the foot of safa.
While standing on safa, say the safa and marwa dua to remember Allah’s signs.
Before walking from safa to marwa, use this dua for safa and marwa for Barakah.
When you reach marwa, repeat the dua at safa and marwa to keep your zikr Allah.
After finishing the rounds, remember the safa marwa dua to thank Allah for His help.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua for Safa Marwa
how_to_perform.description: When you walk between Safa and Marwa during Umrah or Hajj, this dua for safa marwa reminds you that these hills are signs from Allah. Reciting this quranic dua brings Barakah and keeps your heart close to Allah’s mercy.
steps: Stand at Safa, face the Kaaba, and recite the dua for safa marwa with full Iman.
As you walk between safa and marwa, keep saying this safa marwa dua in your heart.
When you reach Marwa, pause and repeat the dua at safa and marwa to remember Allah.
During each round, let your tongue move with this masnoon dua and ask for Barakah.
After finishing all rounds, thank Allah for letting you do this amal and make more dua Muslim.

data.title: Dua for Qurbani (Bismillah)
data.introduction: Jundub bin Abdullah (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said that the sacrificer will sacrifice by saying ‘Bismillah-h’.
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
data.transliteration: Bismillaah
data.translation: In the name of Allah.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ثُمَّ خَطَبَ، ثُمَّ ذَبَحَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فَلْيَذْبَحْ أُخْرَى مَكَانَهَا، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَذْبَحْ فَلْيَذْبَحْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Jundab: On the day of Nahr the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the prayer and delivered the Khutba and then slaughtered the sacrifice and said, "Anybody who slaughtered (his sacrifice) before the prayer should slaughter another animal in lieu of it, and the one who has not yet slaughtered should slaughter the sacrifice mentioning Allah's name on it." [Bukhari: 985]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Qurbani (Bismillah)
benefits.description: Saying bismillah before qurbani brings Allah’s name to the act, making the sacrifice pure and full of blessings for every Muslim on eid al adha.
points: Bismillah in qurbani dua makes the sacrifice halal and accepted by Allah.
Saying bismillah meaning in the name of Allah brings Barakah in qurbani amal.
Dua for qurbani keeps the heart soft and reminds Muslims of Allah’s mercy.
Qurbani ki dua helps Muslims follow qurbani rules and sunnah in every step.
Bismillah before goat qurbani or bakra eid keeps zikr Allah alive in the heart.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Qurbani (Bismillah)
when_to_recite.description: This qurbani dua with bismillah brings Barakah and makes your qurbani Amal right, showing Iman and following qurbani rules on bakra eid and eid al adha with a clean heart.
points: Before starting the qurbani, say bismillah to begin your sacrifice in the name of Allah.
When holding the knife for goat qurbani, recite the qurbani dua for a proper Amal.
As you follow qurbani ka tarika, use bismillah meaning to keep your niyyah pure.
While teaching kids about qurbani rules, repeat bismillah in English for easy learning.
After finishing the sacrifice, remember bismillahi allahu akbar to thank Allah for Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Qurbani Dua
how_to_perform.description: Before you start the qurbani, saying the qurbani dua with Bismillah brings Barakah and makes your amal accepted. This simple Islamic dua is a must for every Muslim doing qurbani on Eid al Adha.
steps: At the time of qurbani, say bismillah with allahuakbar before you touch the knife.
When you stand by the animal, softly recite the qurbani dua for qurbani ka tarika.
While doing goat qurbani or any animal, keep bismillah in English meaning in your heart.
After the sacrifice, thank Allah and remember the qurbani rules and make more dua Muslim.
If you forget, say bismillah as soon as you remember to keep your qurbani ki dua complete.

data.title: Dua for Slaughtering Animal (Bismillah Allahu Akbar)
data.introduction: Anas (RA) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) placed his feet on the two jaws of a goat with white and black horns and sacrificed him saying Bismillahi wAllahu akbar.
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
data.transliteration: Bismillaahi wAllahu 'Akbar
data.translation: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great!

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ ضَحَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِكَبْشَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ أَقْرَنَيْنِ، ذَبَحَهُمَا بِيَدِهِ، وَسَمَّى وَكَبَّرَ وَوَضَعَ رِجْلَهُ عَلَى صِفَاحِهِمَا‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) offered as sacrifices, two horned rams, black and white in color. He slaughtered them with his own hands and mentioned Allah's Name over them and said Takbir and put his foot on their sides. [Bukhari: 5565]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Slaughtering Animal (Bismillah Allahu Akbar)
benefits.description: Saying bismillah allahu akbar before slaughtering makes the act pure and brings Allah’s blessings, keeping the qurbani accepted and full of reward for every Muslim.
points: Bismillah allahu akbar in dua for slaughtering animal makes the meat halal.
This qurbani dua brings Barakah and keeps the amal clean in Allah’s eyes.
Saying allahu akbar reminds Muslims of Allah’s greatness and power in qurbani.
Bismillah allahu akbar helps Muslims follow qurbani takbeer and sunnah rules.
Dua for slaughtering animal keeps zikr Allah alive and hearts soft with mercy.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Slaughtering Animal (Bismillah Allahu Akbar)
when_to_recite.description: This dua for slaughtering animal with bismillah allahu akbar brings Barakah, keeps your Amal right, and follows the qurbani takbeer as you remember Allah’s name and greatness in every step.
points: Before touching the animal for qurbani, say bismillah allahu akbar to start with Iman.
When holding the knife, recite the dua for slaughtering animal for a halal sacrifice.
As you follow qurbani takbeer, use bismillahi allahu akbar to keep your niyyah clean.
While teaching kids what does allahu akbar mean, repeat this dua for easy learning.
After finishing the sacrifice, remember allahuakbar to thank Allah for His Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua for Slaughtering Animal
how_to_perform.description: When you do the qurbani, saying the dua for slaughtering animal with bismillah allahu akbar is a must for every Muslim. This masnoon dua brings Barakah and makes your qurbani accepted by Allah.
steps: Before touching the knife, say bismillah allahu akbar with full Iman and clear heart.
As you face the animal, softly recite the dua for slaughtering animal for qurbani takbeer.
While cutting, keep the meaning of allahu akbar in your mind and do zikr Allah.
After the sacrifice, thank Allah and make a Muslim prayer for your qurbani to be accepted.
If you forget, say bismillah allahu akbar as soon as you remember to complete your amal.

data.title: Dua Before Sacrificing Animal (Qurbani Dua)
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اَللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اَللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
data.transliteration: Bismillaahi wAllahu 'Akbar [Allaahumma minka wa laka] Allaahumma taqabbal minnee
data.translation: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great! [O Allah, from You and to You.] O Allah, accept it from me.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua Before Sacrificing Animal (Qurbani Dua)
benefits.description: This dua for qurbani brings Allah’s name and greatness to the sacrifice, asking Him to accept the act and fill it with blessings for every Muslim on bakra eid.
points: Bismillah allahu akbar in qurbani dua makes the sacrifice halal and pure for Allah.
Dua for acceptance asks Allah to accept the qurbani and give more reward.
Qurbani ki dua keeps the heart humble and reminds Muslims of Allah’s mercy.
Saying this prayer for acceptance brings Barakah and makes amal strong in qurbani.
Dua for qurbani helps Muslims follow sunnah and keeps zikr Allah alive in every step.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Qurbani
when_to_recite.description: This dua for qurbani is said to bring Barakah and acceptance from Allah when you offer your sacrifice, making your Amal pure and your qurbani ki dua in English full of Iman and hope for reward.
points: Before starting the sacrifice, say bismillah allahu akbar as qurbani dua for Barakah.
When holding the animal for qurbani, recite the dua for qurbani to seek Allah’s acceptance.
Just before the knife touches, use the qurbani ki dua in English for pure Amal.
After making intention for qurbani, read this prayer for acceptance to please Allah.
While teaching kids about qurbani, share this masnoon dua to grow love for Islamic dua.

how_to_perform.title: How to Perform Dua for Qurbani
how_to_perform.description: Before you do the qurbani, this dua for qurbani helps your amal get Barakah and makes your sacrifice accepted by Allah. Reciting this qurbani dua with a clean heart is a big part of Eid al Adha for every Muslim.
steps: Stand by the animal, say bismillah allahu akbar and make your niyyah for qurbani dua.
As you hold the knife, softly recite the dua for acceptance and qurbani ki dua in English.
While doing the sacrifice, remember to say allaahumma taqabbal minnee with full hope.
After finishing, thank Allah and make a prayer for acceptance of your qurbani and zikr Allah.
If you forget, say bismillahi allahu akbar as soon as you remember to complete your amal.

data.title: Dua at the Time of Slaughtering (Qurbani Dua)
data.introduction: Prophet (ﷺ) used to say at the time of slaughter -
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَمِنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ
data.transliteration: Bismillaahi, Allah-humma Taqabbal min Muhammadin wa Al-i-Muhammadin, wa min Ummati Muhammadin
data.translation:
In the name of Allah, O Allah, accept it from Muhammad, Muhammad's family and from Muhammad's Ummah (followers)

Then he sacrificed it.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ حَيْوَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ بِكَبْشٍ أَقْرَنَ يَطَأُ فِي سَوَادٍ وَيَبْرُكُ فِي سَوَادٍ وَيَنْظُرُ فِي سَوَادٍ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ لِيُضَحِّيَ بِهِ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ هَلُمِّي الْمُدْيَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اشْحَذِيهَا بِحَجَرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلَتْ ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا وَأَخَذَ الْكَبْشَ فَأَضْجَعَهُ ثُمَّ ذَبَحَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَمِنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ضَحَّى بِهِ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that a ram with black legs, black belly and black (circles) round the eyes should be brought to him, so that he should sacrifice it. He said to 'A'isha: Give me the large knife, and then said: Sharpen it on a stone. She did that. He then took it (the knife) and then the ram; he placed it on the ground and then sacrificed it, saying: Bismillah, Allah-humma Taqabbal min Muhammadin wa Al-i-Muhammadin, wa min Ummati Muhammadin (In the name of Allah," O Allah, accept [this sacrifice] on behalf of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad and the Umma of Muhammad" ). [Muslim: 1967]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua at the Time of Slaughtering (Qurbani Dua)
benefits.description: This qurbani ki dua asks Allah to accept the sacrifice for Prophet Muhammad, his family, and the whole ummah, filling the act with blessings and unity for every Muslim.
points: Bismillah in qurbani dua makes the sacrifice halal and pure for Allah’s sake.
Dua for acceptance brings Barakah and reward for the whole ummah of Muhammad.
Qurbani ki dua keeps the heart soft and reminds Muslims of unity in the ummah.
Saying this prayer for acceptance asks Allah to accept qurbani from all Muslims.
Dua for qurbani at eid al adha feast of sacrifice keeps zikr Allah alive in hearts.

As you hold the knife, recite the qurbani ki dua for acceptance for all Muslims and family.
While doing the sacrifice, remember to say dua for ummah and ask Allah for Barakah.
After finishing, thank Allah and make a prayer for acceptance for the whole Ummah.
If you forget, say bismillah as soon as you remember to complete your amal and qurbani.

data.title: Dua for Sacrificing Animal
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say during the slaughter-
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ هَذَا عَنِّي وَعَمَّنْ لَمْ يُضَحِّ مِنْ أُمَّتِي
data.transliteration: Bismillah-hi wallahu akbaru haza 'anni wa amman lam udahh-hi min ummati
data.translation: In the name of Allah, Allah is Most Great. This is from me and from those who did not sacrifice from my community.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي الإِسْكَنْدَرَانِيَّ - عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الأَضْحَى بِالْمُصَلَّى فَلَمَّا قَضَى خُطْبَتَهُ نَزَلَ مِنْ مِنْبَرِهِ وَأُتِيَ بِكَبْشٍ فَذَبَحَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ هَذَا عَنِّي وَعَمَّنْ لَمْ يُضَحِّ مِنْ أُمَّتِي ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: I witnessed sacrificing along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at the place of prayer. When he finished his sermon, he descended from his pulpit, and a ram was brought to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slaughtered it with his hand, and said: In the name of Allah, Allah, is Most Great. This is from me and from those who did not sacrifice from my community. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 2810]

data.title: Protection from Satan's Whisper Hadith
data.introduction: Allah says: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

data.title: Protection from Jinn Hadith
data.introduction: 1. Seek refuge in Allah from Satan; 2. Give Azan [1] 3. Remembrance and recitation of the Qur'an; And [2] 4. Spitting three times on the left during salah and recitation of the Qur'an. Moreover, the other things that drive away the devils are the adhkaar of morning and evening, the adhkaar of sleep, the adhkaar of awakening, the adhkaar of entering and leaving the house, the adhkaar of entering and leaving the mosque, etc., and those adhkaar which are according to the Shari'ah. For example, Ayatul Kursi, the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah during sleep. Moreover, the person who recites "La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu, wahua 'ala qulli shayin qadir" a hundred times, will give him complete protection for that day. Also giving the Azan, Satan fled. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, “Do not turn your houses into graves. Surely Satan flees from the house where Surah Al-Baqarah is recited.”

data.title: Dua for Protection from Shaytan (Masnun Dua)

data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
data.transliteration: A‛oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
data.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ صُرَدٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَجُلاَنِ يَسْتَبَّانِ، فَأَحَدُهُمَا احْمَرَّ وَجْهُهُ وَانْتَفَخَتْ أَوْدَاجُهُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ كَلِمَةً لَوْ قَالَهَا ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ مَا يَجِدُ، لَوْ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ‏.‏ ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ مَا يَجِدُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لَهُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَهَلْ بِي جُنُونٌ
hadith.translation: Narrated Sulaiman bin Surd: While I was sitting in the company of the Prophet, two men abused each other and the face of one of them became red with anger, and his jugular veins swelled (i.e. he became furious). On that the Prophet said, "I know a word, the saying of which will cause him to relax, if he does say it. If he says: 'I seek Refuge with Allah from Satan.' then all is anger will go away." Some body said to him, "The Prophet has said, 'Seek refuge with Allah from Satan."' The angry man said, "Am I mad?" [Bukhari: 3282]

data.title: Protection Dua from Devil
data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهِ وَنَفْخِهِ وَنَفْثِهِ
data.transliteration: A‛oodhu Billa-Hish Sami’il-‘Alimi Minash Shaytaanir rajeem Min Hamzihi Wa Nafkhihi Wa Nafthihi
data.translation: I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing and the All-Knowing from the accursed devil, from his madness or evil suggestion (Hamz), from his puffing up (Nafkh), and from his witchcraft (Nafth).

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلاَمِ بْنُ مُطَهَّرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الرِّفَاعِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ كَبَّرَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهِ وَنَفْخِهِ وَنَفْثِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَهَذَا الْحَدِيثُ يَقُولُونَ هُوَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ مُرْسَلاً الْوَهَمُ مِنْ جَعْفَرٍ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated AbuSa'id al-Khudri: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up to pray at night (for tahajjud prayer) he uttered the takbir and then said: "Glory be to Thee, O Allah," and "Praise be to Thee" and "Blessed is Thy name," and Exalted is Thy greatness." and "There is no god but Thee." He then said: "There is no god but Allah" three times; he then said: "Allah is altogether great" three times: "I seek refuge in Allah, All-Hearing and All-Knowing from the accursed devil, from his evil suggestion (hamz), from his puffing up (nafkh), and from his spitting (nafth)" He then recited (the Qur'an). Abu Dawud said: It is said that this tradition has been narrated by 'Ali b. 'Ali from al-Hasan omitting the name of the Companion of the Prophet (ﷺ). The misunderstanding occurred on the part of Ja'far. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 775]

data.title: Dua against Shaytan Whisper
data.introduction: If you notice the presence of Satan in the prayer, say this dua and spit three times on the left side -
data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
data.transliteration: A‛oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
data.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي، الْعَلاَءِ أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي الْعَاصِ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ حَالَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ صَلاَتِي وَقِرَاءَتِي يَلْبِسُهَا عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ذَاكَ شَيْطَانٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ خِنْزِبٌ فَإِذَا أَحْسَسْتَهُ فَتَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُ وَاتْفِلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ ثَلاَثًا ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَفَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ فَأَذْهَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَنِّي ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Uthman b. Abu al-'As reported that he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, the Satan intervenes between me and my prayer and my reciting of the Qur'an and he confounds me. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:, That is (the doing of a) Satan (devil) who is known as Khinzab, and when you perceive its effect, seek refuge with Allah from it and spit three times to your left. I did that and Allah dispelled that from me. [Muslim: 2203]

data.title: Dua for Safety From Shaytan in Mosque
data.introduction: When entering the mosque, say -
data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
data.transliteration: A‛oodhu Billaahil ‘Azeem, Wabi Wazhihil Kareem, Wa Sultaanihil Qadeem Minash Shaytaanir rajeem
data.translation:
I seek refuge in Allah, the Magnificent, and in His noble face, and in his eternal domain, from the accursed Devil.

Uqbah (RA) said, ‘When someone recites this du’a, the devil says, ‘This man escaped from me (evil and intrigue) for the whole day.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ بِشْرِ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ حَيْوَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ، قَالَ لَقِيتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ مُسْلِمٍ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ حَدَّثْتَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَقَطُّ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِذَا قَالَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ حُفِظَ مِنِّي سَائِرَ الْيَوْمِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Haiwah b. Shuraih reported : I met ‘Uqbah b. Muslim and said to him: it has been reported to me that someone has narrated to you from the prophet (ﷺ) that when he entered the mosque, he would say: I seek refuge in Allah, the Magnificent, and in His noble face, and in his eternal domain, from the accursed Devil. He asked : is it so much only? I said: Yes. He said: when anyone says so. The devil says: he is protected from me all the day long. [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 466]

data.title: Dua for Entering Mosque (Masnoon Dua)
data.introduction: When entering the mosque, say -
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma`simni min ash-shaytaanir-rajeem
data.translation: O Allah, protect me from Satan the outcast.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدٌ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَإِذَا خَرَجَ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ وَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that: The Mesenger of Allah said: "When anyone of enters the mosque, let him send peace upon the Prophet, then let him say: 'Allahumma aftahli abwaba rahmatik (O Allah, open to me the gates of Your mercy).' And when he leaves, let him send peace upon the Prophet and say: 'Allahumma- simni minash-shaitanir-rajim (O Allah, protect me from the accursed Shaitan).'" [Sahih (Albani). Ibn Majah: 773]

data.title: Satan touch newborn babies (Hadith)
data.introduction: Narrated by Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When any human being is born. Satan touches him at both sides of the body with his two fingers, except Esa (As), the son of Mary, whom Satan tried to touch but failed, for he touched the placenta-cover instead."

data.title: Islamic Dua for Newborn Baby
data.introduction: It is narrated on the authority of Husain (RA) that he went to teach a man how to give greetings and said, You will say:
data.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
data.transliteration: BaarakAllahu laka fil-mawhoobi laka, wa shakartal-waahiba, wa balagha 'ashuddahu, wa ruziqta birrahu.
data.translation: May Allah bless you with His gift to you, and may you (the new parent) give thanks (to Allah - the giver), may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، - وَهُوَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ - حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْمُغِيرَةِ - عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ فِي النَّوْمِ تَفْرِيطٌ إِنَّمَا التَّفْرِيطُ فِي الْيَقَظَةِ أَنْ تُؤَخَّرَ صَلاَةٌ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ وَقْتُ أُخْرَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Qatadah reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: There is no remissness in sleep, it is only when one is awake that there is remissness when you delay saying the prayer till the time for the next prayer comes. Sunan Abi Dawud 441 [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawood: 441]

data.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ وَأَجْزَلَ اللَّهُ ثَوَابَكَ
data.transliteration: Baarakallahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jazaakAllahu khayran, wa razaqakAllahu mithlahu, wa 'ajzalallahu thawaabaka

data.title: Powerful Dua for Evil Eye Protection
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to seek Refuge with Allah for Hasan (RA) and Husain (RA) and say:
data.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا [أَعُوْذُ] بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
data.transliteration: Oo-'idhukumaa (For self: A'ooudhu) bi kalimaat-illaahit-taammati min kulli shaytaanin wa haammah, wa min kulli ‛aynin laammah
data.translation:
I commend you to the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.

The Prophet (ﷺ) say: "Your forefather Ibrahim (AS) used to seek Refuge with Allah for Ishmael (AS) and Isaac (AS) by reciting this dua.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الْمِنْهَالِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَوِّذُ الْحَسَنَ وَالْحُسَيْنَ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَبَاكُمَا كَانَ يُعَوِّذُ بِهَا إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to seek Refuge with Allah for Al-Hasan and Al-Husain and say: "Your forefather (i.e. Abraham) used to seek Refuge with Allah for Ishmael and Isaac by reciting the following: 'O Allah! I seek Refuge with Your Perfect Words from every devil and from poisonous pests and from every evil, harmful, envious eye.' " [Bukhari: 3371]

data.title: Powerful Night Protection Dua (Masnun Dua)
data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
data.transliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaatil-latee laa yujaawizuhunna barrun wa laa faajirum min sharri maa khalaqa, wa bara'a wa dhara'a, wa min sharri maa yanzilu minas-samaa'i, wa min sharri maa ya'ruju feehaa, wa min sharri maa dhara'a fil-'ardhi, wa min sharri ma yakhruju minhaa, wa min sharri fitanil-layli wannahaari, wa min sharri kulli taariqin 'illaa taariqan yatruqu bikhayrin yaa Rahmaan
data.translation: I take refuge within Allah's perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. [I take refuge] from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. [I take refuge] from the evil that is spread on earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.

data.title: Dua for Hardship (Qaddar Allah Dua)
data.arabic: قَدَّرَ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
data.transliteration: Qaddar-Allahu wa maa shaa’a fa‛al
data.translation:
Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.

Abu Huraira (RA) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A strong believer is better and is more lovable to Allah than a weak believer, and there is good in everyone, (but) cherish that which gives you benefit (in the Hereafter) and seek help from Allah and do not lose heart, and if anything (in the form of trouble) comes to you, don't say: If I had not done that, it would not have happened so and so, but say: (The dua is Mentioned above) your "if" opens the (gate) for the Satan.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ احْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَلاَ تَعْجِزْ وَإِنْ أَصَابَكَ شَىْءٌ فَلاَ تَقُلْ لَوْ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ كَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏ وَلَكِنْ قُلْ قَدَرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ فَإِنَّ لَوْ تَفْتَحُ عَمَلَ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A strong believer is better and is more lovable to Allah than a weak believer, and there is good in everyone, (but) cherish that which gives you benefit (in the Hereafter) and seek help from Allah and do not lose heart, and if anything (in the form of trouble) comes to you, don't say: If I had not done that, it would not have happened so and so, but say: Allah did that what He had ordained to do and your" if" opens the (gate) for the Satan. [Muslim: 2664]

data.title: Dua After Sin: 2 Rakats & Istighfar (Hadith)
data.introduction: Narrated by Ali ibn abu Talib: Abu Bakr narrated to me a hadith, and Abu Bakr narrated it truthfully. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: When a servant (of Allah) commits a sin, and he performs ablution well, and then stands and prays two rak'ahs, and asks pardon of Allah, Allah pardons him. He then recited this verse: And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except Allah? - and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know. Those - their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens beneath which rivers flow [in Paradise], wherein they will abide eternally; and excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers.(Surah Al 'Imran 3: 135-136)

data.title: Dua When Rooster Crows or Donkey Brays (Auzubillah Minashaitan Nirajeem)
data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيـمِ
data.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
data.translation:
I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When you hear the crowing of rooster, ask for Allah's Blessings for (their crowing indicates that) they have seen an angel. And when you hear the braying of donkeys, seek Refuge with Allah from Satan for (their braying indicates) that they have seen a Satan. [1] In another narration when you hear the rooster crowing, ask Allah for some of His grace, for they have seen as angel; but when you hear donkey braying, seek refuge in Allah from the devil, for it has seen the devil. [2]

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ، فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكًا، وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ، فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَانًا ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When you hear the crowing of roosters, ask for Allah's Blessings for (their crowing indicates that) they have seen an angel. And when you hear the braying of donkeys, seek Refuge with Allah from Satan for (their braying indicates) that they have seen a Satan." [[1] Bukhari: 3303 [2] Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 5103]

data.title: Dua for Protection from Satan
data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
data.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem

I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَأْتِي الشَّيْطَانُ أَحَدَكُمْ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ خَلَقَ كَذَا مَنْ خَلَقَ كَذَا حَتَّى يَقُولَ مَنْ خَلَقَ رَبَّكَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَهُ فَلْيَسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ، وَلْيَنْتَهِ ‏" ‏‏.‏

data.title: Dua for Doubts in Faith (Amantu billahi dua)
data.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
data.transliteration: Aamantu billaahi wa Rusulihi
data.translation:
I believe in Allah and His Messenger.

It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (RA) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Men will continue to question one another till this is propounded: Allah created all things but who created Allah? He who found himself confronted with such a situation should say: (The dua is Mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِهَارُونَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَزَالُ النَّاسُ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ حَتَّى يُقَالَ هَذَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ فَمَنْ خَلَقَ اللَّهَ فَمَنْ وَجَدَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا فَلْيَقُلْ آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Men will continue to question one another till this is propounded: Allah created all things but who created Allah? He who found himself confronted with such a situation should say: I affirm my faith in Allah. [Muslim: 134]

data.title: Powerful Dua Against Shaytan's Whisper
data.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
data.transliteration: Allahu 'Ahad. Allahus-Samad. Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan 'ahad
data.translation:
He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent.

Abu Hurairah (RA) reported that Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: People will continue to ask one another(questions) till this is pronounced: Allah created all things, but who created Allah ? Whoever comes across anything of that, he should say: (The dua is mentioned above) Then he spit three times on his left side, seeking refuge with Allah from Satan.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْفَضْلِ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْحَاقَ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُتْبَةُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، مَوْلَى بَنِي تَيْمٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِذَا قَالُوا ذَلِكَ فَقُولُوا ‏ {‏ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ * لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ * وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ‏} ‏ ثُمَّ لْيَتْفُلْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ ثَلاَثًا وَلْيَسْتَعِذْ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated AbuHurayrah: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: He then mentioned a tradition like it. This version adds: When they propound that, say: "Say Allah is one. Allah is He to Whom men repair. He has not begotten and He has not been begotten, and no one is equal to Him." Then one should spit three times on his left side and seek refuge in Allah from Satan. [Hasan (Albani). Abu Dawud: 4722]

data.title: Powerful Dua to Strengthen Iman
data.introduction: When doubt in belive comes to your mind, you say -
data.arabic: هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
data.transliteration: Huwal-'Awwalu wal-'Aakhiru wadh-Dhaahiru wal-Baatinu, wa Huwa bikulli shay'in 'Aleem
data.translation:
He is the First and the Last, the Most High and the Most Near. And He is the Knower of all things. (Sura Al-Hadid 57:3)

Abu Zumayl (RA) said: I asked Ibn Abbas (RA), I have a difficult question in my mind. He asked: What is it? I replied: I swear by Allah, I cannot speak about it. He asked me: Is it something doubtful? and he laughed. He then said: No one could escape that, until Allah, the exalted, revealed: (94) So if you are in doubt, [O Muhammad], about that which We have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the Scripture before you. The truth has certainly come to you from your Lord, so never be among the doubters. (95) And never be of those who deny the signs of Allah and [thus] be among the losers. (Sura Yunus 10:94-95)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَمَّارٍ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُمَيْلٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْتُ مَا شَىْءٌ أَجِدُهُ فِي صَدْرِي قَالَ مَا هُوَ قُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ مَا أَتَكَلَّمُ بِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي أَشَىْءٌ مِنْ شَكٍّ قَالَ وَضَحِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا نَجَا مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَحَدٌ - قَالَ - حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏ {‏ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ فِي شَكٍّ مِمَّا أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ فَاسْأَلِ الَّذِينَ يَقْرَءُونَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ ‏} ‏ الآيَةَ قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي إِذَا وَجَدْتَ فِي نَفْسِكَ شَيْئًا فَقُلْ ‏{‏ هُوَ الأَوَّلُ وَالآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ ‏}‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: AbuZumayl said: I asked Ibn Abbas, saying: What is that I find in my breast? He asked: What is it? I replied: I swear by Allah, I cannot speak about it. He asked me: Is it something doubtful? and he laughed. He then said: No one could escape that, until Allah, the exalted, revealed: "If thou went in doubt as to what we have revealed unto thee, and ask those who have been reading the Book from before thee." He said: If you find something in your heart, say: He is the first and the Last, the Evident and the Immanent, and He has full knowledge of all things. [Hasan (Albani). Abu Dawud: 5110]

data.title: Dua for Protection from Hell & Dajjal
data.arabic: نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ
data.transliteration: NA‛oodhu billaahi min ‘adhaabin naar. NA‛oodhu billaahi min ‘adhaabil qabr. NA‛oodhu billaahi minal fitaani maa zahara minhaa wa maa batan. NA‛oodhu billaahi min fitnatid dajjaal
data.translation: We seek refuge with Allah from the torment of Hell, Seek refuge with Allah from the torment of the grave. We seek refuge with Allah from turmoil and its visible and invisible aspects. We seek refuge with Allah from the turmoil of the Dajjal.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدٌ الْجُرَيْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ وَلَمْ أَشْهَدْهُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَكِنْ حَدَّثَنِيهِ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَائِطٍ لِبَنِي النَّجَّارِ عَلَى بَغْلَةٍ لَهُ وَنَحْنُ مَعَهُ إِذْ حَادَتْ بِهِ فَكَادَتْ تُلْقِيهِ وَإِذَا أَقْبُرٌ سِتَّةٌ أَوْ خَمْسَةٌ أَوْ أَرْبَعَةٌ - قَالَ كَذَا كَانَ يَقُولُ الْجُرَيْرِيُّ - فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ يَعْرِفُ أَصْحَابَ هَذِهِ الأَقْبُرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ أَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَتَى مَاتَ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَاتُوا فِي الإِشْرَاكِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةَ تُبْتَلَى فِي قُبُورِهَا فَلَوْلاَ أَنْ لاَ تَدَافَنُوا لَدَعَوْتُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُسْمِعَكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ الَّذِي أَسْمَعُ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: I did not hear this hadith from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) directly but it was Zaid b. Thabit who narrated it from him. As Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was going along with us towards the dwellings of Bani an-Najjar, riding upon his pony, it shied and he was about to fall. He found four, five or six graves there. He said: Who amongst you knows about those lying in the graves? A person said: It is I. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: In what state did they die? He said: They died as polytheists. He said: These people are passing through the ordeal in the graves. If it were not the reason that you would stop burying (your dead) in the graves on listening to the torment in the grave which I am listening to, I would have certainly made you hear that. Then turning his face towards us, he said: Seek refuge with Allah from the torment of Hell. They said: We seek refuge with Allah from the torment of Hell. He said: Seek refuge with Allah from the torment of the grave. They said: We seek refuge with Allah from the torment of the grave. He said: Seek refuge with Allah from turmoil, its visible and invisible (aspects), and they said: We seek refuge with Allah from turmoil and its visible and invisible aspects and he said: Seek refuge with Allah from the turmoil of the Dajjal, and they said We seek refuge with Allah from the turmoil of the Dajjal. [Sahih Muslim: 2867]

data.title: Dua for Protection from Whisperings
data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
data.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
data.translation:
I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

Allah says: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

data.title: Prophet's Advice to Control Anger (Hadith)
data.introduction: Narrated by Sulaiman bin Surad: A man from the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Two men abused each other in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) and one of them became angry and his anger became so intense that his face became swollen and changed. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I know a word the saying of which will cause him to relax if he does say it." Then a man went to him and informed him of the statement of the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Seek refuge with Allah from Satan." On that, angry man said, 'Do you find anything wrong with me? Am I insane? Go away!"

data.title: Hadith on Anger Control (Sahih Bukhari)
data.introduction: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger."

data.title: Masnoon dua (Astaghfirullah)
data.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
data.transliteration: astaghfir-ullaah
data.translation: I seek Allah’s forgiveness.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying." By Allah! I ask for forgiveness from Allah and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day." [Bukhari: 6307]

data.title: Masnoon Dua for forgiveness (Rbbighfirli Wa tub Alayya)
data.introduction: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar (RA): We counted that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would say this dua a hundred times during a meeting -
data.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ (الْغَفُوْرُ)
data.transliteration: Rabbighfirli Watub Alayya Innaka Antat-Tawwabul- rahim [in another narration there is al-Ghaffur instead of al-Rahim]
data.translation: Lord, forgive me and repent for me, for you are The Most Merciful The Acceptor of Repentance. In another narration there is "The Forgiver" instead of "The Acceptor of Repentance"

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ إِنْ كُنَّا لَنَعُدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الْوَاحِدِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ ‏ "‏ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَىَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: We counted that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would say a hundred times during a meeting: "My Lord, forgive me and pardon me; Thou art the Pardoning and forgiving One". [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1516]

data.title: Dua for forgiveness (Astaghfirullah al Azeem)
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) added: The person who says:
data.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِيْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
data.transliteration: Astaghfirulla-hal adhemal-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huwal hayyul qayyoomu wa atoobu ilayhi
data.translation:
I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, Whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Living, the Eternal, and I repent to Him.

Allah would forgive him even if he was one who fled during the advance of an army." [1] He (ﷺ) said: "The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night, so if you are able to be of those who remember Allah at that time, then be so." [2] He (ﷺ) also said: "The nearest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much therein." [3] He (ﷺ) also said: "Verily my heart becomes preoccupied, and verily I seek Allah"s forgiveness a hundred times a day." [4]
data.reference: [1] Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1517 [2] Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3579 [3] Muslim: 482 [4] Muslim: 2702

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الشَّنِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ بِلاَلَ بْنَ يَسَارِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُنِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّي أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَالَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَىُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ غُفِرَ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Zayd, the client of the Prophet: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone says: "I ask pardon of Allah than Whom there is no deity, the Living, the eternal, and I turn to Him in repentance," he will be pardoned, even if he has fled in time of battle. [[1] Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1517 [2] Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3579 [3] Muslim: 482 [4] Muslim: 2702]

data.title: Dua of forgiveness (La Ilaha Illallahul Halimul Karim)
data.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
data.transliteration: Laa ilaha illallaahul halimul karim, laa ilaaha illallaahul ‘aliyyul ‘azim, subhaanallaahi rabbis samawaatis sab’i wa rabbil ‘arshil ‘azim, alhamdu lillaahi rabbil ‘aalamin

There is no true God but Allah the Most Patient, the Most Honorable. There is no true God but Allah the Most Exalted, the Most High. I am proclaiming the holiness of the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the glorious throne. All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

‘Narrated from Ali bin Abi Talib (RA), will I not teach you some sentences which if you say you will be forgiven even though you are forgiven (He then told the above sentences)

data.title: Sayyidul Istighfar Dua for Forgiveness
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِيْ وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِيْ فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma anta rabbee laa ilaaha illaa anta, khalaqtanee wa-ana ‘abduka, wa-ana ‘alaa ‘ahdika wawa‘dika mas-tata‘tu, a‘oothu bika min sharri maa sana‘tu, aboo-o laka bini‘matika ‘alayya, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu laa yaghfirudh dhunooba illaa anta
data.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْعَدَوِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي شَدَّادُ بْنُ أَوْسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَيِّدُ الاِسْتِغْفَارِ أَنْ تَقُولَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ النَّهَارِ مُوقِنًا بِهَا، فَمَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُمْسِيَ، فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَهْوَ مُوقِنٌ بِهَا، فَمَاتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصْبِحَ، فَهْوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Shaddad bin Aus: The Prophet (ﷺ) said "The most superior way of asking for forgiveness from Allah is: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship except You. You have created me, and I am Your servant, and I am faithful to Your covenant and promise as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me, and I admit my sins. So forgive me, for none forgives sins except You. (Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, Khalaqtani wa ana `Abduka, wa ana `ala `ahdika wa wa`dika mastata`tu, A`udhu bika min Sharri ma sana`tu, abu'u Laka bini`matika `alaiya, wa abu'u laka bidhanbi faghfir lee fa innahu la yaghfiru adhdhunuba illa anta) " The Prophet (ﷺ) added. "If somebody recites it during the day with firm faith in it, and dies on the same day before the evening, he will be from the people of Paradise; and if somebody recites it at night with firm faith in it, and dies before the morning, he will be from the people of Paradise." [Bukhari: 6306]

benefits.description: This ayah guides every believer to make a true tawbah, helping muslims clean their hearts and find Allah’s mercy by turning back with real regret and hope for forgiveness.
points: Dua of repentance in surah at tahrim brings Allah’s forgiveness close to the heart.
Sincere repentance prayer from this verse helps muslims fix their Amal and Iman.
Salat al tawbah and this dua tawbah open the way for Barakah in daily life.
Dua to repent in surah al tahrim teaches how to seek forgiveness with honesty.
Forgiveness dua from this ayah makes hearts soft and brings peace in muslim prayer.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Of Repentance
when_to_recite.description: This dua of repentance from Surah At-Tahrim calls every believer to turn to Allah with a clean heart, asking for forgiveness, Barakah, and a new start in Iman and Amal every day.
points: After doing something wrong, use the dua of repentance to seek Allah’s mercy.
When guilt fills your heart, turn to this surah at tahrim verse for true forgiveness.
Before starting salat al tawbah, recite the dua of repentance for a pure heart.
At the end of your daily zikr allah, make this dua of repentance for Barakah.
During quiet moments alone, remember this dua tawbah for strong Iman and istighfar.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua of repentance (Surah At-Tahrim)
how_to_perform.description: This dua of repentance from Surah At-Tahrim teaches every Muslim to turn to Allah with a true heart. It is a simple forgiveness dua that brings Barakah and helps you stay close to Allah’s mercy every day.
steps: After any sin, stop and recite this dua of repentance from surah at tahrim with full hope.
When you pray salat al tawbah, add this repentance prayer to ask for Allah’s forgiveness.
In your daily zikr allah, use this dua tawbah to keep your heart clean and Iman strong.
Gather your family and together say this dua for forgiveness to build unity in your home.
Before starting your namaz dua, remember this dua in islam and ask Allah to accept your tawbah.

data.title: Dua of forgiveness (Surah Ali Imran)
data.introduction: Allah says:
data.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فٰحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوٓا أَنفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا لِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَن يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا عَلٰى مَا فَعَلُوا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
data.transliteration: Wallazeena izaa fa'aloo faahishatan aw zalamooo anfusahum zakarullaaha fastaghfaroo lizunoobihim wa man yaghfiruz-zunooba illallaahu wa lam yusirroo 'alaa maa fa'aloo wa hum ya'lamoon.
data.translation: And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except Allah? - and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua of Forgiveness (Surah Ali Imran)
benefits.description: This ayah teaches muslims to remember Allah after mistakes, showing how seeking forgiveness with a true heart brings hope and stops a person from repeating sins again and again.
points: Dua of forgiveness in surah al imran helps muslims fix their Amal after mistakes.
Remembrance of Allah in this verse brings Barakah and peace in muslim prayer.
Astaghfirullah from this ayah makes hearts soft and brings Allah’s mercy close.
Repentance dua in surat al imran teaches not to keep doing wrong knowingly.
Prayer for forgiveness of sins in this ayah shows only Allah forgives all mistakes.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Of Forgiveness
when_to_recite.description: This dua of forgiveness from Surah Ali Imran teaches Muslims to turn to Allah after mistakes, ask for Barakah, and keep Iman strong by remembering Allah and seeking His mercy every day.
points: After doing a wrong action, use the dua of forgiveness to ask Allah for mercy.
When you feel regret in your heart, remember Allah and make istighfar with this dua.
Before sleeping at night, recite the dua of forgiveness for clean Amal and Barakah.
After salah, turn to this surah al imran verse for forgiveness and strong Iman.
In moments of weakness, use this prayer for forgiveness of sins to fix your heart.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua of forgiveness
how_to_perform.description: This dua of forgiveness from Surah Ali Imran teaches us to turn to Allah after any mistake or sin and ask for His mercy. It is a strong prayer for forgiveness of sins that every Muslim can use to clean their heart and bring Barakah in life.
steps: Start by remembering Allah with zikr allah and say astaghfirullah with a soft heart.
After any wrong action, use this dua for forgiveness and ask Allah to forgive your sins.
When you feel regret, recite this repentance dua from surah al imran and make a promise not to repeat.
Before going to bed, read this islamic prayer for forgiveness to clear your heart from bad deeds.
In your namaz, add this dua in sujood as a masnoon dua to get Allah’s mercy and keep your Iman strong.

data.title: Prophet Muhammad’s (ﷺ) Daily Istighfar (Hadith)
data.introduction: Narrated Abu Huraira: He said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say, 'By Allah! I pray and repent to Allah more than seventy times a day.

data.title: Repent to Allah (Sunnah of 100 Times Daily)
data.introduction: Narrated Abu Burda: I heard Agar, the Companion of the Prophet (ﷺ), narrating a hadeeth quoting Ibn 'Umar. He said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, “People! Repent to Allah (turn to Him); I repent to him a hundred times a day.

data.title: Dua for Forgiveness (Hadith)
data.introduction: Narrated Agar Muzani (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Sometimes my heart goes astray, and I ask Allah for forgiveness a hundred times a day.

data.title: Khutbah for Nikah (Khutbah al-Hajah)
data.introduction: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) narrated: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught us the Tashah-hud for Salat and the Tashah-hud for Al-Hajjah." He said: "The Tashah-hud for Salat is:
data.arabic: إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ نَحْمَدُهُ وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ وَنَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ أَعْمَالِنَا، مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللَّهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُّسْلِمُونَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَاءً ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَالْأَرْحَامَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًۭا سَدِيدًا يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا
data.transliteration: Innal-hamda lillaah nahmaduhu wa nasta‛eenuhu wa nastaghfiruhu, wa na‛oodhu billaahi min shuroori anfusinaa wa min sayyi’aati a‛maalinaa, man yahdih-illaahu fa laa mudilla lah, wa man yudlil fa laa haadiya lah, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha ill-Allaahu, wa ash-hadu anna muhammadan ‛abduhu wa rasooluh Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanut-taqullaaha ‘haqqa tuqaatihi walaa tamootunna illaa wa antum muslimoon yaa ayyuhan-naasut-taqoo rabbakum-ul-ladhee khalaqakum min nafsin wa’hidatin, wa khalaqa minhaa zawjahaa, wa bath-tha minhumaa rijaalan katheeran wanisaa’-an, wat-taqullaahal-ladhee tasaa’aloona bihi wal ar’haam, inn-Allaaha kaana ‛alaykum raqeebaa Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanut-taqullaaha wa qooloo qawlan sadeeda, yusli’h lakum a‛maalakum wa yaghfir lakum dhunoobakum, wa man yuti‛illaaha wa rasoolahu faqad faaza fawz-an ‛azeemaa
data.translation:
Indeed all Praise is for Allah, we praise Him, we seek His help and we ask His forgiveness. We seek refuge with Allah from the evil of our own souls and from the evil of our actions. Whoever Allah guides will never be led astray,and whomever Allah leads astray, no one can guide. I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. (then reads the following verses) O you who believe! Fear Allah as He should be feared, and die not except as Muslims; [1] O Mankind! Fear your Lord, Who created you from a single person, and from him created his wife, and from them he created many men and women, and fear Allah through Whom you demand your mutual (rights). Surely, Allah is Ever Watchful over you; [2] O you who believe! Fear Allah, and speak (always) the truth He will direct you to do righteous good deeds and will forgive you your sins. And whosoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has indeed achieved a great success. [3]

Then he would talk about his needs. [4]
data.reference: [1] Surah Al Imran : 3:102 [2] Sura An-nisa : 4:1 [3] Suah Al-Ahjab: 33:70-71 Sohih(albani) Timiji : 1105

benefits.title: Benefits of Khutbah for Nikah (Khutbah al-Hajah)

points: Khutbah for nikah gives Barakah and peace to the marriage and new couple.
Innal hamda lillah nahmaduhu in this dua for nikah brings Allah’s help and mercy.
Sunnah of nikah is followed by reading this khutbah in every islamic marriage.
Dua for newly married couple in this khutbah asks Allah to fix their Amal and Iman.
Marriage and prayer together in this khutbah teach muslims about taqwa and unity.

when_to_recite.description: The khutbah for nikah is a blessed start for marriage in Islam, bringing Barakah, guidance, and strong Iman for the couple and all who join the Islamic marriage ceremony.
