data.title: Dua After Prayer for Forgiveness
data.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
data.transliteration: Subhaanaka Allaahumma wa bihamdika, 'ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta, 'astaghfiruka wa 'atoobu 'ilayka
data.translation:
Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise is to You. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.

Aishah (RA) said: 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not sit in a gathering, and did not recite the Qur'an, and did not perform any prayer without concluding by saying: (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ الْجَرْجَرَائِيُّ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - الْمَعْنَى - أَنَّ عَبْدَةَ بْنَ سُلَيْمَانَ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ عَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ بِأَخَرَةٍ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَقُومَ مِنَ الْمَجْلِسِ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَتَقُولُ قَوْلاً مَا كُنْتَ تَقُولُهُ فِيمَا مَضَى ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ كَفَّارَةٌ لِمَا يَكُونُ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated AbuBarzah al-Aslami: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) intended to get up from the assembly he used to say in the last. Glory be to Thee. O Allah, and I begin with praise of Thee, I testify that there is no god but Thou; I ask Thy pardon, and return to Thee in repentance. The man asked: Messenger of Allah! you utter the words now which you did not do in the past? He replied: (This is an) atonement for what takes place in the assembly. Sunan Abi Dawud 4859 [Hasan Sahih (Albani). Abu Daud:4859]

data.title: Saying Alhamdulillah in Every Situation
data.introduction: When He (ﷺ) used to receive pleasant news, He (ﷺ) would say:
data.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
data.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmus-saalihaat
data.translation: Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الأَزْرَقُ أَبُو مَرْوَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ إِذَا رَأَى مَا يُحِبُّ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَأَى مَا يَكْرَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated that 'Aishah said: "When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw something he liked, he would say: 'Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi bi ni'matihi tatimmus-salihat (Praise is to Allah by Whose grace good deeds are completed).' And if he saw something that he disliked, he would say: 'Al-hamdu lillahi 'ala kulli hal (Praise is to Allah in all circumstances).'" [Hasan (Albani). Ibn Majah: 3803]

data.translation: Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الأَزْرَقُ أَبُو مَرْوَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ إِذَا رَأَى مَا يُحِبُّ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَأَى مَا يَكْرَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: It was narrated that 'Aishah said: "When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw something he liked, he would say: 'Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi bi ni'matihi tatimmus-salihat (Praise is to Allah by Whose grace good deeds are completed).' And if he saw something that he disliked, he would say: 'Al-hamdu lillahi 'ala kulli hal (Praise is to Allah in all circumstances).'" [Hasan (Albani). Ibn Majah: 3803]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Oppressed from Surah An-Nisa
benefits.description: This dua from Surah An-Nisa gives hope and strength to those facing hardship, asking Allah for a protector and helper when people feel weak or hurt by others’ wrong actions.
points: Allah listens to the dua for oppressed and sends help to those who call with Iman.
The dua for the oppressed brings Allah’s mercy and makes hearts strong in tough times.
Surah al Nisa’s dua for help from Allah gives safety from dushman and their zulm.
The dua of the oppressed is never wasted and Allah gives Barakah in Amal and life.
Verses on protection like this muslim prayer keep a believer safe from harm and fear.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Alhamdulillah Ala Kulli Hal
when_to_recite.description: Alhamdulillah ala kulli hal is a strong way to thank Allah in every up and down, bringing Barakah, patience, and Iman when you face hardship, sadness, or any test in your daily life.
points: After hearing bad news, say alhamdulillah ala kulli hal to show patience and trust.
When you feel sad or worried, use this dua for hardship to ask Allah for sabr.
At times of problems or musibat, make alhamdulillah for everything your zikr for Barakah.
If you lose something or face a test, thank Allah with alhamdulillah ala kulli haal.
When life changes fast, remember this dua for patience to keep your Iman strong.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Alhamdulillah Ala Kulli Hal
how_to_perform.description: Saying alhamdulillah ala kulli hal brings peace to the heart and helps you remember Allah in every moment, whether you feel happy or sad. This simple dua teaches us to thank Allah always, no matter what happens in life.
steps: After hearing bad news or facing hardship, say alhamdulillah ala kulli hal to show patience.
When you feel sad or worried, use this dua for sadness and remember Allah’s mercy.
If you get something you did not want, recite alhamdulillah for everything to accept Allah’s plan.
During tough times, repeat this dua for hardship and ask for sabr and help from Allah.
At the end of your namaz, softly say alhamdulillah ala kulli haal to thank Allah for all situations.

data.title: Islamic Etiquette Dua of Praising Others
data.introduction: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If you ever have to praise someone, say:
data.arabic: أَحْسِبُ فُلَانًا وَاللَّهُ حَسِيْبُهُ وَلَا أُزَكِّيْ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَدًا أَحْسِبُهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا
data.transliteration: A’hsibu fulanan wallahu ‘hasiibuhu wa laa ‘uzakkii ‘alAllahi a’hadan a’hsibuhu kaza wa kaza
data.translation:
I think that he is so and so, and Allah knows exactly the truth, and I do not confirm anybody's good conduct before Allah, but I think him so and so.

It is a crime to slander a person from behind and praise him from the front. In the case of praise, one's special nature or quality can be praised. It is forbidden in the Hadith to praise someone or to say that someone is good. In the case of praise, I have to say: I think such a person is good; Confirmation cannot be expressed.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَامٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ أَثْنَى رَجُلٌ عَلَى رَجُلٍ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ وَيْلَكَ قَطَعْتَ عُنُقَ صَاحِبِكَ قَطَعْتَ عُنُقَ صَاحِبِكَ مِرَارًا ثُمَّ قَالَ مَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ مَادِحًا أَخَاهُ لَا مَحَالَةَ فَلْيَقُلْ أَحْسِبُ فُلَانًا وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ وَلَا أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَدًا أَحْسِبُهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Bakra: A man praised another man in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) . The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Woe to you, you have cut off your companion's neck, you have cut off your companion's neck," repeating it several times and then added, "Whoever amongst you has to praise his brother should say, 'I think that he is so and so, and Allah knows exactly the truth, and I do not confirm anybody's good conduct before Allah, but I think him so and so,' if he really knows what he says about him." [Bukhari: 2662]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Guidance in Difficult Times
benefits.description: This dua from Surah Al-Araf teaches Muslims to trust Allah’s plan, asking Him to guide and judge with truth when life feels hard or confusing and hearts need clear answers.
points: Allah gives clear guidance to the one who makes this dua for guidance with tawakkul.
The dua for difficult times brings peace and helps a muslim trust in Allah’s plan.
Surah Araf’s rabbana dua helps solve problems and removes stress from the heart.

Verses on guidance like this make Amal strong and keep Iman safe in every test.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Islamic Etiquette Dua of Praising Others
when_to_recite.description: This dua teaches you to praise with care, giving all praises to Allah and remembering only Allah knows best, so your words bring Barakah and keep your Iman safe from pride or showing off.
points: When you want to praise someone, use this dua so all praises to Allah stay in your heart.
After seeing a good deed, say masha allah tabarakallah and remember Allah knows best.
If you talk about someone’s good Amal, make this dua to keep your words humble.
When others praise someone in front of you, use this dua for allahumma barik and Barakah.
Before sharing someone’s good, remember to say all praises to Allah and trust His knowledge.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Islamic Etiquette Dua of Praising Others
how_to_perform.description: This dua teaches us to praise someone in a way that keeps our Iman safe and gives all praises to Allah, knowing only Allah knows the real truth about every person’s heart and actions.
steps: When you want to praise someone, start by saying all praises to Allah before any words.
If you mention someone’s good deed, add masha allah tabarakallah to show respect and avoid pride.
While talking about a person’s good side, say allah knows best and use this dua to keep your words true.
After sharing praise, quietly say allahumma barik to ask for Barakah in that person’s life.
If you feel unsure, remember to use this dua so you do not say more than what is right in islamic prayers.

data.title: Dua When Praised by Others (Masnun Dua)
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِيْ بِمَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ (وَاجْعَلْنِيْ خَيْرًا مِمَّا يَظُنُّوْنَ)
data.transliteration: Allaahumma laa tu'aakhidhnee bimaa yaqooloona, waghfir lee maa laa ya'lamoona [waj'alnee khayram-mimmaa yadhunnoon]
data.translation:
Oh Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine].

It was the custom of the Companions that they would feel discomfort if anyone called them righteous or praised them. If someone praise them, they would say- (The dua is mentioned above)
data.reference: Sahih. Adabul Mufrad: 761, Bracketed part (Shu'abul Iman 4/288)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: "حَدَّثَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ‏:‏ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ‏:‏ أَخْبَرَنَا مُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ الْمُزَنِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ أَرْطَأَةَ قَالَ‏:‏ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا زُكِّيَ قَالَ‏:‏ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لا يَعْلَمُونَ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: Adi ibn Arta' said, ""When one of the Companions of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, was praised, he said in supplication to Allah), 'Do not take me to task for what they say and forgive me for what they do not know.'"" [Sahih (Albani). Adabul Mufrad: 761]

benefits.title: Benefits of the Dua of the Oppressed from Surah Yunus
benefits.description: This dua from Surah Yunus helps Muslims trust Allah and ask for safety from wrongdoers, seeking His mercy to stay safe from fitna and harm by zalimin and those who do wrong.
points: Allah answers the dua of the oppressed and gives safety from zalimin and fitna.
Surah Yunus dua for protection keeps a muslim safe from enemies and their evil plans.
Tawakkul in this dua brings the mercy of Allah and helps hearts stay strong in trials.
The dua for oppressed is a shield for muslims in places like Palestine and Gaza.
Verses on protection like this make Amal and Iman strong in every test from Allah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Masnun Dua When Praised by Others
when_to_recite.description: This masnun dua helps you stay humble and ask Allah for forgiveness, Barakah, and mercy when people praise you, so your Iman grows and your heart stays clean from pride.
points: After someone praises you, use this masnun dua to ask Allah for forgiveness and mercy.
When you feel shy from praise, make this dua for forgiveness to keep your heart soft.
If people talk good about you, say this islamic prayer so Allahumma forgives your hidden faults.
When you get praised in front of others, recite this short dua for Barakah and blessings of Allah.
Before leaving a gathering where you got praise, use this supplication to ask for better Amal.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Masnun Dua When Praised by Others
how_to_perform.description: This masnun dua helps a Muslim stay humble and ask for Allah’s mercy when people praise them, reminding us that only Allah knows our real heart and actions, not just what others see or say.
steps: After someone praises you, quietly recite this masnun dua to seek Allah’s forgiveness.
When you feel shy or worried from praise, use this dua for forgiveness and ask for Allah’s mercy.
If people talk good about you, say allahumma and ask Allah to make you better than what they think.
While making supplication, include this short dua from hadith to keep your heart clean from pride.
At the end of your islamic prayer, remember this masnun dua to thank Allah for His blessings and kindness.

data.title: Muslim Greetings (Assalamualaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh)
data.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
data.transliteration: As-salaamu 'alaykum wara'hmatullaahi wa barakaatuh
data.translation:
Peace be upon you, and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings.

By the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Muhammad, you will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not tell you of something that will help you to achieve that? Spread (the greeting of) salaam amongst yourselves.` [1] The person who can combine three things, can combines faith- 1. Justice for oneself, 2. Give salaam to everyone in the world, and 3. Give charity despite having few wealth [2] Once a man asked prophet (ﷺ) which deed is best in islam ? prophet (ﷺ) replied that, “To feed people and give salaam to the persons who are known or unknown to you. [3]
data.reference: [1] Musnad Ahmad 1430 [2] Sahih Bukhari (Fathul Bari) 1/82 [3] Sahih Bukhari (Fathul Bari) 1/55

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، أَنَّ يَعِيشَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ مَوْلًى لِآلِ الزُّبَيْرِ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ الزُّبَيْرَ بْنَ الْعَوَّامِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ دَبَّ إِلَيْكُمْ دَاءُ الْأُمَمِ قَبْلَكُمْ الْحَسَدُ وَالْبَغْضَاءُ وَالْبَغْضَاءُ هِيَ الْحَالِقَةُ لَا أَقُولُ تَحْلِقُ الشَّعْرَ وَلَكِنْ تَحْلِقُ الدِّينَ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ أَوْ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَا تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا أَفَلَا أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا يُثَبِّتُ ذَلِكَ لَكُمْ أَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ بَيْنَكُمْ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ يَعِيشَ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ أَنَّ مَوْلًى لِآلِ الزُّبَيْرِ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ الزُّبَيْرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ دَبَّ إِلَيْكُمْ فَذَكَرَهُ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا رَبَاحٌ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ يَعِيشَ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مَوْلًى لِآلِ الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّ الزُّبَيْرَ بْنَ الْعَوَّامِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ دَبَّ إِلَيْكُمْ فَذَكَرَهُ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Ya`eesh bin al-Waleed narrated that a freed slave of the family of az-Zubair told him that azZubair bin al-`Awwam (رضي الله عنه) narrated to him that The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “There has come to you the disease of the nations before you, jealousy and hatred. Hatred is the `shaver` (destroyer). I do not say that it shaves hair; rather its shaves (destroys) religious commitment. By the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Muhammad, you will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not tell you of something that will help you to achieve that? Spread (the greeting of) salaam amongst yourselves.` It was narrated from Ya`eesh bin al-Waleed that a freed slave of the family of az-Zubair told him that az-Zubair (رضي الله عنه) told him: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “There has come to you.” and he narrated it. It was narrated from a freed slave of the family of az-Zubair (رضي الله عنه) that az-Zubair bin al-`Awwam (رضي الله عنه) told him that The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “There has come to you...` and he narrated it, Musnad Ahmad 1430, 1431, 1432 [[1] Musnad Ahmad 1430 [2] Sahih Bukhari (With Fathul Baari) 1/82 [3] Sahih Bukhari (With Fathul Baari) 1/55]

benefits.title: Benefits of Protection Dua from Surah Ankabut
benefits.description: This short dua from Surah Ankabut asks Allah for help and support against people who spread fasad, keeping a believer safe and strong when facing harm from corrupt people.
points: Allah gives strong help to the one who makes this protection dua with full yaqeen.
Surah Ankabut’s dua for help keeps a muslim safe from the harm of mufsid people.
This protection dua brings Allah’s support and makes Amal easy in hard times.
Verses on protection like this keep Iman safe and hearts away from evil and fasad.
The dua for success and safety helps muslims win against dushman and their plans.

When joining a gathering, begin with this Islamic dua to bring mercy and unity.
If you see a fellow Muslim on the road, offer muslim greetings for blessings.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Muslim Greetings (Assalamualaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh)
how_to_perform.description: Giving muslim greetings is a sunnah that brings peace, Barakah, and love among Muslims. This greeting is not just words but a dua for mercy, blessings, and rizq for the one you meet.
steps: When you meet a Muslim, greet them first with assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh.
If you enter your home or any gathering, say this greetings in islamic way to spread peace.
While walking on the road, use this muslim greetings for every Muslim you pass by.
When sending a message or letter, start with this dua for rizq and wealth for the reader.
After finishing your namaz, greet those around you with assalamualaikum to share Barakah.

data.title: Reply to Non-Muslim Greetings
data.introduction: When the people of the Book greet you, reply by saying:
data.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمْ
data.transliteration: Wa 'alaykum
data.translation: And upon you

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا وَعَلَيْكُمْ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik: the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If the people of the Scripture greet you, then you should say (in reply), 'Wa'alaikum (And on you).' " [Bukhari: 6258]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Protection from Wrongdoers
benefits.description: This dua from Surah Araf asks Allah to keep us away from zalimin, giving safety and hidayah so a muslim can stay on the right path and not fall with people who do wrong.
points: Allah keeps the one safe who makes this dua for protection from zalimin.
Surah al Araf’s rabbana dua helps muslims get hidayah and stay away from evil.
This islamic prayer for protection brings taqwa and keeps Amal clean from wrong.
Verses on protection like this make Iman strong and give istiqamah in hard times.
The dua for protection helps hearts stay pure and away from the path of wrongdoers.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Walaikum

points: When a non-Muslim greets you, answer with walaikum as taught in bukhari hadith.
If someone says peace upon you but is not Muslim, reply with walaikum for adab.
During work or school, use walaikum when non-Muslim friends greet you kindly.
While walking on road, if a non-Muslim greets, respond with walaikum for respect.
In any gathering, keep manners by saying walaikum as a reply to non-Muslim greetings.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Walaikum (Reply to Non-Muslim Greetings)
how_to_perform.description: Replying with walaikum is a simple sunnah that keeps respect and follows the teaching of the Prophet. This short reply is easy to say and is found in sahih al bukhari as the right way for Muslims.
steps: When a non-Muslim greets you, answer with walaikum to keep the reply correct.
If you hear salam from someone not Muslim, use upon you as your answer without adding more.
While in a group, if a non-Muslim says salam, reply with walaikum for everyone to hear.
After any greeting from a non-Muslim, remember this bukhari hadith and use walaikum only.
When teaching kids about islamic prayers, show them how to reply with walaikum in a kind way.

data.title: Dua for Anger (Masnun Dua)
data.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
data.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
data.translation:
I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

Sulaiman ibn Surad (RA) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Saying these words will remove the anger of the angry person. We have seen that suppressing anger and forgiving those who are angry is one of the ways to gain Allah's mercy. Therefore, when a believer feels anger, he should say this sentence again and again, looking at the meaning.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ صُرَدٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَجُلاَنِ يَسْتَبَّانِ، فَأَحَدُهُمَا احْمَرَّ وَجْهُهُ وَانْتَفَخَتْ أَوْدَاجُهُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ كَلِمَةً لَوْ قَالَهَا ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ مَا يَجِدُ، لَوْ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ‏.‏ ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ مَا يَجِدُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لَهُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَهَلْ بِي جُنُونٌ
hadith.translation: Narrated Sulaiman bin Surd: While I was sitting in the company of the Prophet, two men abused each other and the face of one of them became red with anger, and his jugular veins swelled (i.e. he became furious). On that the Prophet said, "I know a word, the saying of which will cause him to relax, if he does say it. If he says: 'I seek Refuge with Allah from Satan.' then all is anger will go away." Some body said to him, "The Prophet has said, 'Seek refuge with Allah from Satan."' The angry man said, "Am I mad?" [Bukhari: 3282]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Safety from Wrongdoers
benefits.description: This dua from Surah Al-Qasas is a strong shield for Muslims, asking Allah to protect from harm and keep us safe from those who do wrong, just like Musa did when he faced danger.
points: Allah gives safety to the heart of a muslim who makes this dua for safety.
Surah al qasas dua helps protect from enemies and those who wish to harm.
Dua for protection from enemies brings Allah’s help in times of fear and worry.
Doa nabi musa keeps a believer safe from both evil and good that can harm.
Hifazat ki dua from surah qasas is a strong way to ask for Allah’s mercy and care.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Anger
when_to_recite.description: This dua for anger, Auzubillah Minashaitan Nirajeem, helps control anger and brings calm, as taught in hadith on anger, giving protection from shaitan and Barakah in your Amal.
points: When feeling upset, recite dua for anger to seek Allah’s help for calm.
If someone makes you angry, use Auzubillah Minashaitan Nirajeem for control.
Before reacting in a fight, say this masnun dua for protection from shaitan.
After a heated talk, make dua for anger control to cool your heart and mind.
While teaching kids how to control anger in islam, show them this short dua.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Anger (Masnun Dua)
how_to_perform.description: When anger rises in your heart, this short dua for anger helps you remember Allah and keep your mind calm. It is a simple masnun dua that every Muslim can use to control anger and protect from Shaytan.
steps: Start by pausing your words and quietly say Auzubillah Minashaitan Nirajeem with full Iman.
If you feel your anger growing, move away from the place and recite this dua for anger.
When you sit for namaz, remember to use this masnun dua for protection from shaitan.
After any argument, softly repeat this dua for anger control to cool your heart.
Before going to bed, say this short dua for protection from evil and ask for Barakah.

data.title: Forgiveness Dua for Insulting Others
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma fa'ayyumaa mu'minin sababtuhu faj'al thaalika lahu qurbatan 'ilayka yawmal-qiyaamah
data.translation: O Allah, whomever of the believers I have abused, give him the reward of a sacrificial slaughter for it on the Day of Resurrection.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏" ‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "O Allah! If I should ever abuse a believer, please let that be a means of bringing him near to You on the Day of Resurrection." [Bukhari: 6361]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Protection from Temptation
benefits.description: This dua from Surah Yusuf teaches Muslims to ask Allah for help against bad choices and to keep hearts clean, just like Nabi Yusuf did when he faced hard tests and strong temptations.
points: Allah keeps a muslim safe from fitnah when this dua for protection is made.
Surah yusuf dua helps turn away from wrong and keeps Iman strong in the heart.
Doa nabi yusuf gives power to fight evil plans and stay away from bad acts.
Protection dua from surat yusuf brings Allah’s mercy when facing hard tests.
Sura yusuf verses on protection help muslims stay away from jahalat and sin.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Forgiveness Dua
when_to_recite.description: This forgiveness dua is a prophetic dua for those times when you hurt someone by words, asking Allah for Barakah and mercy on the Day of Resurrection, as taught in hadith on forgiveness.
points: After realizing you insulted someone, use forgiveness dua for repentance and Barakah.
When making dua after salah, ask Allah with this forgiveness dua for any harsh words.
Before sleeping, remember this masnun dua if you wronged a believer in your day.
On the Day of Jumuah, include this dua for forgiveness in your zikr allah and prayers.
If you feel regret for past words, recite this forgiveness dua for peace in your heart.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Forgiveness Dua for Insulting Others
how_to_perform.description: When you feel regret for hurting someone with words, this forgiveness dua helps you ask Allah for mercy and hope for Barakah on the Day of Resurrection. It is a prophetic dua every Muslim should know for true repentance.
steps: Begin by feeling sorry in your heart and recite this forgiveness dua with full hope in Allah.
After hurting someone, quietly say this masnun dua for forgiveness and ask for their good.
When you finish your salah, remember to make this dua for repentance and seek Allah’s mercy.
If you recall your mistake during zikr allah, use this dua for forgiveness to clean your Amal.
Before going to bed, repeat this prophetic dua and pray for reward for the one you insulted.

data.title: Powerful Zikr of La ilaha illallah
data.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
data.transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wAllahu 'Akbar, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata 'illaa billaah
data.translation:
There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Allah is the Most Great. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, His is the dominion and His is the praise. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, there is no power and no might but by Allah.

Abu Saeed Khudri (RA) and Abu Hurairah (RA) said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said that when a servant says these words, Allah responds to him and if someone says these words while he is ill and then dies, the fire will not touch him.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ وَكِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُحَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَغَرِّ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ أَشْهَدُ عَلَى أَبِي سَعِيدٍ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّهُمَا شَهِدَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ‏.‏ صَدَّقَهُ رَبُّهُ فَقَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنَا وَأَنَا أَكْبَرُ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنَا وَأَنَا وَحْدِي ‏.‏ وَإِذَا قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنَا وَحْدِي لاَ شَرِيكَ لِي ‏.‏ وَإِذَا قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنَا لِيَ الْمُلْكُ وَلِيَ الْحَمْدُ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنَا وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِي ‏.‏ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ مَنْ قَالَهَا فِي مَرَضِهِ ثُمَّ مَاتَ لَمْ تَطْعَمْهُ النَّارُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ رَوَاهُ شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَغَرِّ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَأَبِي، سَعِيدٍ بِنَحْوِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ بِمَعْنَاهُ وَلَمَ يَرْفَعْهُ شُعْبَةُ ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا بِذَلِكَ، بُنْدَارٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Al-Agharr Abu Muslim narrated that he bears witness from Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri and Abu Hurairah, that they bear witness that : the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Whoever says: ‘There is none worthy of worship except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest, (Lā ilāha illallāh, wa Allāhu akbar)’ His Lord affirms his statement and says: ‘There is none worthy of worship except Me, and I am the Greatest,’ and when he say: ‘There is none worthy of worship except for Allah, Alone, (Lā ilāha illallāh, waḥdahu)’ Allah says: ‘There is none worthy of worship except for Me and I am Alone.’ And when he say: ‘There is none worthy of worship except for Allah, Alone, without partner, (Lā ilāha illallāh, waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu)’ Allah says: ‘There is none worthy of worship except Me, Alone, I have no partner.’ And when he say: ‘There is none worthy of worship except for Allah, to Him belongs all that exists, and to Him is the praise, (Lā ilāha illallāh, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu)’ Allah says: ‘There is none worthy of worship except Me, to Me belongs all that exists, and to Me is the praise.’ And when he says: ‘There is none worthy of worship except Allah, and there is no might or power except by Allah, (Lā ilāha illallāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh)’ Allah says: ‘There is none worthy of worship except Me, and there is no might or power except by Me.’” And he used to say: “Whoever says it in his illness, then dies, the Fire shall not consume him.” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3430]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Pain and Hardship Relief
benefits.description: This dua from Surah Al-Anbya is a gentle call to Allah for help in pain and hardship, showing trust in His mercy just like Ayub did when he was sick and needed healing.
points: Allah’s mercy comes close to the one who makes this dua for pain relief.
Surah al anbiya dua helps muslims find shifa and ease in times of sickness.
Dard ki dua brings hope and patience when facing musibat or any hardship.
Dua for hardship from anbiya surah gives strength to trust Ar Rahman Ar Rahim.
Ayat shifa from surah al ambiya is a way to ask Allah for healing and comfort.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Zikr Allah
when_to_recite.description: Zikr Allah with la ilaha illallah fills your heart with Iman, Barakah, and peace, making every day better with the best zikr and remembrance of Allah, as taught in masnun duas.
points: After finishing namaz, do zikr of Allah with la ilaha illallah for Barakah.
In the morning, start your daily zikr with this best dhikr of Allah for a blessed day.
When feeling weak, repeat la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah for strength and help.
Before going to bed, remember Allah with this zikr allah for calm and peace.
While walking or working, keep your tongue busy with zikr of Allah for reward.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Powerful Zikr of La ilaha illallah
how_to_perform.description: This zikr allah is a strong way to remember Allah and fill your heart with Iman and Barakah. It is the best zikr for every Muslim to say daily for peace, reward, and closeness to Allah.
steps: After Fajr or Maghrib salah, recite this zikr of allah slowly and with full heart.
When you walk outside or sit alone, softly say la ilaha illallah for daily zikr.
During hard times, use this remembrance of Allah to find calm and ask for help.
If you feel weak, repeat la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah for strength from Allah.
Before going to bed, make this best dhikr of allah your last words for the night.

data.title: Dua for Guidance to the Right Path
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيْلَ وَمِيْكَائِيْلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ اهْدِنِيْ لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِيْ مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍ
data.transliteration: Allaahumma rabba jibra-eel, wameeka-eel, wa-israafeel faatiras-samawaati wal-ardi, AAalimal-ghaybi washshahaadah, anta tahkumu bayna ibaadika feemaa kanoo feehi yakhtalifoon ihdinee limakh-tulifa feehi minal-haqqi bi-idhnika, innaka tahdee man tashaa-o ilaa siraatin mustaqeem
data.translation:
O Allah, Lord of Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel and Israfeel (great angles), Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Knower of the seen and the unseen. You are the arbitrator between Your servants in that which they have disputed. Guide me to the truth by Your leave, in that which they have differed, for verily You guide whom You will to a straight path.

Ayesha said, "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to recite this du'a at the beginning of the night (tahajjud) prayer." It should be noted that every researcher, scholar, mufti and truth-seeking believer should recite this dua more and more at the beginning of tahajjud, in prostration and at all other times. It is very important to seek guidance from Allah Almighty through this dua without relying entirely on one's own research, knowledge or anything else.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، وَأَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ كَانَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَفْتَتِحُ صَلاَتَهُ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَتْ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ افْتَتَحَ صَلاَتَهُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ '
hadith.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf reported: I asked 'A'isha, the mother of the believers, (to tell me) the words with which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commenced the prayer when he got up at night. She said: When he got up at night he would commence his prayer with these words: O Allah, Lord of Gabriel, and Michael, and Israfil, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, Who knowest the unseen and the seen; Thou decidest amongst Thy servants concerning their differences. Guide me with Thy permission in the divergent views (which the people) hold about Truth, for it is Thou Who guidest whom Thou wilt to the Straight Path. [Muslim: 770]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Guidance to Sirat al Mustaqim
benefits.description: This dua for guidance to sirat al mustaqim is a strong prayer for hidayat, helping Muslims find the right path, keep Iman safe, and get Barakah in every Amal, especially when life feels confusing or hard.
points: Allah shows the right way to the one who asks for guidance to sirat al mustaqim.
This islamic prayer for guidance brings Barakah and peace in every Amal and heart.
Dua for hidayat helps a muslim stay away from wrong and find the truth in life.
Asking for siratal mustaqim keeps Iman strong and brings Allah’s mercy in daily choices.
This dua for guidance helps hearts stay clean and close to Allah in every step.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Guidance
when_to_recite.description: This dua for guidance is a strong prayer for hidayat, asking Allah to show you sirat al mustaqim, help you find the truth, and keep your Iman safe when you feel lost or need Barakah in your Amal.
points: After every salah, ask Allah with this dua for guidance to sirat al mustaqim.
When facing confusion in life, use the prayer for guidance to seek hidayat.
Before making a big choice, recite the dua for guidance for Allah’s help and Barakah.
In times of doubt about right and wrong, turn to this hidayat ki dua for clear path.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Guidance to the Right Path

data.title: Gratitude in Islam (Jazakallah Khairan)
data.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
data.transliteration: JazaakAllahu khayran
data.translation:
May Allah reward you with good.

We have seen that the believer never expects gratitude or recompense from anyone who benefits him. On the other hand, it is the duty of the beneficent believer to express gratitude to the benefactor, to praise him, to openly acknowledge his beneficence, and to pray for him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If someone does good to someone and he gives thanks to the benefactor by saying this, then it will be best appreciated.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الْمَرْوَزِيُّ، بِمَكَّةَ وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْجَوْهَرِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَحْوَصُ بْنُ جَوَّابٍ، عَنْ سُعَيْرِ بْنِ الْخِمْسِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ صُنِعَ إِلَيْهِ مَعْرُوفٌ فَقَالَ لِفَاعِلِهِ جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا فَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ فِي الثَّنَاءِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ جَيِّدٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ إِلاَّ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَسَأَلْتُ مُحَمَّدًا فَلَمْ يَعْرِفْهُ ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ حَازِمٍ الْبَلْخِيُّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْمَكِّيَّ بْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ يَقُولُ كُنَّا عِنْدَ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ الْمَكِّيِّ فَجَاءَ سَائِلٌ فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ لِخَازِنِهِ أَعْطِهِ دِينَارًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَا عِنْدِي إِلاَّ دِينَارٌ إِنْ أَعْطَيْتُهُ لَجُعْتَ وَعِيَالَكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَغَضِبَ وَقَالَ أَعْطِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْمَكِّيُّ فَنَحْنُ عِنْدَ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ إِذْ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ بِكِتَابٍ وَصُرَّةٍ وَقَدْ بَعَثَ إِلَيْهِ بَعْضُ إِخْوَانِهِ وَفِي الْكِتَابِ إِنِّي قَدْ بَعَثْتُ خَمْسِينَ دِينَارًا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَلَّ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ الصُّرَّةَ فَعَدَّهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ أَحَدٌ وَخَمْسُونَ دِينَارًا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ لِخَازِنِهِ قَدْ أَعْطَيْتَ وَاحِدًا فَرَدَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَزَادَكَ خَمْسِينَ دِينَارًا ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Usamah bin Zaid narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said: "Whoever some good was done to him, and he says: 'May Allah reward you in goodness' then he has done the most that he can of praise." [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 2035]

data.title: Dua of Love for the sake of Allah (Masnun Dua)
data.arabic: أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ
data.transliteration: Ahabbakal-ladhee 'ahbabtanee lahu
data.translation: May He for Whose sake you love me, love you.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، كَانَ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَرَّ بِهِ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لأُحِبُّ هَذَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَعْلَمْتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَعْلِمْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَحِقَهُ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أُحِبُّكَ فِي اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Anas ibn Malik: A man was with the Prophet (ﷺ) and a man passed by him and said: Messenger of Allah! I love this man. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then asked: Have you informed him? He replied: No. He said: Inform him. He then went to him and said: I love you for Allah's sake. He replied: May He for Whose sake you love me love you! [Hasan (Albani). Abu Dawud: 5125]

data.title: Dua for Blessings in Family and Wealth
data.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
data.transliteration: BaarakAllahu laka fee 'ahlika wa maalik
data.translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your property.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَأَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ وَتَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ‏"‏ كَمْ أَصْدَقْتَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَزْنَ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ‏.‏ وَعَنْ حُمَيْدٍ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ نَزَلَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ عَلَى الأَنْصَارِ فَنَزَلَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ عَلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ فَقَالَ أُقَاسِمُكَ مَالِي وَأَنْزِلُ لَكَ عَنْ إِحْدَى امْرَأَتَىَّ‏.‏ قَالَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ إِلَى السُّوقِ فَبَاعَ وَاشْتَرَى فَأَصَابَ شَيْئًا مِنْ أَقِطٍ وَسَمْنٍ فَتَزَوَّجَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Anas: When `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf married an Ansari woman, the Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "How much Mahr did you give her?" `Abdur-Rahman said, "Gold equal to the weight of a date stone." Anas added: When they (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions) arrived at Medina, the emigrants stayed at the Ansar's houses. `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf stayed at Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi's house. Sa`d said to `Abdur- Rahman, "I will divide and share my property with you and will give one of my two wives to you." `Abdur-Rahman said, "May Allah bless you, your wives and property (I am not in need of that; but kindly show me the way to the market)." So `Abdur-Rahman went to the market and traded there gaining a profit of some dried yoghurt and butter, and married (an Ansari woman). The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Give a banquet, even if with one sheep." [Bukhari: 5167]

data.title: Sujood Dua During Recitation of Quran
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْرًا وَضَعْ عَنِّيْ بِهَا وِزْرًا وَاجعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْرًا وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ
data.transliteration: Allahum-maktub lee bihaa 'indaka 'ajran, wad'a 'annee bihaa wizran, waj'alhaa lee 'indaka thukhran, wa taqabbalhaa minnee kamaa taqabbaltahaa min 'abdika Daawood
data.translation:
O Allah, write it as a reward for me, and release me from a burden for it, and make it a treasure for me in Paradise. Accept it from me as You accepted it from your servant Dawud.

Ibn 'Abbas (RA) said, "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), recited the verses of prostration and recited this du'a." (The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُنَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ رَأَيْتُنِي اللَّيْلَةَ وَأَنَا نَائِمٌ كَأَنِّي أُصَلِّي خَلْفَ شَجَرَةٍ فَسَجَدَتِ الشَّجَرَةُ لِسُجُودِي وَسَمِعْتُهَا وَهِيَ تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْرًا وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْرًا وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْرًا وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ لِي جَدُّكَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَرَأَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَجْدَةً ثُمَّ سَجَدَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَمِعْتُهُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ مِثْلَ مَا أَخْبَرَ الرَّجُلُ عَنْ قَوْلِ الشَّجَرَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Al-Hasan bin Muhammad bin Ubaidullah bin Abi Yazid said: “Ibn Juraij said to me: “Ubaidullah bin Abi Yazid informed me that Ibn Abbas said: “A man came to the Prophet and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah! I had a dream at night while I was sleeping, in which I was praying behind a tree, when I prostrated, the tree prostrated along with me. Then I heard it saying: “O Allah! Record for me a reward with You for it, remove a sin from me by it, and store it away for me with You for it, and accept it from me as You accepted it from Your worshipper Dawud (Allāhumma uktub lī bihā `indaka ajran, waḍa` `annī bihā wizran, waj`alhā lī `indaka dhukhran, wa taqabbalhā minnī kamā taqabbalta min `abdika Dāwūd).” Al-Hasan said: “Ibn Juraij said to me: ‘Your grandfather said to me: “Ibn Abbas said: ‘So the Prophet recited (an Ayah of) prostration, then prostrated.’” [He said] “So Ibn Abbas said: ‘I listened to him, and he was saying the same as the man informed that the tree had said.’” [Hasan (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3424]

benefits.title: Benefits of Sujood Dua for Seeking Forgiveness and Mercy (Surah Muminun)
benefits.description: This sujood dua is said in sajdah tilawat, asking Allah for forgiveness, Barakah, and to accept your Amal just like He accepted from Dawud, making your recitation full of reward and mercy.
points: This sujood dua brings Allah’s forgiveness and mercy to the heart of a Muslim.
Reciting this dua in sajdah tilawat brings Barakah and reward in your Amal.
It is a masnoon dua from Surah Muminun that asks Allah to accept your deeds.
Saying this dua in sujood helps Muslims hope for Jannah and Allah’s acceptance.
This prayer for forgiveness is easy to teach to kids and brings blessings in Quran recitation.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Sujood Dua During Recitation of Quran
when_to_recite.description: This sujood dua is said in sajdah tilawat, asking Allah for forgiveness, Barakah, and to accept your Amal just like He accepted from Dawud, making your recitation full of reward and mercy.
points: When you reach a sajdah ayah in Quran, recite the sujood dua for acceptance and reward.
After making sajda tilawat, ask Allah for forgiveness with this sujood dua from hadith.
While reading Quran at home, use the sujood dua for Jannah and Barakah in your Amal.
In salah, if you come to a sajdah verse, make this sujood dua for mercy and acceptance.
When teaching kids Quran, help them learn the sujood dua for forgiveness and blessings.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Sujood dua during recitation of Quran
how_to_perform.description: This sujood dua is said when you reach a sajdah ayah in the Quran, asking Allah for reward, forgiveness, and Jannah. It is a special masnoon dua that brings Barakah and makes your tilawat full of blessings and mercy.
steps: When you find a sajdah in Quran, stop your recitation and go into sujood right away.
In sujood, recite this sujood dua with a soft voice, asking Allah for forgiveness and reward.
After saying the dua, pray for acceptance of dua and hope for Jannah from Allah.
If you are with others, remind them to do sajda tilawat and recite this prayer for mercy.
Once you finish, thank Allah for letting you do this amal and ask for more chances to do sajdah.

data.title: Remembering Allah in Meetings
data.introduction: Narrated Abu Hurayrah (RA): The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone sits at a place where he does not remember Allah, deprivation will descend on him from Allah; and if he lies at a place where he does not remember Allah, deprivation will descend on him from Allah.

data.title: Meetings Without Dhikr
data.introduction: Narrated Abu Hurayrah (RA): The Prophet (ﷺ) said: People who get up from a sitting or meeting in which they did not remember Allah will be just as if they had got up from an dunkey corpse, and it will be a cause of grief to them.

data.title: Dua After Gathering
data.introduction: Narrated Abdullah bin Umar (RA): We used to count and see that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say a hundred times after the meeting:
data.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَىَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
data.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee watub 'alayya 'innaka 'Antat-Tawwaabur-rahim
data.translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance, You are the Ever-Relenting, the All-Forgiving.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ إِنْ كُنَّا لَنَعُدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الْوَاحِدِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ ‏ "‏ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَىَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: We counted that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would say a hundred times during a meeting: "My Lord, forgive me and pardon me; Thou art the Pardoning and forgiving One". [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 1516]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Allah’s Forgiveness and Kindness (Surah Muminun)
benefits.description: This dua after gathering is a way to ask Allah for forgiveness and Barakah, making your time with others full of mercy, Amal, and keeping your heart clean after every meeting or talk.
points: This dua after gathering brings Allah’s forgiveness and mercy to your heart.
Reciting this dua after meetings or talks brings Barakah and peace in your Amal.
It is a masnoon dua from Surah Muminun that asks Allah to forgive and have mercy.
Saying this dua after gatherings helps keep your Iman strong and your heart clean.
This prayer for forgiveness is easy to say and brings blessings to every group.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Gathering
when_to_recite.description: This dua after gathering is a way to ask Allah for forgiveness and Barakah, making your time with others full of mercy, Amal, and keeping your heart clean after every meeting or talk.
points: When a family meeting ends, use the dua after gathering to seek Allah’s forgiveness.
After finishing a study circle, recite the dua at the end of a gathering for Barakah.
At the close of a friendly talk, make this dua for repentance and mercy from Allah.
When leaving a group after salah, ask Allah with this dua for clean hearts and Amal.
After any gathering, say the dua for forgiveness to keep your Iman strong and pure.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua after Gathering
how_to_perform.description: This dua after gathering is a simple way to ask Allah for forgiveness and mercy after meeting with others. It helps clean your heart from any mistakes made in talks and brings Barakah to your time spent together.
steps: Start by sitting quietly for a moment and remember Allah before saying the dua after gathering.
After any group talk or meeting, softly recite this dua at the end of a gathering to seek forgiveness.
If you feel you said something wrong, use this islamic dua to ask Allah to forgive your words.
When you finish witr prayer, you can also read this dua for witr prayer to ask for Allah’s mercy.
Teach your family to say this masnoon dua after every gathering so everyone gets the reward.

data.title: Dua After Meeting (Kaffaratul Majlis)
data.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوْبُ إِلَيْكَ
data.transliteration: Subhaanaka Allaahumma wa bihamdika, 'ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta, 'astaghfiruka wa 'atoobu 'ilayka
data.translation:
Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise is to You. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.

It is narrated in different authentic chains by the Companions like Abdullah Ibn Amr Ibn Al-As (RA), Abu Barzah Aslami (RA), Abu Hurairah (RA) that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say these words before leaving the meeting at the end of the meeting. He said, "If anyone says these words while getting up from a meeting, it will be an expiation for the meeting. Because of this, Allah Almighty will forgive the unlawful speech and sins of that meeting.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ أَبِي السَّفَرِ الْكُوفِيُّ، - وَاسْمُهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ جَلَسَ فِي مَجْلِسٍ فَكَثُرَ فِيهِ لَغَطُهُ فَقَالَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُومَ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ذَلِكَ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا كَانَ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ ذَلِكَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي الْبَابِ عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ وَعَائِشَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ صَحِيحٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ لاَ نَعْرِفُهُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ سُهَيْلٍ إِلاَّ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Hurairah narrated that: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Whoever sits in a sitting and engages in much empty, meaningless speech and then says before getting from that sitting of his: ‘Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except You, I seek You forgiveness, and I repent to You, (Subḥānaka Allāhumma wa biḥamdika, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilaik)’ whatever occurred in that sitting would be forgiven to him.” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3433]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Forgiveness for Siblings (Surah Al-Araf)
benefits.description: This dua after meeting, known as kaffaratul majlis, helps you ask Allah for forgiveness, Barakah, and to keep your Amal clean after any talk, gathering, or meeting with others.
points: This dua after meeting brings Allah’s forgiveness and mercy to your heart and your brother.
Reciting this dua after gatherings brings Barakah and peace in your Amal.
It is a masnoon dua from Surah Al-Araf that asks Allah to forgive you and your brother.
Saying this dua after meetings helps keep your Iman strong and your heart clean.
This prayer for forgiveness is easy to say and brings blessings to every group.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua After Meeting
when_to_recite.description: This dua after meeting, known as kaffaratul majlis, helps you ask Allah for forgiveness, Barakah, and to keep your Amal clean after any talk, gathering, or meeting with others.
points: When a meeting ends, recite the dua after meeting to seek Allah’s forgiveness and Barakah.
After a family talk or friendly chat, use subhanaka allahumma wa bihamdika for clean hearts.
At the end of a study group, make this dua after salam to thank Allah and ask for mercy.
When leaving a gathering, say the dua after meeting for forgiveness and strong Iman.
After witr prayer, recite this short dua to keep your Amal pure and close to Allah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua After Meeting
how_to_perform.description: This dua after meeting, known as Kaffaratul Majlis, helps clean any wrong words or mistakes made in talks. It is a short islamic dua that brings Barakah and keeps your heart close to Allah after every gathering.
steps: Sit for a moment after the meeting ends and recite subhanaka allahumma wa bihamdika with full heart.
When you finish talking with friends or family, say this dua after salam to ask Allah for forgiveness.
If you feel you said something not good, use this short dua to clean your Amal and seek Allah’s mercy.
After witr prayer or any namaz, you can read this masnoon dua to keep your zikr allah strong.
Teach kids and family to say this muslim prayer after every meeting so everyone gets reward and peace.

data.title: Dua for Ending Majlis
data.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا يَحُولُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيْكَ وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ وَمِنَ الْيَقِيْنِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مُصِيْبَاتِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنَّا وَاجْعَلْ ثَأْرَنَا عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيْبَتَنَا فِي دِيْنِنَا وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا
data.transliteration: Allaahum-maq-sim la-naa min khash-yatika maa ya'hoolu baynanaa wa bayna ma‛aa-seeka, wa min taa‘a-tika maa tuballi-ghunaa bihi jan-nataka, wa mi-nal-yaqee-ni maa tu-hauwinu bihi ‛alaynaa musib-atid-dunyaa, wa matt'iena bi asmaa‛i-naa, wa absaa-rinaa, wa qoo-wati-naa maa a'h-yay-tanaa, waj‛al-hul-waaritha min-naa, waj‛al tha’ra-naa ‛alaa man zala-manaa, wan-sur-naa ‛alaa man ‛aa-daa-naa, wa laa taj‛al mu-seeba-ta-naa fee dee-ni-naa, wa laa taj‛a-lid-dunyaa akbara ham-minaa, wa laa mab-lagha ‛il-minaa, wa laa tusal-lit ‛alay-naa man laa yar-'hamunaa
data.translation:
O Allah, give us such fear that will serve as a barrier between us and acts of disobedience; and give us such obedience that will take us to Your Paradise; and such certainty as will make easy for us to bear in the calamities of this world. O Allah! let us enjoy our hearing, our sight and our strength as long as You keep us alive and keep our senses healthy and sound until the day We die, and make our revenge restricted to those who oppressed us, and support us against those who are hostile to us, and give us not trial in our religion; and let not worldly affairs be our principal concern, or the ultimate limit of our knowledge, and let not those dominate us who do not show mercy to us.

Abdullah bin Umar (RA) said, The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say this dua before leaving the Majlis and seldom left the Majlis without praying for his companions. This hadith is Hasan. [Tirmidhi (49-Kitabud Dawaat, 80-Baab) 5/ 492-493] In another narration, Tabi'i Nafi said, “Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) would not have stood from a meeting without saying these words for the people sitting in the meeting. [Nasai, As-Sunanul Kubra 6/106; Ibn al-Athir, Jamiul Usul 4/279] It is to be noted that the Prophet (ﷺ), the Companions of his Majlis, Abdullah Ibn Umar (RA) or the people of his Majlis did not raise their hands in supplication. We have seen that the Companions were very interested and diligent in narrating the Sunnah of the Prophet (ﷺ). They have described if raising hands during supplication is permissible in this particular case. That is why it is proved that the sunnah is not to be raised. Besides, we have seen that raising the hand during dua is a manners of dua. The Prophet (ﷺ) sometimes supplicated alone and sometimes with the Companions. In the light of this hadith, it is understood that at the end of the meeting, the speaker will say the words of the supplication and the people present will say Amin. If everyone sometimes raises their hands and supplicates, there is no chance of it being considered illegal or bidat. However, depending on the hadith of general virtue, it is bid'ah to consider it necessary to raise one's hand in the case of such duas or to consider it unlawful not to raise one's hand. Since the matter is open, in the light of hadith, the matter must be kept open.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَحْرٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَلَّمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُومُ مِنْ مَجْلِسٍ حَتَّى يَدْعُوَ بِهَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ لأَصْحَابِهِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا يَحُولُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مُصِيبَاتِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنَّا وَاجْعَلْ ثَأْرَنَا عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا وَلاَ تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا وَلاَ مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا وَلاَ تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمُنَا ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ رَوَى بَعْضُهُمْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Ibn `Umar said: “Rarely would the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stand from a sitting until he supplicated with these words for his Companions: ‘O Allah, apportion for us, fear of You, that shall come between us and disobedience of You, and of obedience to You, which shall cause us to obtain Your Paradise, and of certainty, which shall make the afflictions of the world easy for us, and enjoyment of our hearing, and our seeing, and our strength as long as You keep us alive, and make it the inheritor of us. And let our vengeance be upon those who have wronged us, and aid us against those who show enmity towards us, and do not make our affliction in our religion, and do not make this world our greatest concern, nor the limit of our knowledge, and do not give power over us to those who will not have mercy on us. (Allāhumma-qsim lanā min khashyatika mā yaḥūlu, bainanā wa baina ma`āṣīka wa min ṭā`atika mā tuballighuna bihī jannatak, wa minal-yaqīni mā tuhawwinu bihī `alainā muṣībatid-dunyā, wa matti`na bi-asmā`inā wa abṣārina wa quwwatina mā aḥyaytanā, waj`alhul-wāritha minnā, waj`al tha’ranā `alā man ẓalamanā, wanṣurna `alā man `ādānā, wa lā taj`al muṣībatanā fī dīninā, wa lā taj`alid-dunyā akbara hamminā wa lā mablagha `ilminā, wa lā tusalliṭ `alainā man lā yarḥamunā).’” [Hasan (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3502]

data.title: Dua for Eating Food & Drink (Hadith)
data.introduction: Narrated 'Umar ibn Abi Salamah (RA): I was a boy under the care of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). While eating, I would put my hands in different places of the pot. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, “This boy! Say Bismillah, eat, and the next part of your right to eat! "After the meal, I'm going to follow the instructions.

data.title: Dua Before Eating (Bismillah)
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
data.transliteration: Bismillaah
data.translation:
In the Name of Allah.

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was eating with his six Companions when a desert Arab came and ate up the food in two mouthfuls. Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Had he mentioned the Name of Allah, it would have sufficed for all of you." -(The dua is mentioned above)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ، عَنْ بُدَيْلِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ الْعُقَيْلِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَامًا فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Umm Kulthum: From 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When one of you eats food, then let him say: 'Bismillah.' If he forgets in the beginning, then let him say: 'Bismillah Fi Awwalihi Wa Akhirih (In the Name of Allah in its beginning and its end.)" Jami` at-Tirmidhi 1858 [Tirmidhi 4/254, no. 1858]

data.title: Dua Before Eating (Bismillahi Awwalahu Wa Akhirahu)
data.introduction: And if he forgets to say 'Bismillaah', let him say -
data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
data.transliteration: Bismillaahi 'awwalahu wa 'aakhirah
data.translation: In the name of Allah, in the beginning and in the end.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُؤَمَّلُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الدَّسْتَوَائِيَّ - عَنْ بُدَيْلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ، مِنْهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهَا أُمُّ كُلْثُومٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فَإِنْ نَسِيَ أَنْ يَذْكُرَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When one of you eats, he should mention Allah's name; if he forgets to mention Allah's name at the beginning, he should say: "In the name of Allah at the beginning and at the end of it." [Sahih (Albani). Abu Dawud: 3767]
